row.name: Build Master: MarsVille
row.detailed_description: Forge Mars, Command the Stars! As Earth's resources dwindle, humanity has migrated to the distant planet of Mars. Now, your opportunity has arrived! In Build Master: MarsVille , you are invited to pioneer the most captivating colony on this enchanting red world. As your colony grows in scale and complexity, every decision you make will shape its destiny! Bring Your Colony to Life Start with the untouched canvas of Mars and build your dream city. Construct skyscrapers, parks, bridges, and other buildings. Strategically layout your structures to ensure the city's continuous development. On this harsh planet, your decisions affect life and death. Plan your buildings meticulously to boost resource production, meet citizen demands, and stimulate urban expansion. Thriving on Mars Collect various resources from Mars' terrain and strategically allocate them for city construction and upgrades. Trade resources with other players to enhance your colony's prosperity. Make critical financial decisions, balancing investments in the city, the military, and hero development to ensure citizen satisfaction and overall progress. The heroes, each equipped with distinctive abilities, are pivotal in ensuring the smooth operation of city management. Your city may also face attacks from extraterrestrial pirates and sandworms. When battles loom, command your heroes to defend against the invaders! Unleash Your Engineering Genius During the Mars construction process, you'll encounter numerous challenging gaps to bridge. Unleash your creativity and engineering talents to showcase your bridge-building skills. Each level presents breathtaking scenery and brand-new challenges. Can your carefully crafted bridges withstand the weight test and the limits of engineering expertise? Hold your breath and witness the adrenaline-pumping moments! Of course, failure is inevitable. The thrilling moments of bridge collapse or truck mishaps will provide valuable lessons and drive you to refine your skills continually. Team Up and Battle Your Way to Victory Establish close connections with other colonists and unite to face external threats. Exchange resources to promote mutual prosperity and coordinate attacks against common enemies. Challenge rival colonies, seize valuable resources, and immerse yourself in the thrilling excitement of interstellar warfare. Rise in the ranks and accumulate reputation and rewards. Your tactical wisdom will determine victory at crucial moments.
row.short_description: Build Master: MarsVille is a city-building and strategy game that invites you to create your Martian colony with your engineering genius and building skills. Form alliances, trade resources, and conquer rival colonies. Embrace the challenge and become the ultimate Build Master on Mars!

row.name: Space Battle Royale

Inside are five classes of weapons, unique maps with multiverse portals and upgrades based on alien technology. Everything to build the ultimate fighting machine — and dominate the arena. Are you ready space pilots? Fight your way to the final showdown inside the mysterious Cube, unleashing havoc and leaving behind only the debris of your rivals. Oh, you're the one left among the wreckage? Upgrade your attributes and modify the ship – and get back into the carnage! Play strategically, placing mines and moving between cover – or go guns blazing shooting lasers and rockets all around! Space Battle Royale welcomes all playstyles. But keep an eye out — your rivals aren’t so welcoming. Features: Battle Royale. In space. The game scales up the familiar fun of the genre to new, orbital-level heights. Survival of the fittest. Master five weapon types, AI drones, and a complex system of upgrades to defeat your opponents. Everyone can be a pilot. Zero-G navigation and shooting mechanics are finely tuned to be approachable for beginners and rewarding for advanced players. It’s easy to start flying but it can take a lifetime to master. The future of space tourism. Explore and master our starting battlefields, alien artifacts, multiverse portals and asteroid belts. NOTE: The safety of space tourists is absolutely not guaranteed. The team behind this game is a group of mathematicians and physicists specialised in alternative dimensions So watch out, you never know where you might end up!
row.short_description: Welcome to cosmic chaos. This non-stop action arcade will test you to see if you are truly worthy of space travel. The full use of 3d space, five classes of weapons, and upgrades based on alien technology and alternative dimensions make for the most competitive and mind-expanding game out there.

row.name: Chrono Crystal
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the mysterious continent of Falantero! We have been waiting for you for a long time. As the power of darkness invades, the evil and greedy monsters and evil people start to move. The demon king who brought great calamity a thousand years ago is about to awaken again. He will break the seal and lead his army to sack everything ...... The armies are waiting for your command! Before the Chrono Crystal unleashes its powerful ability, you need to freely plan tactics within the countdown and use uniquely stylized defense towers to defeat the enemies attempting to destroy the Chrono Crystal, until the very last moment. You will travel with the human prince through several distinctive regions and meet with regional leaders to find ways to cooperate. The various heroes you meet along the way will bring their unique talents to bear. Ultimately, you will work together to defeat the Demon King and find the truth behind this terrifying conspiracy. Whether you want to leave feedback or report bugs, please keep in touch with us through our email address: service@my51share.com

You'll be drawn into the heart of the mystery as you navigate through a collection of diverse and intriguing scenarios that will put your observation skills to the test. But the excitement doesn't stop there! This game also features engaging puzzles that add another layer of entertainment to your crime-solving adventure. Exercise your strategic thinking and quick reflexes as you clear the board of colorful jewels, uncovering precious artifacts and unlocking hidden secrets along the way. With each successful match, you'll be one step closer to uncovering the truth behind the criminal underworld. Join the ranks of the elite detectives in a secret organization, and embark on a riveting story of adventure and intrigue. You'll be tasked with finding unique treasures and collections, and as you do, you'll uncover the enigmatic tale of a secret society that operates in the shadows. Travel across three continents, from the bustling streets of New York to the exotic landscapes of Asia, uncovering hidden gems and solving crimes that have stumped the world's finest detectives. As you dive deeper into the game, you'll collect unique artifacts and objects, forming stunning collections that reveal the rich history and secrets of the secret organization. With each new discovery, you'll gain valuable rewards and unlock powerful tools to aid you in your quest. Share your progress with friends, trade items, and join forces to uncover the hidden truth that lies beneath the surface. With a vast array of hidden object scenes, puzzles, and a captivating story, this hidden object adventure is the ultimate game for both new and experienced players alike.

row.name: Bingo Pinball Gameroom
row.detailed_description: Bingo Pinball Gameroom is a collection of 80 extremely realistic Bingo Pinball simulations, amusement machines that were very popular in the 50s to mid 70s. Although officially 'for amusement only', used for gambling nevertheless. Eventually banned in many states all over the world. They proved to be too addictive, too dangerous. Those who know Bingo Pinballs – maybe even had the chance to play them – will appreciate the realistic gameplay. Those who don't know them may be surprized: at first glance it looks just a kind of flipper pinball. But they will soon realize that to score the highest wins, hard decisions have to be made with many possible strategies to follow. No, there's no money involved in the simulations, but can prove to be very addictive still. And no, they have nothing to do with that other bingo game, often played in senior homes... Look and feel of original Bingo Pinball machines All sounds sampled from real Bally and United Bingos Large, crisp graphics Built-in support for multi-screen Virtual Cabinets (using PinballX, Pinup Popper or any other frontend software) Interface to connect to a real Bingo Cabinet Available for Windows and Apple OSX Bally Show Time included, free to play
row.short_description: A collection of 80 Bingo Pinball simulations. Discover why people became addicted to these mysterious machines in the past. row.name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre Playtest
Fitting-In
row.detailed_description: As you work through a level, your past moves are stored in a move history. When you move in the pattern “direction, direction, opposite direction, direction” (for example up, up, down, up) you perform a happy jump which flings you three places instead of one. Things start to heat up when different blocks get introduced that serve as both obstacles and advantages. Walls are the simplest block. You can’t walk through them and have to happy jump over them. Pause blocks are tricky buggers. You can walk inside of them, but the move you make into them is not counted in your move history. The move you make out of the block is counted! Break blocks are the opposite. You can’t walk inside a break block, but running into it will add to the move history even though your player stays in exactly the same spot. Move blocks can be pushed around to clear a path or used in tandem with break blocks to make some crazy moves possible. There are currently 39 levels! I hope you have as much fun playing them as I have had making them.
row.short_description: Fitting-In is a single player puzzle game where you perform movement combos to jump over, through, and inside obstacles! There are walls, pause blocks, break blocks, and move blocks that all require creativity to overcome!

row.detailed_description: Welcome to Duels of Fortune , a super-powered fighting game featuring a crazy diverse cast of loveable characters with unique abilities, and freeform systems that let you play the game your way. It provides a simple control scheme that makes the game accessible for beginners, while keeping plenty of mechanical and character-based depth for serious players to dig into. From intense clashes against friends and rivals, to expansive singleplayer content, to a rich setting full of interesting characters to learn about, there's something for everyone in Duels of Fortune! VERSUS MODE - Battle it out with local friends or CPUs in traditional 1-on-1 duels! ARCADE MODE - Fight your way through a gauntlet of increasingly difficult opponents, culminating in a boss battle with the tournament organizer himself! MISSION MODE - Take on over 75 hand-crafted challenge battles that add special conditions and obstacles to the match! TRAINING MODE - Practice your skills using a customizable training dummy! BOSS FIGHTS - Easily rematch any of the unique and challenging bosses found throughout the game! COMBO TRIALS - Learn what each character can do by trying out increasingly tricky pre-made combos! STAGE HAZARDS - A toggleable feature that flips stages on their head with all sorts of crazy effects, including ring-out zones, throwable items, giant skeletons that attack you from the background, and MORE!! LORE JOURNAL - Read up on the lore and backstory of each character, and learn what they fight for! JUKEBOX - Jam out to the bangin' soundtrack composed by Jack7! All with 20+ UNIQUE FIGHTERS to choose from, with even more on the way! Perform stylish and dynamic combos with an open-ended attack cancel system! Build up your Super Meter to unleash powerful and cinematic Super Moves , or defend yourself in a pinch with invincible Reversal attacks! Strategically use Break Burst to shut down your opponents' combos, or go all-in on your own combo with a well-timed Blast Burst ! Schmoove around the stage with a variety of movement mechanics , including dashes, long jumps, airdashes, free air drifting, and tons of unique character-specific options! And on top of all that, explore each character's plethora of unique attributes , giving every one of them a completely distinct feel and playstyle! What would a fighting game be without its fun and diverse cast of playable characters? Here's just a handful of the loveable (and despicable) fighters you can choose from! ‎ Clyde is a boxing prodigy with an attitude, and one of the most renowned fighters in the world. Clyde doesn't need any weapons; his fists, his natural speed, and his ability to create fire from his hands are all he needs to put up a good fight! TRAILBLAZER - Rush in and overwhelm your opponents with Clyde's incredible speed and offensive capabilities! BRING THE HEAT - Clyde's special moves are focused on raw power and combo utility, delivering fiery punches left and right! KING OF THE RING - Keep your opponent on the ropes with fast mix-ups that force equally fast reactions! ‎ Annie is a young engineer with a big brain, and an even bigger heart. Using her powerful mechanical arm, her vast arsenal of gadgets, and her helpful robotic companion Gizmo, she holds her own even despite her lack of experience! GADGET GIRL - Annie's wide array of projectiles and traps let her set up an unbreakable defense, and she has the tools to easily convert her long-range zoning into close-up pressure! BLAST OFF - Annie's special rocket boots grant her a midair jump, as well as the ability to drastically slow her descent! HELPING HAND - Annie's Super Moves summon her little robo-buddy Gizmo to assist her in various ways, like firing massive lasers or carpet-bombing the whole stage! ‎ Long ago, Rattlebone was a royal knight who loyally served his kingdom, until one day he fell victim to a horrible trebuchet accident. Now, revived into the modern day in skeletal form, he continues to fight as honourably as ever with his trusty sword and shield! FOR HONOUR - An honest and noble fighter, Rattlebone is primarily focused on the absolute fundamentals of combat! RATTLE ME BONES - Rattlebone's skeletal form grants him plenty of new techniques, like throwing his own head as a bouncing projectile! CHIVALROUS SPIRIT - Unleash a powerful Super Move that imbues Rattlebone's sword with special properties for a limited time! ‎ Shoto is a young, yet highly skilled student of the Locks Dojo. While he may have the personality of a cardboard box, his powers of electricity and his unbreakable focus in combat make him a force to be reckoned with! GREASED LIGHTNING - Shoto's attacks are fast and precise, giving him a natural advantage in hand-to-hand combat! GLASS CANNON - Shoto may sport a low health pool, but he's got lots of ways to dish out far more damage in return! SHOTOKAN SPECIAL - With straightforward projectiles, a powerful uppercut, and a flurry of advancing kicks, Shoto remains true to his namesake while putting his own unique spin on the formula! ‎ A brash, delinquent punk from the Capital, Red's aggressive and brutish nature is reflected in his fighting style. Red aims to get in his opponent's face and stay there, relentlessly beating them down with his energy beam! BRUTE STRENGTH - Red is a powerful attacker who prefers to brute-force his way in, rather than relying on speed or zoning. UNYIELDING RAGE - Red's special Rage mechanic lets him unleash stronger versions of his special moves after taking or dealing enough damage! SMASHIN' KNEECAPS - Thanks to his many grappling attacks and deadly mix-ups, Red almost never has to let up his offense once he has the advantage! ‎ Often called the 'strongest man alive', Baron's overwhelming desire to fight strong opponents led him down a dark, bloody path that ended with a life sentence. Now set free again thanks to the manipulation of Sylvan Blackjack, his titanic strength and powerful grappling techniques will crush all who oppose him. WRESTLING LEGEND - Baron's mighty grappling moves can dish out damage like nothing else, and can even be comboed together under the right circumstances! UNBREAKABLE - With a huge HP pool and a variety of armoured attacks, Baron is both an unstoppable force, AND an immovable object! THE BIGGER THEY ARE... - Baron's great power comes at the cost of mobility. Use your techniques wisely to keep the opponent on the back foot and avoid getting overwhelmed! ‎ ‎ Sylvan is the founder and CEO of the Diamondeye Company, one of the largest and richest corporations in the world. Naturally, this can only mean that Sylvan is as sleazy and underhanded as they come, and he'll put all his chips down to get the job done. ACES HIGH - Sylvan revolves around his card drawing mechanic. The more Aces he draws using his card draw attacks, the more options he gains! FULL HOUSE - When Sylvan has all 4 aces, he enters a state called Full House mode, where he becomes the most powerful character in the game for a limited time! GOOD LUCK - It can take some time and luck to get to Full House mode, but tools like a slot machine that grants random effects, and your faithful bodyguard Mr. Withers, can help buy you some time. ‎ Once a feared high-seas pirate, Shiverskull is back from the dead to plunder the competition! With his twin swords and the help of his trusted pirate crew, he isn't afraid to take some serious risks to win. You can't kill what's already dead! AYE, MATEYS - Shiverskull can summon the members of his pirate crew one after another to perform assist attacks, each with their own strengths and uses! RECKLESS SAILOR - Shiverskull is great when it comes to running in and putting on the pressure — but be careful, as messing up can cost you dearly! MORE SWORDS - Wield a deadly Super Move that summons a ring of damaging swords around you for a short time! ‎ Black Heart is an alien parasite that feeds off people's inner hatred to take on their form. Having taken the form of Clyde, Black Heart inherits his speed and fire abilities, but like the trickster they are, they use those powers in much more devious ways. TRICKSTER - Black Heart is capable of all sorts of mix-ups that are extremely difficult to react to, forcing their opponents into a guessing game! SLIPPERY SLIME - Black Heart has some of the trickiest movement in the game, with unique dashes and special moves that let them easily dodge enemy attacks! HEART BREAKER - Rain terror with a Super Move that traps the opponent in a massive smoke cloud, letting you be nearly invisible as you get in their face! Everyone's favourite green, legless superhero, Callowman blurs the line a bit between bravery and stupidity. But regardless of his quality as a hero, he certainly has the raw strength to warrant being called the mightiest warrior in the universe! GRAPPLING WITH EVIL - Callowman's slew of advancing grappling attacks make him extremely fearsome to fight, especially since he's no slouch on speed! SHOW OFF - Successfully taunting as Callowman powers up your grabbing attacks, and you can use them in combos! Now that's what I call a flex! ALMIGHTY POWER - One of Callowman's Super Moves, if used with a full Super Meter AND a full taunt-buff meter, can instantly KO the opponent!! ‎ The fourth-wall-breaking, two-dimensional menace, Doodle emerges from the depths of development hell to exact his revenge for all the cancelled games he was meant to star in. The first step of his vengeance quest? Breaking ALL the rules! CHARGE UP - Doodle goes against the game's normal control scheme, introducing special moves inputted with charge motions! SCREEN HOG  -   Doodle's lingering projectiles can create difficult situations for the opponent to get around, especially since he's no slouch on offense either! METER BURNER - Unload tons of damage with a Super Move that lets you spend even more meter to increase its power! And this is just a small sample! There are  even more characters to discover for yourself when you hop into the game! So what are you waiting for? Get in there and SHOW YOUR POWER !!
row.short_description: A crazy, explosive fighting game with an expressive combo system and a diverse character roster! Play as superhumans, skeletons, aliens, and even stick figures! Battle dangerous foes, take part in lots of exciting singleplayer modes, throw your opponents into the sun, and so much more!
row.notes: Mild language/swearing Implied alcohol usage Tobacco usage Depictions of blood stains and visible wounds Use of firearms Depictions of criminal activities

row.name: Blade Fury
row.detailed_description: This is a fast-paced, first-person hack-and-slash game with 9 different levels that takes place in a futuristic and stylised environment. The player is equipped with advanced movement mechanics such as double jumping, wall running, ziplining, dashing and grappling to help traverse levels, avoid obstacles and kill enemies to obtain a key which can be used to access the next level.
row.short_description: The player is equiped with advanced movement mechanics in order to clear levels by avoiding obstacles, killing enemies and eventually obtaining a key which will be used to access the next level.

row.name: EndlessCar
row.detailed_description: EndlessCar is a casual mini-game that allows you to earn unlimited points to control cars, and the controls are simple and easy to play. The screen you see is all about the game, no upgrades, no levels, and the way you control it is A/D to dodge obstacles left and right while gaining oil drums to gain points and power-ups. The makers thoughtfully added the function of switching backgrounds for players to make it less monotonous, using the keyboard :W. This will not affect the progress of the game. If you want to take a break from a stressful game, you can also press ESC to pause the game. Conditions of Death: 1. The energy bar state disappears, that is, it loses power, so collect as many oil barrels as possible to keep energy. 2. Avoid crashing into obstacles! Points Requirements: One point is awarded for successfully obtaining the oil drum. Please note: there is no upper limit to the maximum score! Have fun!
row.short_description: The car passes through obstacles to earn points mini-game.

row.name: Pedros Eggventure
row.detailed_description: Roadmap Unfortunately there is no roadmap. Our game will be made as is please leave a review. Tell us what we might of done differently to captivate you. About the Game Introducing Pedro's Eggventure, the thrilling first-person and 2D action-adventure game that'll have you hooked! Embark on an epic quest as you navigate through diverse environments in search of the elusive EGG. Unleash your skills and strategy as you face the fierce boss dragon in an unforgettable showdown. Designed for single-player action, this captivating game offers a smooth gaming experience with minimal system requirements. Get ready to embark on the ultimate Eggventure and return home victorious!
row.short_description: we are doing this game for a project at 'univercity'. we hope you enjoy this game that we made. we have everything you would want, a main character who totally does not look like Pedro Pascal, a dragon, a run for your life and just some good old egg puns. - Ms Maddy of Breakfast Crew

row.name: Sword Art Online: Integral Factor
row.detailed_description: The popular smartphone game SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor (SAOIF) will now be available on Steam! Play it with a controller or your keyboard with custom key configurations! See the world of Aincrad come to life on a large PC monitor! This time, the protagonist is...you! You appear in this online RPG as a member of an Assault Team, working with other imprisoned players to reach the 100th floor of Aincrad! What if you were trapped in a game of life or death? You can experience meeting familiar characters and connecting to the original SAO story from your own POV. Experience behind-the-scenes stories not seen in the original SAO, and completely different story developments! Live out a 'what-if' story where you affect Aincrad! Battle System Fight through the sprawling fields of Aincrad with your partner Koharu, trapped together in a game of life and death! You'll need to cooperate with Assault Teams across the land and battle together to beat powerful monsters and tough quests! Forging stronger weapons, using skills with all kinds of effects, and preparing for each enemy's weak points and attack patterns are all key to your success!
row.short_description: Aim to conquer Aincrad with Kirito and Asuna

row.name: Bone Boy
row.detailed_description: Play as Bone Boy in this humerus game. Skate your way through the body as you use your rad tricks to defeat enemies and unleash your need for speed. Encounter an unforgettable range of characters such as Uncle Funny Bone and Jerry The Sentient Gum Wad. Explore cool environments such as the dystopian liver or the blasted tundra of the lungs. Unravel the mysteries of the body as you encounter the various illnesses that plague it.
row.short_description: Feeling bad to the bone? Shred through the body as Bone Boy - learn rad tricks, help your friends and collect epic hats along the way. Get out there and tear it up, kid!

row.name: Aphelion Headhunters
row.detailed_description: Step into the shoes of one of an elite mercenary wielding powerful abilities and firepower in Aphelion Headhunters , a Third-Person PVE Hero Shooter featuring high octane combat and specially crafted abilities and perks. Play as either the Hellion or the Sunslinger, two highly trained Headhunters seeking to the claim the bounty on the head of a notorious Raider and his army of minions. Each of the Headhunters features their own distinct playstyles, abilities and suite of selectable upgrades, offering high replayability and thoughtful buildcrafting. Abilities Each character in Aphelion Headhunters features One Weapon, Three Active abilities and a Passive Ability. Active Abilities are powerful skills that can be used at any time while off cooldown, offering fun and unique gameplay advantages. Passive Abilities are charged up in response to certain triggers, and once ready, provide special boons that further compliment their unique playstyle. The Sunslinger A deadly marksman wielding a rapid fire SMG and the destructive power of the sun in the palm of his hand, the Sunslinger burns down his enemies in a hail of gunfire. Able to blind enemies, hurl fireballs and reload his weapon at the speed of light, the Sunslinger is a deadly foe and a master of dishing out high damage in a short time. The Hellion A close range brawler wielding a shotgun and mysterious yet powerful psionic abilities, the Hellion gets up close and personal and stays there until her enemies are demolished at her feet. Able to weave the power of psionics into swords, shields and bursts of telekinetic fury that stuns opponents, the Hellion is able to keep herself alive by dealing damage, granting her a useful overshield so that she can keep on fighting. Perks System The unique abilities featured by both characters can be further augmented using a selection of specifcally crafted perks, enabling players to tailor their experience to fit their playstyle. Choosing up to 3 perks from a total pool of 8, players can make the characters their own, and enjoy hours of replayability with different perks and builds.
row.short_description: Aphelion Headhunters is a Third-Person PVE Hero Shooter featuring two unique player characters, each with their own distinct playstyle, abilities and suite of selectable upgrades.

row.name: Trolley Delayma
row.detailed_description: Trolley Delayma is a tiny puzzle game where you move around manipulating the tracks to save the victims and delay the inevitable fate forever. A combination of puzzle solving and fast reaction to save everyone, including you! Features 20 different levels for about 30 minutes of Gameplay. This game was originally created for the Ludum Dare 50, with the theme 'delay the inevitable'.
row.short_description: Top down puzzle game about manipulating the tracks to redirect the trolley to save the victims. Solve the trolley problem in various forms of tiny puzzles.

row.name: NonFullControl
row.detailed_description: This is a simple minigame that used to be a testing project. Inspiration was generated in several simple scenes, and since then, that space has taken on new meaning and I wants to share it. Q: What kind of game is this? A: This is a 3D, platform like jumping, level breaking game. Q: What will you experience in the game? A: In the game, players need to overcome numerous levels without fully controlling their own operations, and ultimately be led to the truth behind them. Q: Where will the game's save be stored? A: The game's archive will only exist locally. Free Plan: This game is planned to be converted to a free game after the actual sales volume is less than (unknown reasons) or equal to 1111 . The mobile version will also eliminate advertising. Self-rating: 5/10 —— Bilibili：危途异客
row.short_description: A simple and short minigame.When some of your actions are not under your control, can you unravel the truth behind? Relying on partially controllable operations to pass through the level, there seems to be some anomalies in the space.

row.name: o7
row.detailed_description: Complete redesign We will soon release a new version with better graphics and a complete overall design. We are also working on a multiplayer mode where the last person alive wins. Stay tuned. About the Game o7 is an infinite vertical scroller where the floor is Lava , you have to go up as fast as possible and try to stay alive. The lava is constantly raising and accelerating. This game was originaly made in 48H during a Game Jam. o7 features an Online Leaderboard even if the game is only solo (for now).
row.short_description: o7 is an infinite vertical scroller where the floor is Lava, you have to go up as fast as possible and try to stay alive.

row.name: Witchcraft: Candy Hunt
row.detailed_description: Witchcraft: Candy Hunt is an old-school shooter game with charming pixel art graphics that will take you on a Halloween adventure. Fly on a broomstick and battle your way through three exciting levels, each one featuring unique spooky creatures such as pumpkin monsters, evil crows and ghosts. With three different modes of difficulty to choose from, our game provides a fun and enjoyable experience for players of all levels. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced player, Witchcraft: Candy Hunt is the perfect game for all ages. Join the witch on a magical journey and help save Halloween from spooky creatures in this charming old-school shooter game! The game offers three difficulty modes for players of all skill levels: - The Rainbow mode is the easiest and is recommended for young or inexperienced new players. With fewer monsters and less aggressive enemies, it's the perfect way to ease into the game - The Moderate difficulty is a balanced option that is designed to be fun and challenging for most players - The Hostile mode gives the player a real challenge. With more enemies and a greater level of difficulty, it's the perfect choice for experienced players who want to put their skills to the test Casual arcade action Experience non-stop action with infinite lives and checkpoints in Witchcraft: Candy Hunt! Choose from five types of powerful spells to help you defeat spooky creatures, including powerful blue bullets, laser green spells, homing yellow bullets, large wave pink spells, and double bullet purple spells. With each type of spell providing a unique advantage, you'll have the tools you need to overcome the toughest challenges in the game. The levels Explore three distinct levels – the Forest, Graveyard, and Castle – each with its own unique look and feel. Encounter many monsters along the way, each with their own set of powers, making every level a new and exciting challenge. As you progress, you'll face mini-bosses and bosses at the end of each level, each with their own distinct patterns and multiple phases to conquer. It's up to you to understand and overcome their challenges to progress through the game. Get ready to experience a world full of spooky creatures and thrilling battles, and emerge victorious as the ultimate witch of Halloween!
row.short_description: Witchcraft: Candy Hunt is an old-school shooter game with charming pixel art graphics that will take you on a Halloween adventure. Fly on a broomstick and battle your way through three exciting levels, each one featuring unique spooky creatures such as pumpkin monsters, evil crows and ghosts.

row.name: Miners Settlement
row.detailed_description: Tinker with the best gear and harness the power of intricate rune words to enhance your abilities and overcome formidable challenges. Every battle is an opportunity to showcase your expertise and optimize your loadout, ensuring you're prepared for the diverse range of content that awaits. Forge lasting friendships as you embark on thrilling adventures together. Engage in epic guild content, such as challenging dungeons and exhilarating dragon fights, where cooperation is the key to victory. Unleash your entrepreneurial spirit in the bustling Open Market, a vibrant hub where players can trade equipment and goods. Shape the dynamic in-game economy and get rich as you engage in thrilling transactions. Take a break from epic boss battles and delve into the realm of professions. Engage in the tranquil art of harvesting and fishing, where you can immerse yourself in the beauty of nature. With unique pixel art graphics, our game invites you to embark on a visually stunning adventure. Experience the freshly revamped starting location and explore various enchanting landscapes, from verdant elvish forests to mystical dwarven ruins.
row.short_description: Explore enchanting landscapes with unique pixel art graphics. Join a guild for thrilling adventures and epic battles. Cooperate to conquer dungeons and dragons. Trade in the Open Market, master professions, and create your build. Forge friendships and shape your destiny in our immersive RPG world!

row.name: Watermelon
row.detailed_description: Watermelon is a clicker game where you click on a watermelon to grow your collection! Get a random watermelon every 3 hours. Features: Watermelons, obviously Items to boost your watermelon collection Achievements to unlock A community that's all about watermelons --- It was developed for the following reasons: The Meme I was bored Unity x Steam Integration Tutorial Youtube Video
row.short_description: Watermelon is a clicker game where you click on a watermelon to earn more watermelons! In Watermelon, your goal is to click the juicy fruit to expand your watermelon collection. Every 3 hours, a new watermelon will appear for you to add to your growing stash.

row.name: Year 500
row.detailed_description: 'Your memory is failing you again? I will indulge you just this once...' It is the Year 500. Chaos fell upon the world ten years ago when an unknown and mysterious celestial body arrived and began orbiting Earth. Given the name 'The Witness' by the natives of the Runic Empire, the celestial body eerily leered down at the people of the world as its energy gifted people with magical powers beyond their wildest dreams. Ranging from control over the elements like Earth and Fire, to more sophisticated powers like control over animal life and even the gift of healing, humanity found plenty of uses for the newly-found powers they had been bestowed. The gifts people received were named “Bursts” after their ability to burst through the limitations of what humanity once thought was possible, and those capable of using them were named “Breakers”. Humanity appeared to be entering a Golden Age of power…but their prosperity was short-lived. Soon, those who relished themselves too extensively in the Witness’ gifts found themselves corrupted, their mental sanity breaking down as the Burst magic running through their veins malformed their minds and bodies. These lost souls were referred to as the Broken, and they ranged from mindless zombies to intelligent monsters. Among them was King Runic, the most powerful wizard to ever live. When the witness appeared, he used the chaos to consolidate his power and take over. His presence as the king allowed him to maintain control over his many conquered nations. Among his many loyal men, three soldiers were brought together by the sheer gravity of his power. These soldiers served as extensions of his power and were used to conquer and control the region. When King Runic eventually passed, a void of strength was created; one that could only be filled with more strength. Over the years, factions were formed around two of the pillars while the 3rd disappeared completely. The runic kingdom was split once more between the 2 mad kings: Weiss and Saladin. Though mercenaries are looked down upon by society as ruthless individuals and contracted killers, there is one particular group of them that act in the interest of the people. This group, led by the protagonist, Oden, is one such group. You, as the player, take control of Oden who is famous across the region for his combat aptitude and unwavering stamina and strength. Though, Oden is a victim of severe amnesia and his past is a complete mystery to him, but not all hope is lost after his group is contracted to neutralize the Three Pillars of the Runic Kingdom. With this quest accepted, Oden and his band of mercenaries venture across the land to combat evil and the Three Pillars themselves in an epic and action-packed adventure. Will you reclaim your memory and save the kingdom from total corruption? Lethal Swordplay Use your sharpened and lethal sword to strike down foes and maintain your Breaker Gauge. Magic Casting Oden isn't just limited to his sword. Oden can cast magic spells that deal great damage to enemies. Be careful, however, as continued use of these spells can subject Oden into what we call... Broken Mode Continuous exposure to magic and Bursts casts Oden into Broken Mode, a transformation that boosts all of Oden's combat capabilities. Be sparing with this mode, as it will limit your vitality the more you use it. Engaging Story The world of Year 500 has plenty of characters and lore to discover. Speak to your fellow mercenaries, descry the world around you and be exposed to a rich lore that has more than meets the eye.
row.short_description: Year 500 is a third-person, hack-n-slash adventure game featuring swordplay, magic casting, and an engaging story set in a fantasy world. Reclaim your memory, oppose and defeat evil, and save the kingdom by any means necessary.

row.name: Moonring
row.detailed_description: A free game by the co-creator of the XBox's Fable series. Five hundred years ago, the land of Caldera was plunged into endless darkness. Decades later, five moons rose in the sky, bringing light to the world and strange Gods with it. With them came the Dreams: calls to Devotion promising supernatural Gifts. Thus, the new Calderan civilisation was born; a world of Devotion and Dreamers, Gods and Gifts, with a Dreamless Archon acting as the Gods' mortal representative. But Archons are not eternal, and a successor must be found. You are Dreamless: free to choose your own destiny, to ask questions others dare not, or even become Archon yourself. What will you do, Dreamless one? Moonring is a retro-inspired open-world, turn-based, tile RPG in the style of the classic Ultima games, but created from the ground up with modern design sensibilities. The world's geography is hand-designed, but the deadly dungeons beneath the surface reconfigure each time you leave... or die. Travel, trade, sneak, fight and sail the world of Caldera. Speak with the townsfolk, learn Caldera's secrets, and challenge the Archon for his throne... or even overthrow the Gods themselves! Features: - Large, hand-designed open world - An infinite supply of dungeons generated using your character name - Over 100 varied enemy types, from fodder to bosses - 35 unique Gifts from the Gods, their usage changing with the moon phases - Sailing, ship-to-ship combat and boarding - A Dungeon Synth OST with over 50 tracks, all made using retro Mod Trackers! - A hidden magic system and many other mysteries A note from the creator: Hi folks. I've loved RPGs since the early 1980s, and grew up playing games like Lord British's 'Ultima' series and early Roguelikes. This is my love-letter to a style of gaming that has largely fallen out of fashion: with its vivid, bright sprites overlaid on stark black backgrounds, true open-world gameplay, and lack of handholding. The days I spent playing these games were spent in joyful exploration and discovery, venturing into the dark unknown, a co-author of the experience, filling in the gaps left by the primitive art with my imagination. For those of you who did the same, I hope Moonring recaptures some of the spirit of those days for you. For those who did not, I hope that the more modern conveniences you find in this game allow you to catch a glimpse of what we did 40 years ago. My heartfelt thanks to all who spared even a moment to play this. Please be kind to my mistakes. I will fix them. :-) - Dene
row.short_description: A dark-fantasy, turn-based, retro-fusion of classic turn-based RPGs and roguelikes, all presented with a unique neon aesthetic.

row.name: Luckie Ball
row.detailed_description: Luckie Ball is a short precision platformer where nothing is fully solid. You'll float to the top of everything! Inspired by the Flash games you used to play in the school computer lab, Luckie Ball features dozens of hand-drawn levels for you to traverse through. The tight and responsive controls lend well to advanced mechanics and optimized movement. Collect Luckie Coins to unlock a wealth of bonus levels and character skins! Take on the Extreme Gauntlet, a set of three torturous levels that'll test the limits of your patience and skill. Expert understanding of the physics engine is mandatory. Flex your creative muscles with the custom level creator! Share the level file with your friends so they can enjoy your masterpieces too. Need another way to compete? Set the fastest time you can in Speedrun Mode! All of this content is totally free. There's no in-app purchases or paid DLC! That means there's no excuse for you not to play. Or maybe there is. I'm not you, I wouldn't know.
row.short_description: A short precision platformer where nothing is fully solid. Roll, float, and air jump your way through zany worlds and bonus challenges!

row.name: Fusionist
row.detailed_description: Fusionist is a turn-based strategy sci-fi game. Players lead a team of five mechs, strategically combining cores and mechs to create unique tactical combinations for battle. The game features three elemental types—Frozen (Ice), Burn (Fire), and Electric (Lightning)—allowing players to trigger diverse elemental reactions, such as ice-based control, continuous fire damage, and electric chain explosions, greatly enhancing combat strategy. Each of the five mech classes has distinct roles: melee Striker, shielded Defender, ranged Buster, precision Sniper, and backline Support. Players can adapt their tactics to the battlefield situation. Turn-based combat emphasizes action order and formation placement, offering deep strategic gameplay. Players can complete missions to collect resources, forge and upgrade their own mech squad. In the arena, they can compete with commanders worldwide, where team composition and skillful operation determine victory. The new version introduces more powerful weapons and innovative core mechanics, allowing players to fully enjoy the strategic sci-fi mech experience.
row.short_description: Introducing Fusionist Launch Version: The New Beginning! On Dec. 23rd, 2024, Fusionist will bring forth new maps, powerful weapons, and the game-changing Core System! Experience deeper customization and exciting strategies as you dive into the new Fusionist adventure!
row.reviews: “The prestigious Famitsu Japan has done an extensive preview about Fusionist Beta II, the article is written in Japanese and can be found here:” Famitsu

row.name: Situation TARFU
row.detailed_description: Overview Situation TARFU has two main modes, the singleplayer mode 'Classic' and the multiplayer versus mode 'Totally Royal' both modes involve getting a high score however the singleplayer mode you compete with the local high score whereas in the versus mode you battle it out with a friend to steal points in an arena map. row.name: HexBat
row.detailed_description: This is a 2 player turn-based strategy game. Think chess meets turn-based RPGs. Each player's team is made up of one character from each of these positions: -Forward (Tank) - Usually has high health and damage while also being the slowest character. -Flex (DPS) - Is flexible with how each character plays but is usually the fastest character. -Support (Healer) - Has support abilities that enable other characters. Characters take turns depending on their speed and generate Action Points at the start of each of their turns. Action Points (AP) are used for either Actions (Attacks / Healing) or Moving (1 AP per tile). Any unspent Action Points are carried over to the character's next turn up to a maximum of 6 AP. Hex Grids consist of up to a maximum of 25 tiles of Five different types: -Spawn: Spawn point for a Character (turns into a grass tile during game). -Grass: Basic tile with no direct effects. -Mud: Costs an additional AP to traverse. -Molten: Take 10 Damage at the end of Character's turn. -Corrupt: Doubles all Damage Character receives. You can create your own custom Hex Grids with the in-game editor. Victory Condition: First player to kill 2 characters of the Opponent's team.
row.short_description: Challenge your Friends in this Free turn-based, chess-like strategy game with Healers, Rogues, Archers, and more! Create your own Hexagon Grids for near endless variation.

row.name: Angels vs Angels
row.detailed_description: Angels vs Angels A fast-paced multiplayer action shooter where angels battle angels using divine weapons in surreal, symbolic arenas. Angels vs Angels is a competitive PvP game focused on quick matches, skill-based combat, and chaotic celestial warfare. Players take control of powerful angels, each armed with unique weapons and abilities, and fight across abstract environments inspired by sacred architecture and religious symbolism. The game emphasizes immediate action, readable combat, and short match sessions — jump in, fight, and improve your skills without long waiting times. Key Features ⚔️ Fast-paced multiplayer combat Short, intense matches designed for instant action and replayability. 👼 Playable angel characters Different weapons, abilities, and movement styles to support multiple playstyles. 🏛 Stylized celestial arenas Battle inside churches, heavens, and abstract symbolic locations. 🤖 Bots & AI support Play even when online matches are quiet — no empty servers. 🔄 Active development New maps, balance updates, and gameplay improvements planned. Expect changes, improvements, and new content over time.

row.name: Minor Scale
row.detailed_description: Buggy Beats Be sure to stay on the beat or else you will end up in a sticky situation. Play through multiple levels accompanied by custom-composed music and artwork. Building Phase: Use your conducting skills to earn currency to buy even more critters with varying instruments. Each bug's specialized instrument will act differently so be sure to strategize. Wave Onslaught: Once you exit the building phase the wave phase will begin. See how well you keep the beat to attack these creepy intruders. When in doubt you can always use a powerful crescendo attack to wipe out incoming waves! Keyboard Critter Co is a student-driven company that was established in 2022 out of the Entertainment Arts and Engineering (EAE) program at the University of Utah. Our goal is to provide a fun experience to our players while also showcasing the hard work and talent of up-and-coming game developers. Our current working title, Minor Scale, is our collective graduating project. We hope you enjoy the experience and thank you for taking the time to play our game! 🐦Twitter: 🐛TikTok: 🐜Youtube: 🐝Itch.io: 🕸 Epic Games: COMING SOON! About the Game Minor Scale is a rhythm-based tower defense game with a 2D / 3D hybrid whimsical aesthetic. You will conduct a band of cute little Critters to defend their jam session from the creepy Crawlies threatening their home with the power of music. - Unique combination of rhythm and tower defense mechanics - Place critters to defeat the crawlies by playing along with the music - For lovers of rhythm games, tower defense, and cute creatures - Hit notes to earn crescendo meter - Defeat crawlies to place more critters to earn currency - Original soundtrack - Start your waves on your own time

row.name: Whisker Witchery

After being cursed by your rival, you must navigate their witch cottage all while avoiding detection by the magic creatures within. Avoid fearsome Fire Sprites who will hunt you down, or the rare Waxies, living candles who shoot balls of fire! Leap between the floating books and locate the 3 ingredients that hold the key to returning to normal! Will you be able to reach the cauldron, or will you fall prey to many dangers? row.name: Cash Dash
row.detailed_description: Cash Dash is a 2.5D fun platformer game where the player has to run, jump, slide, and crouch through various platforms in record time while attempting to collect as much money as possible. In addition, the game has moving platforms, spikes, speed runs, checkpoints and jump boost pads to help or slow down the player while trying to complete the level. At the end of each level, the player gets a completion rate which depends on the time taken to complete the level and the money collected. The game has 10 themed levels with varying levels of difficulty. All the levels were created by the crew members at nonPareil. nonPareil Institute's mission is to help adults on the autism spectrum grow towards their potential by providing work readiness training integrated with hands-on technical instruction and social engagement opportunities.
row.short_description: Run, jump, or slide though your way through ten unique levels in record time while acquiring money or tips.

row.name: Castle War
row.detailed_description: In this real time strategy game, defeat your friends by destroying their castle. The last player with their castle still standing wins! Players must manage their economy, build their base and defenses, while producing and upgrading their units. Build: -House: generates money -Forge: generates iron and upgrades your army's armor (3 different armor types: blunt, piercing, and slashing) -Pillar: generates magic and enchants targeted unit, so that they bypass enemy non-magic armor. -Barracks: recruit and upgrade soldier soldier -Archery range: recruits and upgrades archers -Foundry: recruits and upgrades canons -Wizard tower: recruits and upgrades wizards. -Defensive Tower: shoots 3 arrows at enemies in the vicinity. -Walls: blocks unit movement. -Gate: A wall that can let units go through Produce your army from a range of 4 different units: -Archer: attacks from afar with piercing damage but are more accurate at close range. -Soldier: attacks with slashing damage, have higher HP and armor and can change their weapon type to counter their opponent's armor-type -Canon: attacks from a long range causing blunt damage, effective at taking down enemy defenses. -Wizard: attacks from medium-range, causing blunt damage and can cast powerful fireballs and defensive shields at the cost of MP. Upgrade your army: -There are 3 types of armor upgrades (blunt, piercing, slashing) available to your army, try to upgrade the right ones to counter your opponent's army. -You can also level up your army's units, which will improve their attack power and max health -the cost of upgrades depends on the number of units you own.
row.short_description: In this real time strategy game, defeat your friends by destroying their castle. The last player with their castle still standing wins! Players must manage their economy, build their base and defenses, while producing and upgrading their units.

row.name: Enid
row.detailed_description: Enid is a ¾ perspective, single-player RPG with a retro feel, wherein the player collects objects and completes tasks for their fantastical friend - an anthropomorphic fire named Enid ! The core gameplay hearkens back to a nostalgic era, drawing inspiration from classic games (as well as newer indie titles) like Harvest Moon , Pikmin , Stardew Valley , Celeste , and A Short Hike . Imagine a laid-back, lo-fi exploration RPG where the player takes care of their new pal, who reveals bits and pieces of a grander and secret narrative as they help one another move forward - all this in tightly packaged, easy to play minigames! Above all, Enid is a game about exploring, collecting, solving, and progressing through manageable, bite-sized chunks of gameplay and story!
row.short_description: Help Enid stay aflame while exploring the forest and playing minigames with woodland creatures!

Your goal is to manage resources to sustain your food, oxygen, power, body temperature, and other vital resources. Attempt to translate messages from HQ to help co-ordinate a rescue. However, as you slowly come to the realization of your situation, and what its outcome will be, you can always enjoy the view. Floating Coffin is in the name. There is no good ending. row.name: TRIBE NINE
row.detailed_description: It's the year 20XX. The story takes place in Neo Tokyo, a futuristic country ruled by deadly games. Groups of teens fight in brutal life-or-death battles to reclaim their stolen dreams and freedom. Players control characters as they venture through the vibrant 'City' of Neo Tokyo, taking down formidable enemies to liberate the city. The party consists of three characters who all fight on the battlefield simultaneously. Ally units will respond to the battle accordingly, luring enemies and healing allies. When the time is right, you can even unleash a combo attack by all three party members. Each character possesses a unique personality, with various battle strategies and methods that change based on the combination of your party members. In TRIBE NINE, players progress through the story by controlling characters and exploring Neo Tokyo, encountering battles and various other events on the city streets. Along the way, tasks come in one after another, such as acquiring items from streets and treasure chests, completing puzzles and other mini-games, and fulfilling requests from the town's residents. Each playable character has their unique characteristics, which is reflected in their skills and actions, so you can experience various playstyles depending on the character. In addition to leveling up your characters, you also have the freedom to select which stats to boost and what equipment to use. You could even try building a healer as an attacker! There are plenty of possibilities, so you can experiment with creating your own original build! New main stories and cities will be added to TRIBE NINE through updates. Look forward to the ever-unfolding adventure of TRIBE NINE for free! (in-game purchases available)
row.short_description: Defy the madness. Brutal Action RPG 'TRIBE NINE' Set in the nation of Neo Tokyo, where absolute madness rules. Here, teens face life-or-death battles, constantly resisting the harsh and unjust world—all in pursuit of reclaiming their lost freedom and dreams.

row.name: Highrise Guardian
row.detailed_description: ARENA ABOVE THE SKYLINE: Boots on the ground while firing above the cloud! Highrise Guardian is a fast-paced Online Area Retro FPS. Gear up with weapons of your choice, Form the fighting flow with a selection of abilities and perks, and dominate your enemies with map resource control. Make your battle style like arts to fulfill your Anime gunslinger fantasies. BUILD A HERO OF YOUR OWN In Highrise Guardian, You can select freely select 3 Weapons, 2 Active ABilites, and 2 Passive Perks from the area to create your own anime gunslinger. WEAPONS: Conveniently Assassinate Select from Rowdy SMGs, Ruthless Long-range Laser Rifles, Rampant Rocket Launchers, and Shotguns that blow holes in your face. Whether you want to be a long-range sharpshooter or a close-quarter Gun-Kata master, you will find your fancy way to dominate your enemies in style. Weapon List: Phased Plasma 40W: Bolt Action heavy hit energy beam weapon. Slow fire rate. Sheriff 800: Lever Action Rifle loaded with 12G buck shot. Damage scaled by the number of fragments collided with enemies. Denzel-10: Full-Auto high fire rate nail projectile shooting weapon. Projectiles take travel time to land on enemies. TubeScreamer-10: Classic Rocket Launcher with mid level fire rate. Rockets may knock back players and enemies to force position displacement. Wick’s Sidekick: Semi-Auto magic pistol that has infinite ammo. Low damage output. ACTIVE ABILITIES: Be the First to Strike Extra Agilities, Stealty Infiltration, Intel Scouting, and Control Distortion, Select the active abilities to put yourself on the high ground in the fight you initiated. Ability List: Wind Rush: Quick dashing to the front for a small distant. Optic Phase: Shift into full invisible for 3 seconds. Thermal Sight: Detect nearby enemies in any condition. Magnetic Intervention: Reverse enemies' camera control input. PASSIVE PERKS: Born With Talents Under Pressure, Pinned down? No Stress! The Perks provides you with a passive bonus to help you overcome disadvantaged situations and outplay your enemies. Perk List Stalker: Strafing speed increase to 150% under the battle. Berserk: Receiving bonus of output damage scaled by losing HP. Favor of Battle: Regenerate 50% of Total HP after elimination. Hesitation is death: Deal 130% to enemies by default, dealing 10% less damage to enemy after receiving damage. MAP DESIGN: Higher than the rooftop and Wider than the canal In Highrise Guardian, you will be assigned to one of the two fractions, Operators and Heisters, to create your class of a Hero and intensely fight each other over the rooftop of the bright city downtown and overcast canal ports. The maps are designed for creative interaction and dynamic combat, and emphasizes vertical engagement, shifting gun-sight aligning, and fast position change. The maps also provide portals and jump pads for flanking and quick engagement. Most importantly, be creative and get yourself on the move. RESOURCES: Hotspot to Contend Securing high value pickables with map control and vantage point hold! Crush your enemies not only with your gun skills but also the resource dominiation.
row.short_description: Boots on the ground while firing above the cloud! Highrise Guardian is an Arena FPS. Gear up with weapons of your choice, Form the fighting flow with a selection of abilities and perks, dominate your enemies with map control, and make an art-like battle style to become the Anime gunslinger.

row.name: ソードコレクター
row.detailed_description: Give me the memory. Give me that sword-- The powerful sword embodies the boss in order to maximize its own power. Beat him and take his abilities. Level up, learn the arts, and challenge the bosses. Bosses are basically clad in super armor and will not stagger, but if you keep hitting them, they can armor break. If the boss is in armor break, you can hit him with combos until his attack is interrupted. Aim aggressively! Controls Common controls Option button: Open menu While delivering a sword Press X to avoid ・・・・・ ✕ button・・・・・ speak, open treasure chests, etc. Press △ button ・・・・・ to attack normally. Shift to sword drawing state. R1 button・・・・・ to switch to sword drawing state. R2 button ・・・・・ jumps. Press and hold L1 button + 0 or □ or △ ・・・ Arts. Shift to sword drawing state. Use the cross key ・・・・・ set item. While drawing the sword Press X. Step to ・・・・・ Press X twice for emergency evasion Press X to guard ・・・・・ △ button ・・・・・ Normal attack □ button ・・・・・ Sword Arts R1 button・・・・・ Sword state R2 button・・・・・ jumps R3 button・・・・・ awakening L1 button long press + 0 or □ or △ - Arts Use the cross key ・・・・・ to use the set item. Shift to natto state. There are four gauges: HP gauge, SP gauge, MP gauge, and Stamina gauge. HP gauge The green gauge in the center of the screen. When it reaches 0, the game is over, so use recovery items to prevent it from reaching 0. SP Gauge This gauge looks like a fireball next to the HP gauge. Pressing the □ button during a sword draw will use 33% of the SP gauge to use Sword Arts. Sword Arts summons a boss to attack. Since they can be activated independently of your actions, you can use them to connect combos or to break the deadlock in a pinch. Its performance changes depending on the sword you have equipped. You can also awaken it by pressing the R3 button at 100%. While awakened, you will always be in Super Armor and your Stamina and MP will not decrease. In addition, the number of normal attacks will increase to 6, and by pressing the △ button, you can perform a secret secret move. Just keep on hitting him! Stamina Gauge It is the yellow gauge in the lower right corner. It is consumed when a normal attack, step, emergency evasion, or guard succeeds. It automatically recovers when you are not taking any of the above four actions. If you want to continue attacking, use Arts to recover during that time. MP Gauge This is the pink gauge in the lower right corner. It is consumed when using Arts. Normal attacks alone consume a large amount of stamina, so mix your attacks with arts. Hit the target with a normal attack. MP can be recovered by using items. Normal attacks consume stamina and can be performed up to five times in a row. You can cancel from a normal attack to an art to attack. You can cancel from normal attack and arts to step, and from step to normal attack and arts.
