row.name: Pincrediball
row.detailed_description: Pincrediball is a fun twist on the pinball game genre. You design the Pinball machine, and the Automata Pinball Wizard follows a 'Playbook' to play your design. Achieve High Scores and earn medals to advance levels. How to play Think of a 'Machine' as a 'World' with stages (or 'levels'). At each level you unlock new components to add to the Pinball machine. Place these components in the right spots on the machine, and hit 'Run Playbook' to see what score it gets you. With some tiny spoilers, here's one way to handle the Tutorial Machine's final stage: Every playbook must end by draining the ball (at the bottom of the machine) within the given time limit. If you succeed, your score will count and gets you a bronze, silver, or even gold medal if you cross a certain target. At least bronze is needed to advance a level. Going for silver and gold after bronze? Or advance to the next level? It's your choice! And you could also go back to go full completionist on a level!! What is included? Pincrediball has many features, including (but not limited to): A Tutorial Machine (a 'world') with several levels to play. Target scores (bronze, silver, gold) and a progression system, based on high scores. A multi-multi-multi-ball 'Stress Test' mode to test your setup, or just for fun! The trailer showcases all these features as well as many others. About the Development This game was created as a solo sabbatical project. You can read about the full development history on the website's devlog, and even view the source code (written for the Godot 4 engine).
row.short_description: The Automata Pinball Wizard game! YOU design the machine and the Automata Pinball Wizard plays it to get a High Score. Earn medals to advance levels and build ever more extensive machines!

row.name: Little Keepers
row.detailed_description: Little Keepers is an indie chaotic couch-coop tower defense that will put your friendship to test! Mom has been doing experiments in our garden and now the plants are attacking us! As the Little Keepers, you’ll be given the chance to gather resources, build your defenses and create the best strategy to defend your home from spooky creatures. You and your partner in crime, hand in hand against cute spooky hordes... Good Ol’ Couch Coop. Collect materials throughout the map and choose between metal or wood to give life to your creations! BUT BEWARE, some resources are too heavy to carry alone… the two of you must team up to carry them. Enjoy a balanced system with multiple options to complete levels and a difficulty curve worthy of the best strategists. In Little Keepers each game is different, and each strategy is as unique as its creator. It won't matter if you and your buddy work together as synchronized as a Swiss clock... CHAOS IS INEVITABLE! (But it's also funny so enjoy!) Step into a cute & spooky wonderworld and face together the monsters that shelter the forest. For the loners… you are not alone! Little AI will be by your side in good and bad (but mostly good, really, it’s extremely efficient!)
row.short_description: What are friends for if not to defend each other from mutant plants that want to hurt you? Build your enemies, destroy your defenses and restore chaos in the garden! ... Wait, it was the other way around.

row.name: Piano at 5 a.m.
row.detailed_description: RECOMMEND! About the Game Introduction . In the early hours of the morning, around 5 a.m., there is sometimes a thick fog. In addition, there is a story about people who went out on a foggy day and never came back. People are not sure if this is true or not. However, most people in this town do not go out on foggy mornings. She, who lives in a log house in the mountains, loved such fog. On foggy mornings, she always goes for a walk. But she doesn't really know why she likes fog. So, although she likes fog, she does not like foggy mornings.　 She wanders around in the fog as if she is attracted and driven by something she does not understand. Character . The main character is a girl who likes fog. She lives with her family in a log cabin in the mountains. She loves this house and the fog, where she has lived since she was a child, as much as she loves the smell of the trees, the garden with its small flowers, and the forest she can see from her window. But soon she will be moving out of this house. She doesn't want to forget the time she spent here - she thinks as she walks through the fog. System . Wandering through the fog until 8 a.m. 'Piano at 5 a.m.' is a text adventure game. A girl leaves her house at 5 a.m. and encounters various things in the fog, and she always chooses one of two options to proceed. Depending on the choice, the four values of 'Drowsiness,' 'Thirst,' 'Madness,' and 'Charge' will be increased or decreased. If you can make a choice so that these four do not reach their maximum limit and reach 8:00 a.m., the story will progress. Staff . Planning, Production, Scenario : Kazuhide Oka Event Planning : Aoki Character Design / Main Visual : fina Music : Kano
row.short_description: 'Piano at 5 a.m.' is a short text adventure game. A girl who is the main character wanders in a fog forest while adjusting the four factors of 'drowsiness,' 'thirst,' 'madness,' and 'recharge,' which increase or decrease depending on the choices she makes.

row.name: Medusa VR
row.detailed_description: A scene from an original virtual reality story by Tomis Fras. Medusa is a story about two Croatian actors, adapting to a rapidly changing industry. From acting in plays at the Croatian National Theatre to acting in motion capture suits for a major Hollywood studio. They explore themes of artistic integrity, cultural identity and learning to cope with uncertainty. In this 10 minute Room-scale VR experience, you’ll join them for a conversation over coffee at the canals of ‘A-Studios’. This piece is a solo-devoloped passion project - fully voiced and mocaped in Croatian with English subtitles. Context: this is a proof of concept for a full three Act Medusa VR Film - this scene is from Act 2 Scene 5 of Medusa. Should you be interested in ever seeing the full VR film come to life, feel free to comment in the reviews. To find out more about the behind-the-scenes of Medusa VR or see more of my work visit my website.
row.short_description: Medusa, the Croatian word for jellyfish. Medusa VR is 10 minute solo-developed VR film. Join Russel and Zlatan - two Croatian actors in Califonia for a coffee by the canal as they discuss grief, change and loss. When on strange shores, would you swim with Medusas?

row.name: It Belongs in a Museum
row.detailed_description: Run, don’t walk like an Egyptian to your nearest Steam store and check out It Belongs in a Museum! put on your virtual reality headset and join a secret organization that has been around for thousands of years, in a story that wouldn't sell out a block buster movie, but is JUST good enough for VR! Your task is simple: take your ample goddess companion into battle across five stages listening to her recall the story while destroying monsters with an array of weapons. Look for sparkly treasure strewn across large, small, and procedural dungeons to satisfy your need to buy much needed guns. Marvel at the lack of consistency in story telling as the plot unfolds leaving you with more questions than answers! And when all of that is finished, you can extend your gameplay experience by repeating the stages in a similar fashion to a hamster in a wheel for the sole purpose of buying virtual versions of REAL artifacts from the skeleton dealer to fill up your museum… to scratch that “I need to collect something….” Itch! So, act now! Copies are limited…. Wait… digital games aren’t limited, are they? OK screw it I’m too old for this. Features: - Multiple weapons: pistols, SMGs, assault rifles, shotguns, grenades, bow and sniper! - Enough Unity store assets flipped you’ll think it’s a gymnastics tournament! - Foul mouthed NPCs that keep it PG-13! - A “story” written in the span of weeks when time allowed, loosely based on Akkadian/ Mesopotamian mythology with a large order of plot holes and logical fallacies! - Smooth motion with no teleporting! - snap and smooth turning! - Full body IK now with glitchy arms and hands! - slow time just to make shooting look cool! now cool shooting in slow Mo does more damage! - Companion fully voiced by a REAL actress and other NPCs voiced by REAL AI! - Inconsistent pacing and level design because sometimes I just thought: “Not realistic, but it looks cool!” - Various types of enemies from skeletons, zombies, and mummies… OH MY! - Climbing on various surfaces such as walls, pyramids, and …..stairs! (Achievements not yet included. Side effects may include headache, fever, runny nose, nausea, lack of ambition, weight gain, indigestion, and priapism. Consult your doctor if you have two or more of these symptoms lasting longer than 4 hours.) In all seriousness, Thank you for reading to the end. I enjoyed putting this game together and I hope that you enjoy playing it. - CoffeeSerpent
row.short_description: It Belongs in a Museum is a Rogue-lite, treasure hunting, artifact collection VR story game. Join a shadow organization and help its weakened, resurrected goddess search for magic treasures to undo the curse they unleashed in procedural dungeons, tombs, lost cities, and ancient ruins.

row.name: The Unfallens: Awakening
row.detailed_description: 'The Unfallens: Awakening' is a soul-like action-packed boss battle game where you play as a surviving member of the 'Unfallens' civilization using a ghost scythe to challenge the merciless guardians BOSS. Narrative Background A shattered world awaits you as you return home from your exile in the underground. The once-thriving civilization of the Unfallens now lies in ruins, with only ruthless guardians left to attack you. Journey through the remains of this fallen civilization, using your skills to overcome intense boss battles and uncover the truth behind the devastation. Awaken your true power, and reclaim what was lost. Challenging Action Combat The game's action combat is challenging, requiring you to master the distance of different attack movements, use dodges to correctly respond to the rich moves of the boss, and survive under the formidable enemy. Satisfying Combat Feel Feel the solid sense of the soul scythe hitting the enemy, and participate in intense combat through smooth animations, realistic sound effects, visual effects, screen shaking, and other methods. Full Support for Controllers and Keyboard and Mouse You can choose any control method suitable for you to play. Whether you prefer a keyboard and mouse or a controller, you can find your play style. Gorgeous Game Graphics The game uses high-quality graphics effects to create a unique atmosphere and characters full of details. Abuot the developers Floatonic Studio, a team of talented student developers, created 'The Unfallens: Awakening' over six months. Three students from the University of Utah led the development effort, while two students from the Berklee College of Music contributed to the game's immersive audio experience. Despite its compact content, the developers aimed to provide players with the best quality game featuring a unique and challenging boss battle experience. Through their hard work and collaboration, the team has brought this action-packed game to life for players to enjoy.
row.short_description: Returning from exile underground, a shattered world awaits you. The civilization of Unfallens lies in ruins. The ruthless guardian waits to attack. Journey through remains. Awaken your true power. Reclaim what was lost. Experience challenging action boss battles in this compact, high-quality game.

row.name: Genting Party
row.detailed_description: There's an island, surrounded by clouds with a pleasing landscape. But also it's a hub for fantastic exciting adventures. 【Loads of Games - Continually Updated】 Play all sorts of VR games with your pals - competitive, adventurous, team-based, chill - there's something for everyone. And we're adding more all the time! Genting Zuma Blast those colored orbs with your space gun, rookie astronaut. As you level up, things get tougher! Zombie Cave Enter the deadly cave with your team, and fight off the cheeky zombies that interrupt your adventure. Homeland Defenser As the village's last line of defense, protect your home from invaders with powerful weapons. High Noon A Western shootout - new sheriffs on the scene, gunslingers going rogue. Time for a duel in the Wild West! Heroes Unleashed Intense battles in dangerous settings. Defeat the boss in the allotted time, power up by eliminating smaller enemies, and repelling other players. Bonfire Campsite Experience the warmth and romance of a camping trip under the starry sky. Perfect for a game of Werewolf! Virus Clash Shoot those viruses with your trusty bow, send them fleeing. A fun mix of offense and defense on a colorful battlefield, full of action and fun! 【Engage in delightful social interactions, nurture pets, and build your dream home】 Have a blast socializing and creating your world in Genting Party! Socializing in the Lobby The cloud island is the perfect place to make friends, chat, and have fun. A simple high five is all it takes to add someone as a friend. Don't forget to take a group photo with the in-game camera! Lobby Mini-Games Play lots of fun games in the hall - basketball, whack-a-mole, cosmic slingshot, hoop toss, darts, dragon dance, and many more. Twice the fun with friends! Pets Experience the joy of raising pets in the cloud. Pets in Cloud Party can be taken anywhere, cared for, and nurtured into your own unique pet! Home We provide a customizable private space where you can place a wide variety of furniture and decorations, cultivate crops, and create a home that truly represents your style and tastes! -Outfits Express yourself with our colorful outfits. From cool to cute to quirky, make a stunning statement in Genting Party!
row.short_description: Genting Party is a VR social hub， loaded with a variety of free VR games, continually updated and ever-expanding!

row.name: 珍珠梦Pearl Dream
row.detailed_description: This is an AVG game with an early Lovecraftian style. You will play as a thief trapped under the castle, trying to escape through exploration and mystery solving. Process lasts about 30 minutes and has more than 1 ending. Independent development. From scripts to the production of art and music assets all by myself. Hope to present a deeper story within a shorter process.
row.short_description: Cthulhu style AVG. Main gameplay is exploration and selection.
row.notes: Death, Horrible creature

row.name: Every Letter
row.detailed_description: With your typewriter, write letters on behalf of others, and transform their sentiments into words in this cozy single-player letter writing game. Experience the first day of your new job as a letter writer, typing freely on your typewriter. Receive requests from clients and turn their messages and feelings into letters, from casual hellos to love letters and theater scripts. As you write, uncover intertwining stories told across multiple clients’ requests, grow accustomed to the quirks of a typewriter, and find your own meaning to letter writing. Key Features A narrative-driven, single-player game with a charming cast of characters Over a dozen possible letter requests with side stories spanning multiple requests Beautiful hand drawn art A lovingly detailed typewriter, down to the satisfying clicks and clacks (Content warning: written mention of death and grief, written mentions of food) Thanks to XtlusArt, the Locasaurus team, Lucie Teulières, Sasha Boucheron, Sarah Deville, Anabel Morales, Ōkami, Hasanh, Ayliz Yıldız, Haigang Zhou, Rafaela Fernandes, and Nhung Tran for their hard work helping make Every Letter!
row.short_description: Write letters with your typewriter on behalf of others in this cozy single-player game. Compose everything from simple hellos to theater scripts and love letters, express each client’s emotions, and find your own meaning to letter writing.

row.name: Wizardry Variants Daphne
row.detailed_description: Wizardry Variants Daphne carries on the lineage of the classic RPG series, Wizardry. The portal to the labyrinth of despair, where even destruction is pleasure, has opened once again. ■ Story Once every 100 years, the Abyss opens. It is a curse of death that consumes the continent. A Warlock who coveted Death, devoured people and animals and enveloped the world in despair. Inheriting the power to seal the Abyss over generations, kings have continued to protect the kingdom from its curse. But now, the king has vanished, and the world is being consumed by death, moment by moment. Resistance itself is meaningless. There is naught but to perish. ■ Adventure with allies Experience an adventure of your very own with unique allies based on combinations of classes and races. ■ Difficulty with a bite Perilous traps and mighty foes await in the dungeon. Take on a high difficulty that only Wizardry can offer. ■ Cadre of renowned creators Main Character Design: Yusuke Kozaki Manga artist and illustrator; in addition to writing manga, he also does design work for anime and games, and is well known for the fine touches in his character designs. Boss Monster Design: Katsuya Terada His work, centered on manga and illustration, includes character designs video games and movies, as well as poster for theater productions. Sound: Hitoshi Sakimoto Has composed for more than 130 game titles of all genres. With their rich sound and epic scale, his scores have received tremendous support not only in Japan, but also from overseas. ■ Magnificent cast brings the fully-voiced scenario to life [English Voice Actors] Lulunarde: Morgan Cambs Pulgritte: Dev Joshi Dylanhardt: Doug Cockle Elmon: Laurence Bouvard Vernant: Christopher Ragland Pickerel: Alex Capon Leaufonde: Garrick Hagon Shagtis of Sorrow: Jay Rincon - Other Voice Actors, etc. - Beth Robb Adams, Mike Bodie, Sarah Borges, Davis Brooks, Shin-Fei Chen, Doug Cockle, Clare Corbett, Arlene Decker, Sarah Galbraith, Garrick Hagon, Arina Ii, Jules de Jongh, Dev Joshi, Samantha Kamras, Rae Lim,Elsie Lovelock, Meaghan Martin, Gianni Matragrano, Joseph May, Alexander McMorran, Eric Meyers, Sarah Pitard, Christopher Ragland, Matt Reeves, Jay Rincon, Cecily Bednar Schmidt, Kerry Shale, Martin T Sherman, Adam Sims, Ina Marie Smith, Colin Stinton, Alex Vincent, Alexandra Vincent, Glenn Wrage -- Other appearances (in alphabetical order) [Japanese Voice Actors] Lulunarde: Inori Minase Pulgritte: Yui Ishikawa Dylanhardt: Chikahiro Kobayashi Elmon: Satomi Korogi Vernant: Yoshimasa Hosoya Pickerel: Junya Enoki Leaufonde: Takaya Hashi Shagtis of Sorrow: Takehito Koyasu - Other Voice Actors, etc. - Yutaka Aoyama, Masumi Asano, Koji Ishii, Maaya Uchida, Yu Kobayashi, Tetsuo Komura, Jiro Saito, Yu Shimamura, Yoko Soumi, Shinya Takahashi, Hiroki Takahashi, Yumi Toma, Yuichi Nakamura, Romi Park, Fairouz Ai, Shinshu Fuji, Takanori Hoshino, Anna Yamaki, Aoi Yuki -- Other appearances (in Japanese alphabetical order) ■What is Wizardry? Wizardry is a computer role-playing game released in the United States in 1981 with elements such as party organizing, labyrinth exploration, monster fighting, and character development having such a tremendous impact on the various RPGs that followed, that it is often referred to as the origin of RPGs. Numerous sequels have been released, and nearly 40 years after its release, it remains a timeless masterpiece that enjoys strong popularity around the world.
row.short_description: 3D Dungeon RPG The portal of despair opens again. The labyrinth calls you to destruction. Revel in the endless dangers, relish the risk, devour the rewards. Savor the risk.

row.name: Deserted Island
row.detailed_description: You and your friends will be stranded on a deserted island, with nothing but your fists and each other. Gather some materials, craft weapons, build buildings and protect yourself and your mates from the creatures of the island.
row.short_description: stranded on a island with friends, what will be your adventure?

row.name: Wyvia: Prologue
row.detailed_description: In this prologue to the game you fill the shoes of a fresh recruit of the Mercenaries. Get your footing in the land of Wyvia and begin to unravel the mystery of the where the Wyverns have gone. Your mission is simple, find the wyverns, uncover the source of the invasion, and discover your role in saving Wyvia. Prologue Features 2 open world areas 11 locations 4 classes 2 bosses 12 enemies 21 accessories Wyvia features fun and simple combat that feels good to utilize! Whack Goopies with a huge axe or fire away with screen clearing abilities! Mix and match skills between 4 (11 in the full game) distinct classes, allocate points into stats and skills, and create a character that's really your own! Explore a variety of locations from plains, deep caves, spooky forests, and frozen wastes as you struggle against the invasion of monsters in your world and find the source of their intrusion. Use the power of Wyverns to fly, gain new abilities, augment your combat prowess and explore the world around you.
row.short_description: Wyvia is an open world 3D action RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Save your world from a monstrous invasion. Choose from 4 unique classes, and customize them with a robust cross-class skill system. Craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Explore dungeons full of enemies, and defeat terrifying bosses!

row.name: Duel Timers
row.detailed_description: Duel Timers is a local multiplayer FPS Platformer. Fight against a friend with On-the-Couch Local Multiplayer or through Steam Remote Play (All multiplayer requires a Bluetooth Gamepad). Jump from platform to platform on a vertical arena to avoid enemy players and the impending void! Master Jump Charging, Quick Falling, and Double Jumping to maximize your movement. Collect Ammo Boxes and Med Kits to keep the fight going! Activate Power-Ups to annoy your friends or give yourself an advantage! Duel Timers is a unique take on two classic genres! Important Note: Duel Timers requires both a Controller and Keyboard and Mouse. Player 1 will always play on Keyboard, and Player 2 will always play on Controller. This also applies for players using Remote Play Together. Remote Play Together also works across platforms, but a controller is still needed for Player 2, as is the case for all Remote Play Together games with multiple independent players.
row.short_description: Duel Timers is a split screen, local multiplayer FPS platformer. Choose your Weapon and Power-Up and begin the fight! On a vertical map, jump from tile to tile to get to or away from the enemy, or to collect ammo and health!

row.name: illum
row.detailed_description: illum welcomes you to a mystical 3D third-person adventure game, where you embark on a quest to illuminate a dormant kingdom using the power of light. AWAKEN THE SLEEPING KINGDOM Form heartwarming bonds with your light friend as you journey together to connect light gems and awaken the slumbering world of Illum. EXPLORE A POETIC, EXPANSIVE WORLD Discover the beauty and narratives embedded in Illum's atmospheric world, as you unravel its secrets of the world. EXPERIENCE A VISUALLY STUNNING AND EMOTIONAL JOURNEY Delve into an immersive and poignant adventure that weaves together striking visuals, immersive audio, and atmospheric gameplay to create a truly memorable experience. Illum was created as part of CTIN 532: Interactive Design and Production I at the University of Southern California by main developers Elsa Liu and Tianyue Gu, with audio by Raphael Almeida, Richard Wang, Eduardo Resende, and Alexander 'Gooch' Duong. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website, linked to the right.
row.short_description: Embark on a heartwarming journey with your little light friend to solve puzzles and bring light to the mystical realm of Illum.

row.detailed_description: QMotion is a tool that help you control your VRM models as much as you want. It supports ARKit face capture, Noitom motion capture, and Rokoko motion capture. Of course, the operation of QMotion is very simple, and the system occupancy is very low. Contact information: Discord: Email: qpmotion@outlook.com
row.short_description: QMotion is a tool that help you control your VRM models as much as you want. It supports ARKit face capture, Noitom motion capture, and Rokoko motion capture. Of course, the operation of QMotion is very simple, and the system occupancy is very low.

row.name: Ashes to Ashes
row.detailed_description: Hex, dash, and blast your way through the mystical canyons of Gloam Country. Seek your undead revenge against the Red Wake gang for their betrayal and burying you six feet under. Discover the lore of the land through echoes of spirits long passed to assemble and remember your past. Standoff against dangerous gunslingers and teach them the meaning of fear. Key Features Harness the power of hexes to combine the elements of flame, frost, and quake to make any environment your personal playground of destruction. Aim for precise headshots to clear waves of bandits quickly before they’re able to shoot back or toss dangerous hex grenades. Travel through diverse settings to hunt down key members of the Red Wake gang in the form of epic boss battles. Seek breathtaking vistas to give respite from the onslaught of bullets. Immerse yourself in our epic original soundtrack by the talented Collin Anderson.
row.short_description: Shoot your way to vengeance as the infamous undead gunslinger Quinn del Ramo. In this weird wild west, experience a story-driven action-packed adventure with bullets, magic, and betrayal.
row.notes: Cartoon violence, gunslinging, some swearing

row.name: Quest for the Golden Candelabra
row.detailed_description: Quest for the Golden Candelabra is a 2D turn-based tactics game based on the rules of PF2E, the second edition of a powerful tabletop OGL ruleset. You lead a group of four colorful characters through a series of encounters, fighting against monsters, acquiring loot and eventually -- hopefully -- recovering the ancient artifact that's the object of your quest. For an experienced player of tabletop roleplaying games, the entire game takes about 40 minutes to play through, from beginning to end. Five difficult encounters in varied locations against varied monsters Four interesting characters to play as (an honorable orc fighter, a silent rogue, a well-spoken sorcerer, and an excitable cleric) A complex OGL-based rule system which makes for strong strategic gameplay Cut straight into the gameplay This game is a cinematic experience, where you fight one combat encounter after another, and these fights are interspersed only with (voiced!) cinematic cutscenes. The game doesn't waste your time: animations are lightning fast, cutscenes skippable, and you can really focus on the engaging combat experience. Powerful rule system Each turn, you get three actions to spend on moving, attacking, casting spells, taking combat maneuvers, drinking potions and defensive or other actions. You can preview the effects and success probability of all actions before you commit and weigh your options. All combat encounters are balanced but difficult: To win the game reliably and consistently, you will need to make use of almost all of your options. Story of the Dawnsbury Four Experience the first steps of an up-and-coming party of young adventurers as they take on their first quest and attempt to recover an artifact that has once protected their beloved home town. A taste of Dawnsbury Days This game is greatly expanded upon in the follow-up game, Dawnsbury Days, which contains the content from Quest for the Golden Candelabra but also allows you to create and customize your own characters, enhances art and rules fidelity and otherwise greatly improves upon this game, and most importantly, adds additional combat encounters and additional character levels. You don't need to play this game first. Dawnsbury Days contains the full story that's contained in this game.
row.short_description: Lead a group of childhood friends in a series of difficult encounters played under the rules of PF2E, the second edition of a powerful tabletop OGL ruleset.

row.name: G.O.M.P!
row.detailed_description: Howdy y'all! Welcome to G.O.M.P! Also called Get Off My Property, ya hear? This is the game where you play as a tough-as-nails redneck defending your farm from an endless swarm of invaders who are trying to steal your food. Grab your trusty weapon and get ready for some fast-paced action-packed gameplay that'll test your shooting skills and survival instincts. Whether you're playing solo or with your buddies, G.O.M.P! offers a rootin' tootin' good time that'll keep you on the edge of your seat. Compete against your friends to see who can rack up the highest score and become the ultimate redneck defender. But be warned, each wave of invaders gets harder and harder to defeat, so you'll need to stay on your toes and be ready for anything. With each game session lasting between 10-15 minutes, G.O.M.P! is perfect for a quick gaming break or a marathon session. So what are you waiting for? It's time to defend your farm and show those pesky invaders who's boss! Get G.O.M.P! today and get ready to blast your way through wave after wave of enemies. Yeehaw!
row.short_description: G.O.M.P! is an action-packed game where you defend your farm from invaders. Compete with friends and survive wave after wave of enemies. Yeehaw!

row.name: Stickman and the sword of legends
row.detailed_description: Stickman needs to get the Sword of Legends to be able to leave his planet that is about to explode.You need to collect 3 boxes to pass each level , you can walk with WASD jump with space attack with the mouse and dash with Q , you can also change the camera angle with TAB.You can play 4 different levels , but they are not in their final form, some of them just close the game others are connected . This game was first released in itch.io as a collage project in the university(FUMEC) and this version was made for the School of Public Management, Communication and Tourism to obtain a Bachelor degree in Game Design. The itch,io version was completely created by me Felipe Ananias aka derefepo and the steam version was made with the help of some friends , that were responsable for the 2D art and the Steam art.
row.short_description: Stickman needs to get the Sword of Legends to be able to leave his planet that is about to explode.

row.name: Section Gamma
row.detailed_description: We're lost without you! Welcome to Section Gamma , a turn-based strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world where a meteorite impact has left the Earth in ruins. As a commander, you must lead your faction in a fierce battle for dominance over the valuable energy crystals discovered in Section Gamma. With limited resources and an uncertain future, you must make strategic decisions to upgrade your troops, unlock new technologies, and mine the valuable crystals to secure your place as the dominant faction in this world. But be warned, your opponents are just as determined to succeed as you are, and you'll need to stay one step ahead to emerge victorious. With turn-based action and strategy gameplay, Section Gamma offers an immersive and challenging experience for players. Whether you choose to go solo or team up with others, you'll need to use all of your cunning and tactical skills to outmaneuver your opponents and emerge as the ultimate victor. So what are you waiting for? Join the battle for dominance in Section Gamma today and prove that you have what it takes to lead your faction to victory!
row.short_description: Section Gamma is a turn-based strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world for 1-4 players. It combines classic RTS elements with the strategic depth of chess. Play an exciting single-player campaign or fight alongside friends in multiplayer matches.
row.notes: This game depicts a fictional war between factions in a sci-fi setting.

row.name: Genjiro: Samurai Defense
row.detailed_description: A Samurai Hack & Slash, Roguelike, City Defense Game! Upgrade your skills and defend the city from waves of incoming enemies. For how long can you hold them off? Each character has 3 Skills + Dodge (L-Shift, Space) and Block (Right click, Reduces incoming damage by 60%) Playable characters : Samurai , Onna-musha Ninja and Monk characters will be released in future updates. *please report any bug you found in the game to the email in 'Credit' Tab in main menu*
row.short_description: A Samurai Hack & Slash, Roguelike, City Defense Game! Upgrade your skills and defend the city from waves of incoming enemies. For how long can you hold them off?

row.detailed_description: It is challenging to come up with an appropriate introduction for this game, but if it's okay, I can quote the storyline of the game within the game. 'Leaving all the uncertainties behind, you have to perform significant or insignificant tasks from here on out. Congratulations on being hired safely in this place...' Gameplay? W,A,S,D and mouse click. F key and mouse scroll somecases. Check out this quick and easy mystery game that only takes 10-20 minutes to finish! Game features? ■ A first-person walking simulator with pixel graphics ■ Glitches and mysteries, enjoyable and important tasks at a hotel ■ Sandwiches are not included in the game.
row.short_description: The last scenery you faced was a quite unfamiliar hotel office. Leaving all the uncertainties behind, you have to perform significant or insignificant tasks from here on out. -256 is a pixel graphics first-person mystery hotel walking simulator.

row.name: Steam Engine Simulator
row.detailed_description: On January 21, 2023, AngeTheGreat released a video called 'Simulating a Steam Engine with C++' which documented the creation of a simple steam engine simulation. This is that simulation now made into a simple game! Enjoy operating and listening to your own miniature virtual steam engine.
row.short_description: The Steam Engine Simulator shown on AngeTheGreat's YouTube channel.

row.name: The Sinking of the Dream Chaser
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the post-apocalyptic world of 'The Sinking of the Dream Chaser'! This 2D point-and-click adventure game takes you on a journey alongside Led, a servant robot with a mysterious past and a dire need for answers. As the game begins, you find Led awakening in the stern of the ship named Dream Chaser. However, something is terribly wrong. Led discovers that he is broken and malfunctioning, and his memory drives have been corrupted. Lost and confused he needs to unravel the enigma that surrounds him. In 'The Sinking of the Dream Chaser', you will embark on a quest to uncover the truth behind Led's existence, the fate of the ship, and the whereabouts of his master. The game features: Engaging Point-and-Click Gameplay: Experience the classic point-and-click mechanics as you interact with the environment, solve puzzles, and progress through the story. Enigmatic Storyline: Dive deep into an intriguing and mysterious narrative to uncover the truth. Stunning 2D Visuals: Immerse yourself in a beautifully hand-drawn world, filled with intricate details and atmospheric settings. Rich and Dynamic Soundtrack: Enjoy an original musical score that enhances the immersive atmosphere of the game. Join Led on his extraordinary adventure and become part of a compelling tale filled with twists, revelations, and a captivating world waiting to be explored. Will you be able to piece together the fragments of Led's past and unveil the secrets hidden within the ship? The answers lie in your hands.
row.short_description: Servant robot Led reboots in the stern of the ship Dream Chaser, only to find he's broken and malfunctioning. His memory drives have been corrupted. He has no idea what's going on. And he needs your help to find out what happened to himself, the ship, and to his master.

row.name: Airship
row.detailed_description: Airship is an open platform for playing multiplayer indie games. BedWars 2 BedWars 2 is currently in early testing! Why did we make BedWars 2 on Airship? Free kits (no 70%+ tax) Much more advanced anticheat Better networking to improve combat responsiveness Modern game engine for more powerful creator tools Better servers (with region control!) A clean slate for a fresh BedWars experience Become a Developer We make multiplayer easy with Unity Engine and TypeScript. The Client & API is even open source! Check out our website for details on how to create a game.
row.short_description: Airship is a multiplayer game platform in early development! Play BedWars 2 and other indie games.
row.notes: This platform includes user-generated games, some of which may feature violence or strong language.

row.name: Vivian Carmine
row.detailed_description: Vivian Carmine is an anime style visual novel featuring point and click gameplay. Something has been detected in this world which should not be here. Play as Vivian, an interdimensional investigator, and her partner Nicholas, to figure out the source of the disturbance and fix it. Meet the duo: Vivian: A young, mildly inexperienced, but competent investigator dedicated to doing what she must to ensure order between the worlds is kept. Nicholas: Vivian's badge and partner. The more experienced of the two, he is dedicated to assisting Vivian in any way he can. Features: Point and click gameplay Anime-style graphics Explore the town, ask questions, and see what information you can gather!
row.short_description: In an average town somewhere in America, a disturbance has been felt. Vivian Carmine and her badge, Nicholas, have come from the Gap Between Worlds to investigate.
row.notes: - Strong language - Violence - Gore

row.name: LaborSurviveManual
row.detailed_description: Go forward, and survive to the end. Defeat to attack the enemy, the choice and upgrade your weapon. Experience the pure sense of mowing frank experience combined with a variety of weapons.
row.short_description: 2D pixel TPS game, Through the keyboard control move and attack, Defeat the enemy gain experience to upgrade and strengthen weapons to live as much as possible.

row.name: Xenosis
row.detailed_description: Xenosis is a thrilling metroidvania where you traverse an ancient temple that has been overrun by alien creatures. Your only hope for survival is to explore the temple and find a way to escape. Armed with your blaster, you must combat a variety of challenging enemies and upgrade your weapon along the way! EXPLORE AN ANCIENT TEMPLE FORGOTTEN BY TIME Explore an ancient temple forgotten by time. With non-linear exploration, multiple paths, and hidden secrets to uncover, Xenosis offers a personalized experience that allows players to choose their own path and play at their own pace. COMBAT AN UNFORGIVING ALIEN INFESTATION Throughout the temple, you will combat alien insectoids, mechanical defense golems and automatic temple defense systems. Xenosis has challenging enemies, platforming puzzles, and a variety of weapon upgrades to discover. EXPERIENCE A COSMIC ATMOSPHERE WITH CLASSIC METROIDVANIA GRAPHICS Immerse yourself in a cosmic temple atmosphere with brooding instrumental music and classic metroidvania graphics that capture the nostalgia of retro gaming. Xenosis was created independently by students in the University of Southern California’s games program. The game was developed by Noah Lee, Luke Todaro, Simon Burdick, Ryan Wilson, Emily Jiang, and Hudson Nguyen. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website.
row.short_description: Xenosis is a thrilling metroidvania where you traverse an ancient temple that has been overrun by alien creatures. Armed with your blaster, you must combat a variety of challenging enemies and upgrade your weapon to escape

row.name: A Game Called Paako
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game A Game Called Paako is a pixel-art 2D platformer metagame that tells the story of a game major graduate student making his thesis game project: A Game Called Paako. Quality-certified double jump and wall jump mechanics. (Very old-school) A fishing minigame. (Of course) Watch a talk show. (Why?) Find a job. (Or at least try to) Listen to your own echo. (No, I don’t have one) A Game Called Paako is initially an MFA thesis project at the University of Southern California created by Chaoran Huang, developed with help of Team Paako. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website.
row.short_description: It’s a game. It’s called Paako. It’s A Game Called Paako. It’s a game called A Game Called Paako. It’s about Paako, but also about A Game Called Paako. It’s only about Paako, but it’s not only about Paako. You’ll finish A Game Called Paako, but you won’t finish A Game Called Paako.

row.name: Nomad
row.detailed_description: Nomad is an atmospheric first-person platformer where you embark on a relaxing journey of melancholy to rekindle one of nature’s long-lost wonders. Your goal is to climb on top of a colossi to awaken it from its eternal slumber by combining jumps and a magical rope. Climb the Collosi Use your trusty grappling hook to latch onto the collsi and propel yourself forward. Chain your grappling hook to launch yourself into the air. Explore and create your own paths up the giant. Explore nature from a new perspective Explore a magical land of enormity. Enjoy breathtaking views as you continue to rise higher and higher into the clouds. Nomad was created by Bob Wu and David Zheng as part of the University of Southern California’s Game Development class. This included a collaboration with many talented musicians at Berklee College of Music, including David Contarino, Zhengzheng Fan, Sara Maeng, Albert Wang, and Andrea Brun. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website, linked to the right.
row.short_description: A serene first-person 3D platformer where you use a magical rope to traverse the body of a dormant ancient colossus in order to heal its wounds and awaken it once again. Embark on a relaxing journey of melancholy to rekindle one of nature's long-lost wonders.

row.name: Machine Heart
row.detailed_description: Machine Heart is a 2.5D Sci-fi Puzzle-Adventure Game featuring two interconnected storylines. You'll play as Avis, a defiant scientist hunted for her research, and Vox, a sentient robot who lost all his memory. By bringing together two storylines from two distinct eras, you'll uncover the striking secret behind the fate of humanity. Throughout your journey, you will learn to solve challenging cross-timeline puzzles with a mix of stealth, bike chasing, and exploration. Will you be able to find out what truly happened to all of mankind? TRAVEL BETWEEN TWO ERAS The two storylines are set in two distinct times and spaces. Carefully explore the dystopian Cyberpunk city of Avis's storyline, or immerse yourself in the post-apocalyptic ruins of Vox's storyline. Switch between storylines at any time and discover the surprising connection between the two protagonists. EXPERIENCE THRILLING STEALTH GAMEPLAY When you play as Avis, the scientist, you'll need to evade hostile patrols by staying out of their spotlight. Hurry up and get to your lab as soon as you can because your research might decide the fate of humanity. CHALLENGE YOUR WITS WITH UNIQUE PUZZLES Solve unique and challenging puzzles throughout your journey. Some require careful observation of the world, while others test your ability to connect various clues you've gathered. Can you piece together the solutions and the true story behind the game? Machine Heart was created as part of the University of Southern California’s Advanced Game Project (AGP). For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 game program in the world, check out USC Games website, linked to the right.
row.short_description: Delve into the captivating cross-timeline puzzles of Machine Heart, and unravel the conspiracy behind a mass mind-uploading scheme.

row.name: The Stoevi Curse
row.detailed_description: The Stoevi Curse is a chilling first-person survival horror game set in rural post-Communist Bulgaria, where you must protect your farm and save your family from a nightmarish creature. You are Dimo Stoev, a single father determined to protect his farm and rescue his children from the creature that terrorizes the land after nightfall. Drawing from Bulgarian folklore, The Stoevi Curse immerses players in a chilling tale of survival and family. RESOURCE AND TIME MANAGEMENT Strategically manage your scarce resources and beat the clock to return home before the sun sets, when the Bulgarian bogeyman comes out to hunt. STEALTH AND EVASION Stay low and quiet as you navigate your farm, avoiding the sinister creature that lurks in the shadows, ready to strike when you least expect it. SURVIVAL AND FAMILY Withstand the relentless nightmare plaguing your land each day, and summon the strength to save your family from the clutches of the dreadful Stoevi Curse. The Stoevi Curse was created as part of CTWR 410: Game Narrative Workshop by developers Colin Spiridonov, Austin Fuad, Tian Yang, M. Mo, Simon Burdick, Max Hall, and Anthony Sabatino. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website.
row.short_description: Unravel the mystery of The Stoevi Curse, a first-person survival horror game set in rural post-Communist Bulgaria. Protect your farm, save your family.

row.name: Death Requiem
row.detailed_description: Not the final version of the game. Sorry for the accident release. Update including more optimized gameplay and new maps will coming up really soon!!! Death Requiem is a survival fantasy game. You'll dive into the dungeon and explore the gothic environment to experience the grandeur of architecture. At the same time, danger is approaching... The rift in the universe has opened and countless enemies are coming. Use your strategy and skill combination to fight against the enemies. Are you ready to deal with constant stream of enemies and ready to start a wonderful adventure? Intense Combat: Play as the third person character and fight against constantly spawning demons from the outside world. Different combat styles and abilities allow the player to create your own attack preference and bring different game experiences. Wave System: Enemies will be refreshed in each wave and more and more. There will be more powerful enemies spawning in later waves. Get ready to face each wave of enemies' onslaught and try to survive as long as you can in this tense and exciting battle Collection system and hidden rewards: Player needs to collect items and gold scattered in the world that can be used to buy weapons and upgrade character's abilities. There is a hidden boss that can boost character's attributes after being killed. Skill trees and upgrade system: When killing enemies, player can get blood currency that can be used to upgrade character's attributes. The skill trees contain various expertise that can be used expand character's attack style. These skills include basic attacks, healing abilities and weapon upgrade and can be unlocked through current expertise level Element upgrade: There are four kinds of magic cloaks in the game that can give players corresponding attributes that include: Fire, Poison, Lightning, Dark. Each magic cloaks contains magic skills that assist the player in killing enemies. These skills can be upgraded from skill trees once the player finds the cloak.
row.short_description: Death Requiem is a wave-based fantasy game. You'll explore the dungeon and gothic environment to experience the grandeur of architecture. The rift in the universe has opened and get ready to fight against constant stream of enemies using your strategy and skill combination.
row.notes: This product contains some blood splatter and dismemberment effects

row.name: The Flying Feathers
row.detailed_description: The player will play the role of Nia, who accidentally enters Alice's past memories on the train to her best friend Alice's graduation ceremony. The only way to escape the illusion and return to the real world is to help Alice solve all the problems she is currently facing. Examine every clue around you to understand the current story and dilemma that Alice is facing. Collect clues and solve puzzles to help Alice solve her troubles or fulfill her current wishes. Experience the journey and learn about what happened to Alice. During this process, Nia gradually learned about everything Alice had gone through. If she could go back to the past and start all over again, would there still be any regrets left? The Flying Feathers is a first-person narrative game, which combines interactive experience and cutscenes to immerse players in the story.
row.short_description: Nia accidentally goes into her best friend—Alice's past, the only way to escape and go back to the real world is to help Alice to solve all her problems. When you can go back to the past, do you want to do everything you can to save what you've lost?

row.name: Hare 136
row.detailed_description: No matter if rabbit or hare, it's always puzzling! After enjoying a whole day playing outside, it's time to go home. And there's no time to waste, be clever and try to do it in the minimum number of moves! Hare 136 is a simple and relaxing but increasingly challenging sliding puzzle game where you find the best path to move rabbits across the board. You can choose between the two available game modes: 'Slider' where you try to get one of the rabbits back into their den, and 'Sower' where you try to get the rabbits go through every tile to seed the whole map. Key features: Two game modes : Choose between Slider and Sower , where you use the sliding mechanic to reach different goals. 136 unique levels for each mode : Those are 272 unique levels in total! Daily puzzle mode : If 272 levels weren't enough, you can come back tomorrow to get a completely new random level. Cute hand-drawn artstyle : The rabbits are cute and fluffy, so are the puzzles. An amazing soundtrack : If you ever wondered how rabbits and puzzles sound, this is how. Steam achievements : A digital trophy for all the puzzles you are able to solve. Slide rabbits, Solve Puzzles!
row.short_description: Drag adorable coin-riding rabbits and slide them across the board. Solve engaging cozy puzzles. Help our little fluffy friends get back to their home!

row.name: Axecutioners
row.detailed_description: Axecutioners is a 2D fighting game in which players must determine which axecutioner reigns supreme! In a kingdom dying of boredom, the ruling king took it upon himself to find his subjects (and himself) a new source of entertainment. Enter the colosseum, with its new (totally willing) participants, all of the prisoners in the land! However, as the kingdom runs out of prisoners to pit against one another, the duty of entertaining the masses has fallen to the king's loyal executioners. Now at the mercy of a local necromancer (to ensure the fights never end), the executioners, armed with their larger-than-life axes, are now tasked with slaying each other in an endless cycle to see who can be spared being brought back from death once again! In Axecutioners you play as an axecutioner fighting for their life for the entertainment of the king, the kingdom, and the necromancer! Utilize your low, mid, and high attacks in rock-paper-scissors style combat. However, be careful; even though you are an absolutely yoked fighter, your axe is quite large and unwieldy, meaning your attacks are powerful but slow! This means you need to be very intentional with each attack, or else your opponent will win the favor of your audience! Additionally, pick up the crown each round to empower your attacks! While it won't make you hit any harder (it is just a crown after all), it will give you the extra ability to cleave your opponents in half if you land the killing blow! Impress the audience (and your friends) by showing the other axecutioner who's boss!
row.short_description: A minimal-input fighting game to determine who is the greatest Axecutioner of them all! Your huge, unwieldy axe ensures that each of your attacks are slow yet powerful, meaning you need to think and strategize before your next attack to claim victory over your opponent!
row.notes: Axecutioners features cartoonish violence and the usage of light stylized gore elements. All elements of blood and gore are heavily stylized and reflect a very cartoon-esque depiction of bodily harm. User discretion is advised.

row.name: Yappie! Knockout
row.detailed_description: The game features up to 24 players Competing in a series of mini-games that take place in a colorful and chaotic world filled with traps and obstacles. The objective of the game is to be the last player standing after completing each round and avoiding elimination by falling off the edge of the platform, being knocked out by obstacles, or failing to complete the mini-game withinthe given time limit. • Supports up to 24 players at once, matching players over the internet • Requires skill and fast reflexes, while remaining fun and entertaining • Tracks and obstacles are randomly generated, making each game unique • Easy to learn and play with simple controls such as jumping and pushing • Includes various game modes like race, team-based, survival, and more Download Yappie now and experience the fun!
row.short_description: You can play with up to 24 players simultaneously across 13 levels. It's time to call your friends and use your running, jumping, and other skills to win in Yappie!

row.name: The Monster War
row.detailed_description: This is my first game, created in within a limited timeframe and minimal budget, which is why it is not fully polished and uses many free assets. Every aspect of this game reflects a labor of love. It is my hope that you will enjoy it for what it is, and be able to see my vision and the potential of what it could be. Welcome to The Monster War This game combines 3 game modes into 1 exciting and unique experience, bringing to life the heroic exploits of Lyonel Cooper, a valiant knight from the pages of 'A Tale of Destiny' (my first book). Play as our hero on a quest to protect the kingdom from a relentless onslaught of monstrous invaders. Starting in the Side Scroller mode, immersive yourself in adventure across a landscape filled with danger. Push back the monstrous threat with combat and exploration, but beware—run out of time and the monster war will come to your front door. If you do not win the Side Scroller mode, you are sent to the front lines of Tower Defense mode. Lead the battle against waves of enemies as you fortify the castle's defenses and thwart the advancing horde of goblins, orcs and trolls. If you do manage to locate the monster's base in the side scroller mode, you must win the Casual Puzzle mode, to determine the fate of the kingdom. Launch catapults and dismantle their base piece by piece. Failure here will bring you back to the Side Scroller mode, requiring you to locate their nearest stronghold again, but victory will bring an end to the war! Join the battle in The Monster War to become a part of this epic tale!
row.short_description: Embark on an epic journey as a knight in a fantasy war. Experience Tower Defense, Side Scroller and Casual Puzzle modes all in one thrilling adventure. Defend the kingdom from the monster invasion, push back the threat, and conquer their bases of operations to emerge victorious from the war!

row.name: Creeping Deck: Pharaoh's Curse Prologue
row.detailed_description: Join now the early access! SUBSCRIBE TO THE NEWSLETTER About the Game The prologue only gives you access to the first 3 temples Embark on a journey through Ancient Egypt as you conquer dungeons and face mythological creatures. Build and refine your deck as you progress through each dungeon, facing off against bosses and enemies. Uncover hidden treasures, and discover powerful artifacts, potions, and epic cards, upgrade, unlock new skills and options in order to protect all of Egypt! More than 100 cards available to build your deck Face up to 10+ type of enemies: Giants, Zombies, Impious and more. Boss fights! You'll encounter 1 boss per dungeon Upgrade your character, increase HP or energy level, unlock rest options and more in the dungeons! Unlock definitive upgrades for your character in the God's Lair Start your run by choosing a set of initial cards with a random artifact Each battle unlocks new cards and artifacts for you to use in your deck Open chests to find new loot such as artifacts, potions or epic cards! Creeping Deck is the first collaboration of Tavrox Games (Overboss, Neurodeck) and Miju Games (Planet crafters), two indie game studios originating from the same city in the south of France, joining forces to create challenging and strategic experiences through gaming!
row.short_description: Creeping Deck is a strategic roguelite deck-builder with RPG elements. Build and refine your deck as you progress through each dungeon, facing off against bosses and enemies. Upgrade, and unlock new skills, options, and artifacts to protect all of Egypt!

row.name: 廃病院探索
row.detailed_description: Exploring abandoned hospitals This is a free game. It's my first work, but I hope you enjoy it even a little. The protagonist heads to an abandoned hospital at the request of a friend... A first-person horror game about finding out what happened in an abandoned hospital. *Some grotesque and unpleasant scenes ·ending Two types are available. ・Play time 20 to 30 minutes (assumed) ·atmosphere I tried to reproduce it so that it feels real. ·save Autosave only We welcome live commentary and distribution!
row.short_description: This is a horror game that asks a friend to find out what happened in an abandoned hospital.
row.notes: Some parts of the game contain extreme expressions such as bloodshed and torture.

row.name: Fursona Festival
row.detailed_description: Ever wonder what animal your personality matches best? This game let's you answer an extensive list of questions in the form of a point-and-click adventure/visual novel. The game will analyze you over 200+ personality questions, determining what Jungian archetype best suits you, and the related animal based on historical symbolism. A great game for streamers to connect with their audience by answering a bunch of quirky or insightful questions about what drives them. It's also a wonderful experience for anyone curious about anthropomorphization or the furry fandom: find out what animal you're most like, risk free! Plus, you're guided along on your journey by a 9ft tall dragon lady! Pretty neat!
row.short_description: Wander into the carnival of a giant magical dragon lady, where nobody ever leaves unchanged! Answer an extensive list of questions disguised as mini games as you explore the carnival grounds to discover what animal spirit lives inside you.

row.name: Octodad (Student Edition)
row.detailed_description: (This is the original free student project. The fully complete Octodad: Dadliest Catch can also be purchased on Steam.) Octodad is a third person adventure game about destruction, deception, and fatherhood. The player controls Octodad, a dapper octopus masquerading as a human, as he goes about a day of his life. His existence is a constant struggle, as he must master mundane tasks with his unwieldy boneless tentacles while simultaneously keeping his cephalopodan nature a secret from his human family. The player controls Octodad like a marionette, dragging his arms and legs around while his body flops along. The player’s goals are often simple household chores made difficult and interesting by the flailing, tenuous control they have over Octodad’s body. Being an octopus also has its strengths. Octodad can slip through tight spaces, grab objects with his suckers, and knock things around with tremendous strength. But if the player does things too out-of-the-ordinary, Octodad’s family will grow suspicious and realize what he really is. If they do, it’s game over for Octodad! FEATURES: 6 levels full of comedic failure! 3 family members to deceive! Roughly 35-45 minutes of gameplay! One very non-canonical ending! WHY DID WE MAKE THIS? Octodad: Student Edition is part of Young Horses: Free Range, where we collect our smaller side projects and release them for free! This is the game that started it all! Octodad was made before the founding of Young Horses by a group of students at DePaul University. Our goal was to enter the Independent Games Festival in 2010 (we did enter, but we didn't win). Octodad made a big enough splash that we decided to take our chances and start a company to develop a commercial sequel! So give it a try! It's free, so there's only so disappointed you can be!
row.short_description: You are Octodad, a dapper octopus masquerading as a human, as he goes about a day of his life. His existence is a constant struggle, as he must master mundane tasks with his unwieldy boneless tentacles while simultaneously keeping his cephalopodan nature a secret from his human family!

row.name: Your World VR
row.detailed_description: MAIN FEATURES Avatar customization Many items that can be placed anywhere All items can be made any size All items can be recolored Items can be made climbable All items can be left frozen or made to be affected by physics Place traps, enemies, obstacles, and much more Import your own models Share and try community made maps using Steam Workshop WHAT WILL YOU BUILD Use your imagination to build Your World anyway you want. You build the landscape and everything in it. Build a giant obstacle course to try and conquer with traps, enemies, and even a boss that gains new abilities as its weakened, or anything else you could imagine. Use the npc builder to create custom made npc's from any items you choose to make a truly unique companion. All progress can be saved and shared through the Steam Workshop. Join the discord for tips , help, or to share or find community made worlds
row.short_description: The ultimate VR building game! Build just about anything you can imagine. Build obstacle courses, dungeons, custom npc's. There are many items to choose from that are all customizable. Share and experience other worlds through the Steam Workshop.

row.name: Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure
row.detailed_description: A free-to-play turn based RPG that serves as a short demo. It is a fair gauge if you as a player may or may not want to pick up the full games.  The main story is a short series of quests to help Anri recover an artifact. Meet interesting people. Recruit new party members. Learn about your party members and the region you are exploring. Explore the world and fight challenging turn-based battles. Repeatable dungeons with harvesting and chest nodes that reset. Play fun mini games. Gather food and cook it. Designed with widescreen monitors and laptops in mind In addition to the base game, we have the following DLCs available: Optimization DLCs: a free download for Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure and one for Interstellar and it is intended to be used on lower end operating systems. The other DLCs are are effectively 2 games and 1 big expansion pack in a trench coat. Luminous Skies: The Pilgrimage: A standalone game set prior to the events in A Short Adventure and Horizons. Luminous Skies: Horizons: an add-on for A Short Adventure. It adds a many new quests, new encounters, new overworld zones, secrets, weapons and armors, and new party members. We hope to add additional content on a regular basis. Mainland and new world access has opened up for more exploration. If The Pilgrimage is a standalone game, Horizons is a standalone expansion pack. Luminous Skies: Interstellar. Another standalone game, this time set in a Sci-Fi setting. Explore many worlds and contend with the Solar Regime and their plots to conquer all of known space. Please refer to our announcements in the community section for further details on updates. In some ways, these games have more in common with games of the 1980s or 1990s than those of the current year. What are you waiting for? It's all out there for you to find and experience for yourself. We do not use A.I. in our products.
row.short_description: A free-to-play demo for a turn based RPG. Explore the world and fight challenging battles. Play fun mini games. Gather food and cook it.

row.detailed_description: Three Kingdoms theme card game'Eat Wei Shu Wu' with the classic pixel painting hot attack! Skill attributes compatible grams, hidden strategy scheming, offline hanging fat profits, Zero Krypton micro-liver easy map! The seat of the Lord is vacant, come to build belong to your palm of the Three Kingdoms!
row.short_description: Come and build your own three kingdoms!

row.name: CyberRoom
row.detailed_description: 此应用可以基于虚幻引擎的Lumen光线追踪与硬件光线追踪来评估您GPU设备的性能表现，并且可以自由的在房间中行动和进行不记录成绩的参观场景；
