row.name: World Capitals Quizzer
row.detailed_description: Test your knowledge of world capitals, countries, flags and geography in this fun and educational trivia game! World Capitals Quizzer has entertained millions of players worldwide. Whether you are a beginner or a geography expert, this game helps you learn, play, and improve your world knowledge while having fun. Learn the world through play Explore every corner of the globe with quiz modes covering world capitals, countries, flags, landmarks, currencies and regions. Play short quizzes to sharpen your skills, or tackle harder challenges to become a true geography master. Features Guess all the world’s capitals and see how many you know Identify countries and their national flags Explore landmarks, famous regions and currencies Learn about national animals, flowers, anthems and historical figures Multiple quiz modes: capitals, flags, states/regions and more Fun, relaxing, and suitable for all ages Challenge your friends or test yourself solo Regular updates with new quizzes and features Why choose World Capitals Quizzer? Perfect for students who want to study geography Great for quiz and trivia fans who enjoy testing their knowledge Ideal for travellers curious about new countries and cultures Entertaining and educational for players of all ages World Capitals Quizzer is more than a quiz – it’s a learning journey. Improve your knowledge of world capitals, flags and countries while enjoying an engaging and relaxing gameplay experience. Play free today and join the global community of trivia fans discovering the world one question at a time!
row.short_description: Guess capitals, flags, countries and geography in this fun and educational trivia quiz. Learn and play your way to becoming a geography master!

row.name: Pixel Madness
row.detailed_description: - About the game - Pixel Madness - is simple 2D clicker game but with cool key elements that will help you achieve your goals and make your gameplay more fun. - You can - CRAFTING - use your workbench to craft different materials from different resources. TRANSMUTATIONS - use your 'Magic knowledge' to splice essences into something very cool. DIFFERENT WORLDS - visit different locations to obtain better resources with more XP. BOSS FIGHTING - fight different bosses to earn XP and maybe you can even get a good reward after beating the boss. WORLDS - use the unknown power to travel between different worlds to farm even more different resources. ACHIEVEMENTS - complete goals and unlock cool looking pixel images called achievements. - More... - Our biggest goal is to make a really good community that is really interested in what we are doing and also wants to be a part of the game development! We are going to make a lot of updates in the future with new mechanics/bosses/locations and more, so don't forget to join our official discord server to know about all our announcements & updates!
row.short_description: Pixel Madness is a simple 2D clicker game where your main goal is to level up/craft/fight bosses and complete different achievements.

row.name: Metaart
row.detailed_description: Art Galleries In the Metaverse. Vr Art Museum Welcome to our VR free browsing museum game! This game will take you into a virtual museum, allowing you to explore various exquisite exhibits and historical relics to your heart's content. You can wear a VR headset and immerse yourself in a realistic 3D museum environment, experiencing a real museum experience. You can stroll freely in different exhibition halls and admire various exquisite artworks, historical relics, antiques, technological exhibits, and more. Our game is also equipped with various interactive devices, such as touch screens, controllers, etc., allowing you to have a deeper understanding of the history and background of each exhibit. You can also listen to audio guides to learn detailed information about each exhibit, or exchange thoughts and feelings with other players. Our VR free browsing museum game is a very suitable game for educational and cultural experiences. You can learn various historical and cultural knowledge in the game, while also relaxing your body and mind, enjoying a beautiful visual and auditory experience.
row.short_description: Art galleries in the metaverse. Vr Art Museum

row.name: Cavera - The Island of Apes
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Cavera - The Island of Apes, a top-rated vacation destination for all those who identify as degens or Apes. Immerse yourself in a cinematic island setting and enjoy socializing with your Ape friends while grooving to music in a spacious house. Whether you're looking for a chill chat or a thrilling adventure, Cavera has it all. Join up to 99 other players in this exclusive multiplayer game, where you can connect with like-minded individuals and engage in exciting activities. Take a dip in the crystal clear waters, or explore the island's lush terrain. With endless possibilities and a vibrant community, Cavera offers an unforgettable experience that you won't want to miss. So what are you waiting for? Come and join the fun at Cavera - The Island of Apes.
row.short_description: Cavera - Island of Apes: top vacation spot for Apes and degens. Socialize, dance with up to 99 others. Explore, swim, chill on this multiplayer game.

row.name: Rebound Gun
row.detailed_description: Game Features Shooting and Rebounding In this game, players can use blocking to rebound enemy bullets. Perfect rebounds will temporarily disable enemy attacks. Jumping Use different routes to reach the destination. Cute and Healing Pixel Art Style The use of pixel art style for the paper character is not just to save art resources! Game Objective Defeat the final boss to open the exit of the maze.
row.short_description: 'Rebound Gun' is an indie game with shooting and bullet rebound as its main theme. In the game, players will play as the protagonist Hyakka, exploring the imaginative world during sleepless nights.

row.name: It gets so lonely here
row.detailed_description: You are running through a forest. It is late at night and the sky is as black as pitch. The trees which surround you, jutting out of the earth like eerie monuments to a foreign god, are blotting out most of the moonlight. You do not know where you are going. You have no map; no route; no plan. You have no desire, as you run, save to escape. You cannot let yourself be caught. All you can do is run, on and on and on... But, despite all of your hard work, your best efforts will, invariably, be in vain. It’s already too late for you. After all... You’ll never be able to escape from me. About 50k words of text (approx 2-3 hours of reading) A branching story with several choices 800x600 resolution for that old-timey aesthetic Custom character artwork A custom soundtrack which comes bundled with the VN Three(?) pretty girls who will love you to death Three exciting ways to die!!! An archly amused narrator who berates you for your poor life decisions Cannibalism ♥
row.short_description: A yandere yuri visual novel with a fairytale theme. Can you escape from your mysterious pursuer?
row.notes: This VN does not contain any explicit gory artwork or descriptions. However, it does touch upon subjects some readers may find discomforting, such as: bullying, drowning, being buried alive, and cannibalism.

row.name: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Realms of Ruin - Playtest
Fish Collector: Aquarium Story
row.detailed_description: Raise fish, evolve them into mermaids, and become an aquarium tycoon! Build your dream aquarium in this relaxing simulation game! Raise fish and watch them evolve into beautiful mermaids. Manage resources, decorate your aquatic paradise, and grow your aquarium business. Collect over 100 mermaids and sea creatures through relaxing gameplay. Enjoy fun match-3 puzzles and merge challenges as you expand your collection! Raise, Collect, and Relax Enjoy the most relaxing fish collecting experience! Watch adorable sea creatures swim peacefully in your aquariums - from tiny clownfish to mysterious pirate lanternfish. Each fish has its own personality and charm, creating a soothing atmosphere perfect for unwinding after a long day. Evolve Fish into Legendary Mermaids Witness the magic as your ordinary fish transform into stunning mermaids! Through careful nurturing and special care, watch your aquatic friends undergo amazing evolutionary changes. Collect dozens of unique mermaid species, each with their own beautiful design and special abilities. Customize Your Aquarium World Design every corner of your aquarium paradise! Choose from hundreds of decorative items - palm trees, coral reefs, guide shelves, and themed decorations. Create different zones for different creatures, build walking paths for visitors, and craft the perfect aquatic environment that reflects your style. Play Smart, Be a Tycoon Run a successful aquarium business! Harvest raw materials, develop visitor products, and manage your resources wisely. Balance your fish care, decoration budget, and souvenir production to build the world's most profitable aquarium. ※ Game Features: ► Collect 100+ mermaids and sea animals ► Raise fish and evolve them into mythical mermaids ► Decorate and customize your aquarium with hundreds of themed items ► Craft souvenirs and trade rare items ► Enjoy diverse mini-games, including match-3 and merge puzzles ► Team up with friends and compete in global leaderboards
row.short_description: Run your own aquarium and evolve fish into mermaids! Fish Collector is a relaxing aquarium tycoon game that blends fish farming, idle resource production, match-3, and merge gameplay to build your fantasy ocean world.

row.name: Carnage Cuisine
row.detailed_description: Carnage Cuisine is a survivors-like, action rogue-lite experience where food fights back! Prepare for a culinary revolution as you embark on a thrilling adventure to fight against evil cooks, liberate oppressed foods and become their hero. 🔥 Survivors-like: Dive into survivors-like bullet hell mechanics. Choose the upgrades that suit your play style. Create unique builds. Beat the game by killing the boss. 💎 Meta progression: Collect purple gem things, the strange currency of this gastronomical uprising, and utilize them to upgrade your character and attack skills. 🍌 Go bananas: Take on the role of a courageous warrior, Banana, fighting alongside the rebellious edibles. More playable characters are on the way! 🍽️ Boss battles: Face off against formidable bosses (currently there is only one boss though, more on the way) who serve as the ultimate test of your culinary prowess. Show them who's the true master of the kitchen as you outmaneuver them and deliver the final blow to claim victory. 🛠️ Early access: Join the revolution in the early access phase and witness the game's evolution firsthand. Stay tuned for upcoming updates as we plan to introduce new playable characters, bosses, skills, weapons, game modes, and maps. Carnage Cuisine is the battle for food liberation that you've been craving. Can you restore freedom to the oppressed edibles? The time has come to unleash your skills and savor the taste of victory!
row.short_description: You are a banana with a gun! Blast your way through hordes of evil cooks and machines in this survivors-like, action rogue-lite. Collect loot, unlock powerful skills, rally your food allies, and lead them to victory! If you fail, upgrade your character and skills, and rise stronger for the next run!
row.notes: Cartoon violence

row.name: Project Hardline
row.detailed_description: Project Hardline is a first person shooter game where two teams of mercenaries fight to be the last ones left or to capture an uplink station. This uplink station contains vital intel and must not fall into the wrong hands. Every time a team loses a round, they come back better equipped with better weapons, gear and equipment. This game is perfect for a party of casual shooter players, with tight physics based gun mechanics and fast paced round. NOTE: This game is developed nearly entirely by one person, content updates may be slow and sporadic and bugs may still exist due to the limited resources available to testing the game. Bug reports are highly appreciated and any considerable bugs and errors will be patched immediately.
row.short_description: Project Hardline is a party first person shooter game where two teams fight to capture an uplink station. This uplink station contains vital intel and must not fall into the wrong hands. With every round a team faces, they will come back with better gear. This game is perfect for a party of friends.

row.name: Dwarfender
row.detailed_description: Dwarfender is an action-strategy fantasy game taking place in the dwarven caves, take control of a powerful dwarf named Rigolain ! Use your blunderbuss and a set of traps to defeat your stone foes and steal their crystals ! Use these crystals to build more traps and huge towers to make a perfect stronghold ! **Features :** • 3 unique levels ! Fight waves of enemies ! • 5 kinds of traps including 2 types of towers ! • 3 types of golems to destroy ! • Find out why Rigolain cares so much about crystals ! A game made by students over the course of three months.
row.short_description: Dwarfender is an action-strategy fantasy game in third person, set traps to repel waves of angry golems ! Take control of Rigolain, a dwarf-engineer, ready for anything in the heat of battle !

row.name: Wandering Skies
row.detailed_description: Somewhere, high in the sky, resides a forgotten and magical place. An elusive paradise filled with secrets, wonders and adventures... Wandering skies, a student game, is a first-person platformer adventure taking place in the desolate Sky Lands, a fantastic world that has been corrupted and destroyed by a strange magic. Observe your surrondings and use your abilities to reach the portals in each level, bringing you closer and closer from your main objective : the harmony crystal. Jump, slide and run across the various platforms and dangerous gaps. Activate buttons and magic mechanisms to progress through each zone. Use your two obtainable shooting powers to create acesses and uncover secrets. Five hidden gems hiding in each levels, plus one super-secret collectible ! A total of 7 levels to discover and explore
row.short_description: Navigate through the Sky Lands and uncover its secrets to restore their lost harmony. In this first person platformer, use your abilities to reach the end of each level. Observation and skill are the keys to success !

row.name: Everlasting Abundance
row.detailed_description: Everlasting Abundance (the game) is set in a dystopian future where a AAA game company controls everything and pushes its predatory practices like loot boxes and forced gambling into the everyday lives of people. You play as an orphan teenager, and along with your little sister Kiyoko and your childhood friend Mirai , you will need to break out of your daily routine and join a faction of independent rebels called the Circle in order to try to defeat Everlasting Abundance (the regime). However, ushering in a new era of freedom isn't as easy as 1-2-3. Conflicts will arise. Tears will be shed. Meat & potatoes will be eaten. And the flowers will grow back... Probably. This game is 3 to 4 hours long, has 4 different endings and an original soundtrack (heavily influenced by classic JRPG music). It also has a Story Mode if you want to breeze through the combat and mostly experience the narrative. Pride & Accomplishment!
row.short_description: A greedy AAA game company rules the world with an iron fist. You must join a faction of independent rebels and defeat the tyranny of Everlasting Abundance. Can you succeed? Is it all just a pointless dream?

row.name: STRAFTAT
row.detailed_description: Straftat is a free to play, online, proximity chat enabled, 1v1, 2v2 or FFA first person shooter taking place in a wide variety of maps with a large choice of firearms, explosives and melee weapons. A match is composed of a number rounds. A round ends when only one survivor remains. Each round takes place in a different environment. Straftat features over 350 arenas to play in. Each map contains its own set of weapons. Pick them up and hunt down your opponent. Unlock hats and fashion ware through unique challenges. Keyboard and Gamepad supported
row.short_description: STRAFTAT is a 1v1/2v2 ONLINE first person SHOOTER with quick rounds in over 350 MAPS ; Including all WEAPONS, proximity chat and 4 players FFA.
row.notes: This game contains visual representations of blood, death, and act of violence with firearms and bladed weapons.

row.name: 数据结构之森
row.detailed_description: 用大量比喻或拟人的例子为您解释数据结构的定义 无论您是正在学习数据结构专业课的学生，还是零基础想当解谜游戏顺便开拓思维。游玩完全无压力！ 活灵活现的演示动画 动画是最直观的表现方式！多么精准简练的文字都不如动画更容易理解 难度适中的互动解谜小游戏 在掌握了概念之后，您总需要练练手！每当学习一个概念之后都会安排简单的小谜题 想自己试试看? 在关卡中复制可以复刻本关过程与结果的代码.您可以随时导出到自己的编辑器中 自行编辑代码,结合游戏深度理解其中的原理与思想
row.short_description: 数据结构之森是结合了互动解谜和动画可视化的学习数据结构的游戏。游戏创作的核心理念是避免填鸭，快乐学习。希望此游戏能有幸成为您坚持学习计算机或成为游戏创作者的一个理由.交流群570409322

row.name: Raw Nerve
row.detailed_description: Drive this truckin’ weird and wild world of jumps, traverses and winding ascents. Uncover artifacts, help build the sonic landscape, conquer the summit, and try to clock the fastest time. • There is no traction control in space! A sandbox of hidden paths, cutty jumps and sonic artifacts. • Discover shortcuts to clock the best time to the finish line. • Use checkpoints as your guide or just go exploring. • It’s a vibrant and psychedelic drive.
row.short_description: Raw Nerve is a slippery, small driving sandbox in a psychedelic galaxy. Take a casual rip or speedrun to the summit for a top time. It’s one truckin' awesome ride.

row.name: Nature is hungry
row.detailed_description: Welcome to a world of darkness and danger, where survival is key and enemies lurk around every corner. You find yourself stranded in the middle of nowhere after a plane crash, with nothing but predators for company. Crocodiles, bears, and wolves are just a few of the deadly creatures that you must face in each round. Armed with an array of weapons and the ability to scavenge for health packs, ammo, and batteries, you must fight your way through the darkness and uncover the mystery behind two long-dead skeletons. But beware, for the darkness is your greatest enemy. With limited visibility, you must use your wits and your resources to stay alive. The batteries you collect are essential to lighting up the environment, revealing the horrors that await you in the shadows. This game is not for the faint of heart, as it combines elements of horror with the intense action of a first-person shooter. With a storyline that unfolds as you progress, you will be on the edge of your seat as you uncover the truth about the mysterious skeletons and the reason behind the deadly predators. This game is the ultimate test of survival, as you fight to stay alive and uncover the truth in a world that wants you dead. Are you ready to take on the challenge? The predators are waiting, and time is running out.
row.short_description: After a plane crash, fight for survival against deadly predators. Gather essential supplies to stay alive and uncover the mystery behind two long-dead skeletons and the crocodiles' presence. In this horror FPS game, the night is your greatest enemy. Can you survive until dawn and solve the mystery?

row.name: Bifröst: Through the Realms
row.detailed_description: Bifröst is a fast-paced, multi-dimensional platformer with Norse and Sci-Fi themes. Race through different Realms using the Bifrost; a device capable of opening Rifts and Bridges to alternate worlds. Master the unique effects of these abilities to battle and platform your way through the different realms! Utilize 6 unique abilities to explore the realms! Explore three massive levels, containing two realms each! Highly replayable, try to beat your best time! Treat your ears to an epic musical score! Feast your eyes on Bifröst's vivid and stylized art! And always listen to Heimdall, your AI companion! Good luck, Valkyrie!
row.short_description: Bifröst: Through the Realms is a fast-paced multidimensional platformer with Norse and Sci-Fi themes. Use the power of the Bifröst to save the realms from Ragnarök.

row.name: Derpy Dino
row.detailed_description: Get ready for a dino-mite adventure! Derpy Dino is a 2D survival game where you play as a lovable, yet hapless dinosaur trying to survive in a world filled with danger. In Survival Mode, dodge falling meteors and see how long you can last. The timer will keep track of your progress. But that's not all! In the brand new Adventure Mode you can take on five levels filled with dangerous enemies and delicious fruits! With its pixel art graphics and catchy chiptune soundtrack, Derpy Dino is a nostalgic treat for gamers of all ages. And with two exciting game modes to choose from, you'll never get bored. So grab your keyboard and mouse or controller, and get ready to join the Derpy Dino adventure! Can you survive the meteor showers and defeat the enemies to become the ultimate Derpy Dino champion?
row.short_description: Unleash your primal roar! Conquer the different stages in Adventure Mode, where different enemies will try to stop you. Or test your limits in Endless Mode, where the sky is literally falling! Meteors are crashing down, and the action never stops. Can you beat your highscore?

row.name: Green Reaper
row.detailed_description: Play as Rubin, a rose ensorcelled by the goddess Antheia and entrusted with her sacred scythe. Mushroom marauders have invaded the peaceful, prosperous greenhouse, targeting the garden goddess and choking the life from her children. It is your duty as Antheia’s chosen to traverse the expanse of the greenhouse and slay these invaders before they bleed dry your fellow fruits and flowers and overtake your home. Intense 3rd person combat Unique enemy types Gorgeous greenhouse environment Immersive and memorable soundtrack This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Play as Rubin, a rose ensorcelled by the goddess Antheia and entrusted with her sacred scythe. Mushroom marauders have invaded the greenhouse, targeting the garden goddess and choking the life out of her children. It is your duty to traverse the expanse of the greenhouse and slay these invaders.

row.name: Mirage
row.detailed_description: Mirage is a 2D action platformer-shooter game that transports you to a surreal desert world. You play as Ono, a cat; and Vio, his fireball-shooting snake friend. Together, they're on the hunt for treasure! Traverse mystical desert architecture to explore the world of Mirage across three game levels. Each takes place in a different time, with beautiful art direction and hand-drawn animation! Maneuver your way through difficult jumps and treacherous hazards to reach the end of the ruins. Along the way, you'll encounter strange bird-like creatures called Gobs, who guard the treasure with their lives. Watch out—the Gobs will be angry if you take it, and you'll have to make a daring escape! 2D shooting Platforming action Hand-drawn character animation Beautiful art direction An exciting ending escape sequence to every level This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Jump through mystical desert ruins and shoot the bird-like guards to steal their treasure.

row.name: Operation Space Force
row.detailed_description: Join Operation Space Force, a free-to-play team-based shooter that takes place in space. KEY FEATURES With 6+ unique characters on the roster, experiment with their speed and power. Select the one who shall deem you victorious in the arena. There are four slots: Two to choose from between 13+ guns, one to select from 2+ grenades, and one for a knife. Weapon customization allows you to change certain parts of the gun and offers a variety of skins. Roam in 4+ different maps, where two maps will stay the same, while three maps will change every time a new match is loaded. Join a team and play up to 5+ game modes. Host a game, have the freedom to decide the gameplay, and create. Joining a game is perfectly optional as well.
row.short_description: Join Operation Space Force, a free-to-play team-based shooter that takes place in space. Explore weapon customization and different heroes, your base, fight against enemies, and experience different game modes.

row.name: Pens: The Freeware Collection
row.detailed_description: Pens: Ballad of the Erasers was not the beginning! There was actually some stuff that happened before then, and here it is in all it's glory! For the low, low price of absolutely nothing, witness the complete story leading up to Pens: Ballad of the Erasers in PENS: THE FREEWARE COLLECTION! For the first time, all four freeware titles in the PENS series - the original PENS, its follow-ups PENS 2: REVENGE OF THE SPRINGS and PENS 3: TIDES OF WAR, and the prequel FALL OF THE SPRINGS - have been bundled into one handy dandy package. A weaving tale of tragedy, cartoonish epicness and mutated living office equipment awaits! One download, four complete games, four completely different gameplay styles and all for the price of a breath of fresh air? Why, that's madness I say! And wild and wacky madness is what you will find in this ridiculous dramedy story! What do I get in PENS: THE FREEWARE COLLECTION? Why, all of this! -- PENS With the war already in full swing, fight as a determined green Pen against the army of the red Pens, shooting your way through six enemy-infested levels and battling against six wildly varied bosses. -- PENS 2: REVENGE OF THE SPRINGS The Springs have invaded and the war continues! Pilot your weapons-toting UFO through five chapter-divided missions against the Springs. Then, once you're done, play through as the Springs and experience their side of the story! -- PENS 3: TIDES OF WAR - COMPLETE EDITION Why is PENS 3 the only one to feature 'Complete Edition' in it's title? Why, that's because it's chock-full of add-on content, of course! Explore and blast through thirteen hilarious story missions in a massive side-scrolling open world in the main campaign, stop a zombie apocalypse in PENS 3: NIGHTS OF DEATH, see the setup for Pens: Ballad of the Erasers in PENS 3: BLEAK OMEN, fight against experiments-gone-wrong in PENS 3: TALE OF THE ACCURSED and take a couple of quick trips to the moon in PENS 3: TO THE MOON and PENS 3: LUNAR PLAGUES! -- FALL OF THE SPRINGS The entire story makes no secret that the reason behind everything that happens is because, just over a century prior, the Springs lost their world in a civil war. Explore a side-scrolling open world and witness first-hand the final days of the Springs' home planet in the eight story missions of FALL OF THE SPRINGS, then find out what happened to the leader of the Spring rebellion in the years between then and now in FALL OF THE SPRINGS: AURORA'S GREAT ESCAPE. ** PENS 3: TIDES OF WAR - COMPLETE EDITION is the only game in the Collection to be fully voice acted. All other games make use only of written text.
row.short_description: A complete compilation of all four freely released games in the PENS series, each featuring drastically different gameplay styles. Action, comedy, drama and pure ridiculousness await in this cartoony story!

row.name: 龙傲天的多元宇宙
row.detailed_description: Please install free DLC Please install free DLC or the game content is abnormal. About the Game The protagonist of this work Yuwen flame accidentally traversed to a mysterious campus. Wake up Yuwen flame met high cold beautiful Li Xue, cute cute sister little sauce, sexy charming Hou Meiling and other students, they are from different universe of people, everything seems like a dream, but it is true. In order to return to their respective world, the principal of the school stipulated that students could only pass campus exams before leaving the school. This is a role-playing game in which players play the role of a high school traveler, Yuwenflame, and return to the original world through learning skills, developing attributes, card fighting, collecting cards, and interactive gameplay. Play: Learning: Through XX days of campus study, learn the attributes of the corresponding discipline, and each attribute will become one card according to the card battle Combat: Play card battles with NPCS, reward them when you win, draw their cards randomly. And the cards drawn can be replaced by the cards of the corresponding discipline. Exams: Take a test every 30 days, which is a card battle with teachers.
row.short_description: This is a role-playing game in which players play the role of a high school traveler, Yuwenflame, and return to the original world through learning skills, developing attributes, card fighting, collecting cards, and interactive gameplay.

row.name: Invasion: Family Ties
row.detailed_description: Rick travels to Indiana to visit his mother, but during his stay, unexpected events occur that lead him on a thrilling adventure. As Rick navigates through the challenges of his visit, he uncovers a series of mysterious occurrences that keep him on his toes. Along the way, he must overcome obstacles and solve puzzles to ensure his visit goes smoothly. However, little does he know that a major threat looms on the horizon that will change everything. Will Rick be able to save the day and protect those he cares about? Invasion: Family Ties is a third-person adventure game where you play as Rick. Set in Indiana, you'll need to explore your surroundings to uncover the source of a mysterious and unusual event.
row.short_description: Rick travels to Indiana to visit his mother, but during his stay, unexpected events occur that lead him on a thrilling adventure. However, little does he know that a major threat looms on the horizon that will change everything. Will Rick be able to save the day and protect those he cares about?

row.name: Rite as Rain
row.detailed_description: The weather is yours to control... how will you use it? Rite as Rain is a whimsical turn-based open world game where you, Eira, are tasked with stopping elemental spirts gone awry. Solve puzzles, help villagers, and decide the fate of your enemies. Will you choose the light, or let darkness consume you? Use your weather magic to solve puzzles and interact with your environment. Explore the world to discover clues to solve puzzles. Find magical potions to help you survive dangerous battles with elemental enemies. Explore the vast villages within Estelia, and interact with a variety of villagers! When battle is required, use your magic to fight enemies using turn-based combat with your familiar, Looney the cat! (This is a student game made by UCF undergrad students! We're open to feedback so we can continue to improve.)
row.short_description: A magical open world RPG, where your choices matter!

row.name: (val)iant: or, val's guide to having a broken vag
row.detailed_description: about (val)iant is a single-player narrative game about pelvic pain. play as val, a nonbinary college student struggling with their relationship to their body, as well as their relationship with sex. this game is fundamentally about how we as a society learn (or don't learn) about sex. use your mouse and keyboard (WASD/arrow keys) as controls as you engage with val and their story! key features lots of text : it's part visual novel, part... something else point and click : choose your favorite sailor moon fanfic drag and drop : insert the tampon (or can you?) rhythm minigame : there's no fishing minigame, but this will have to suffice talk to doctors : some are bad and some are ok
row.short_description: (val)iant is a single-player narrative game about pelvic pain. play as val, a nonbinary college student struggling with their relationship to their body, as well as their relationship with sex. this game is fundamentally about how we as a society learn (or don't learn) about sex.
row.notes: Content Warning This experience contains references to abortions, anti-abortion propaganda, misgendering, sexism, and homophobia. No graphic visual content of the aforementioned topics will be shown. As this is a game about pelvic pain, there will be depictions of cartoonish vulvas and vaginas. These appear in Chapter 3 and Chapter 12. There are also some suggestive (though not explicit) sexual images in Chapter 10 and Chapter 13. Please check in with yourself before playing this game.

row.name: Kessler Syndrome
row.detailed_description: Alone in orbit with the corpse of your only colleague and no way to reach Earth, play as a weary astronaut who must struggle to keep a defunct space station in orbit. While aboard the Damocles space station you must maintain the various systems aboard, deal with the ever-present threat of great storms of space junk, and navigate the dark halls in zero-gravity. Day by day more and more systems fail, and the cold of the void draws ever closer. Kessler Syndrome is a student made slow-burn horror game, developed at Champlain College as a capstone project. We are excited to showcase what we have been working on this semester to any and all who may be interested! Key features: 6 degrees of freedom allows you to float through the space station with ease Check your task log and navigate your way through the ship to pick up tools and complete tasks Maintain the ship for a week to achieve a climactic conclusion.
row.short_description: Alone in orbit with a corpse and no way to reach Earth, play as an astronaut who must keep a defunct space station aloft. Maintain the onboard systems, deal with the constant threat of space junk, and navigate the dark halls in zero-gravity. Day by day more systems fail, and the void draws closer.

row.name: Echo of the Last Light Playtest
Save King
row.detailed_description: The king of the peaceful kingdom was kidnapped by Demon. On behalf of the sick prince, the princess leaves to save the king. Can the princess who followed daemon who ran away through the door that appeared in a small pond on a hill near the kingdom save the king. The purpose of the game is to save the king from Daemon's prison located on the 11th floor. This game belongs to a casual 3d puzzle. But it's never easy. How to play: 1. Press and drag the left mouse button. 2. The princess changes direction with the dragged direction. 3. The length of the dragged line is the force that indicates how far the princess will run. 4. If you have decided on the direction and force, release the left mouse button. The princess is running. 5. The princess jumps when you press the space bar. The game features: 1. Each floor is in the form of a maze, but the maze consists of only roads without walls. It means that when the princess gets off the road, she immediately falls down. So strength control is the most important thing. 2. There is nothing on the first floor except the road, but the road moving from the second floor and about 10 kinds of traps from the third floor interfere with the princess. 3. If you fell from a maze above the second floor, you should fall down and go up again from where you arrived. If you are not good at controlling your strength, you will fall down a lot, so you will increase your patience and calmness. 4. From the second floor, a skull-shaped bullet flies toward the princess from time to time. If it is shot, the Hp gauge located in the upper left Ui will be reduced, and if it is shot 10 times, the princess will die. 5. From the 2nd floor, in addition to skull bullets, Hp recovery bullets fly in the direction of the player. After 10 shots, you will recover 100%. 6. Traps function like getting off the road, moving to the starting point, stabbing with a thorn, or sending it downstairs. Traps also appear on the road two in a row. 7. Players can choose a character and embark on a journey to visit familiar and unfamiliar locations, upgrade their character's equipment, configure talents, defeat monsters along the way, and discover the stories of each girl's journey, while uncovering the reasons behind the increasingly chaotic world. As the first game in the Elementcore Revelations , Journey Prologue portrays the personal stories of the characters that appear in this game series. This game will allow players to experience the gameplay of one of the main characters in a free format, while other characters will gradually appear as DLC. Different characters will have different skills, talents, applicable weapons, storylines, and more. It is hoped that this character will provide players with a clearer understanding of the gameplay and a greater curiosity about the world within the game. row.name: 战姬军团
row.detailed_description: Game gift pack: tm-Fate111 tm-Fate222 tm-Fate333 tm-Fate444 tm-Fate555 tm-Fate666 tm-Fate777 tm-Fate888 Customer service QQ: 1595584560 Customer service email: wangquan0630@outlook.com Contact customer service and receive a gift package（Contains photo gift pack） In *Legion of Valkyrie*, War Maidens are not merely numerical tools, but 'partners' with souls, attitudes, and stories. Based on high-quality art and Live2D technology, each War Maiden can showcase her distinct personality through dynamic expressions, delicate movements, and multiple cutscenes. The War Maidens come from different civilizations: there are kingdom girls who protect their land with chivalry, and pure-blooded elves dwelling in the forest; there are dragon-blooded warriors who wield dragonfire, and automatons from an ancient civilization. Their cultures, beliefs, and destinies intertwine, forming the most vibrant tapestry of life on this continent. Each of them has an independent storyline, each possesses a unique fighting style, and every choice you make can rewrite their fate. During your adventure, players can gradually unlock the War Maidens' exclusive storylines, continuously strengthening their bonds through dialogue, interaction, and battle. As affinity grows, the War Maidens will reveal more facets of themselves—shyness, pride, stubbornness, coquettishness, and even the vulnerability hidden behind their strength. They will change because of your choices, and they will open their hearts to you. This sense of growth and companionship makes every encounter meaningful. Whether it's the initial wariness as they grip their weapons upon first meeting you, the trust gradually built after battles, or even the rare whispered conversations under the moonlight, these moments are fully captured by Live2D technology, making each War Maiden feel as if they truly exist beside you. Sexy Skin System: Swimsuits, Lingerie, Uniforms—a complete range of styles are available. The game offers an extremely extensive skin system, covering various themes from revealing swimsuits to alluring lingerie, from elegant dresses to playful uniforms, allowing each War Maiden to present herself to you in a different style. The **Summer Swimsuit Series** uses bright, cheerful colors and water droplet effects to showcase the freest side of the girls; The **Sexy Series Skins** create an alluring atmosphere with details such as silk textures, black stockings, high heels, and lace; The **Uniform Theme** includes classic anime-style outfits beloved by players, such as maid, nurse, school uniform, and secretary attire, allowing each battle maiden to display new charm in different roles; During limited-time holiday events, you can also obtain limited-edition appearances such as **Christmas dresses, New Year's kimono outfits, and Halloween-themed skins**. Skins are not simply outfit changes; they often come with: * New Live2D animations * Different emotions and expressions * Unique voice lines * Exclusive interactive dialogue Some rare skins also bring changes to combat effects From gentle to dashing, from cute to mature, from pure to alluring, each skin is like rewriting a 'character chapter' for the battle maidens. For collectors, this is not only a place to develop their combat power, but also their own 'Valkyrie Costume Library,' where they can experience the diverse charm of these characters in various styles. *Legion of Valkyrie*: When fate breaks, the Valkyries will rewrite the world with you. *Legion of Valkyrie* is a fantasy RPG that blends collecting beautiful female characters, strategic card battles, open-world exploration, and a deep character development system. With high-quality art as its core selling point, all Valkyries feature exquisite illustrations and Live2D dynamic animations. Some are lively and cute, some are aloof and noble, some are alluring and dangerous, and some are calm and wise. During your adventure, you can build deep bonds with them, unlock exclusive stories and voice lines, and gradually uncover the secrets hidden deep within their hearts. If you love the following games, you'll find your home here: Azur Lane, NIKKE: Goddess of Victory, Honkai Impact 3, Genshin Impact, Girls' Frontline, Fate/Grand Order, Arknights. If these titles have captivated you, then *Legion of Valkyrie* will be your new stronghold. It combines strategy, adventure, beautiful girls, fan service, character development, and character collection to create an immersive fantasy experience. Conclusion: Your destiny will be inextricably linked with the War Maidens. On this continent where beauty and danger coexist, you are not a bystander, but a participant. Legion of Valkyrie await you, trust you, and rely on you, and ultimately, the one who changes the fate of the world—can only be you. Now, embark on your journey. row.name: Phantom Blaze
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the immersive world of Phantom Blaze, an extraordinary online multiplayer gaming experience developed and published by the visionary team at ZONK STUDIOS PTE. LTD. Phantom Blaze is more than just a game; it's a tribute to the unyielding bravery and remarkable instincts of Indian Commanders. An Epic Tribute: Phantom Blaze stands as a testament to the valor and audacity exhibited by Indian Commanders throughout history. It's a game that pays homage to their unwavering commitment to protecting their homeland and their unquenchable thirst for victory. The Ultimate Battlefield: In Phantom Blaze, players find themselves thrust into a dynamic and ever-evolving battlefield. Your mission: Seek out the most potent weapons and equipment, master the art of strategy, and seize every opportunity to triumph while safeguarding your own survival. Unparalleled Excitement: This game isn't just about adrenaline-pumping action; it's a journey of heart-pounding excitement. Every decision counts, every move shapes your destiny, and every victory is a testament to your prowess. Key Features: Tactical Gameplay: Engage in strategic warfare, where every choice you make can tip the scales of victory. Weaponry Galore: Explore a vast array of weapons and equipment to customize your gameplay and enhance your combat abilities. Multiplayer Mayhem: Join forces with friends or go head-to-head with players from around the globe in epic multiplayer battles(Coming Soon). Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in the breathtaking landscapes and meticulously designed environments that bring Phantom Blaze's world to life. Commander's Legacy: Learn from the tactics and strategies of legendary Indian Commanders and use their wisdom to outsmart your opponents. Phantom Blaze isn't just a game; it's an ode to courage, an adventure of survival, and a celebration of the warrior spirit. Are you ready to step onto the battlefield and forge your own legend? Join us in the world of Phantom Blaze and become a part of gaming history. *Please Note:- This is a Beta Version of Phantom Blaze , This Beta Version doesn't represent the final quality of the product. row.short_description: Phantom Blaze sets the stage for an adrenaline-fueled odyssey, drawing inspiration from fearless commanders worldwide. This pulse-pounding game pushes players to the edge as they scavenge for cutting-edge weaponry, seizing every opportunity for victory while battling to stay alive.

row.name: Starcade FACTIONS
row.detailed_description: Embark on a strategic journey in Starcade FACTIONS —where every move could be your path to victory or defeat! Every turn offers up to three powerful actions: Build new ships for your fleet... Play a powerful Action card... Move ships and launch attacks... Your mission is clear: capture the enemy’s Flagship and claim your victory! In this fast-paced, turn-based strategy game, you're not just a commander; you're the mastermind behind epic space battles. Engage in quick, action-packed games that last just about 5 minutes, perfect for when you need a quick burst of high-octane action. With 10 unique ship types like Fighters, Medics, and Builders, you’ll uncover layers of strategy that are easy to grasp but challenging to master. row.name: Arobynn: Below The Surface
row.detailed_description: Finally, the multiplayer VR dungeon crawler we've all been waiting for! Complete with floor bosses, traps, and a glowing immersive environment. What can I say except you're welcome! Whether you like it or not, share it on social media to help the genre grow. Game Story Most of the living word and the surface has been destroyed during the Geocubic wars of the past. A devastating technology that crystalizes structures was weaponized and used heavily during the wars leading to the fall and collapse. For centuries, the surface remained barren and hope for the future was lost, but beneath the desolation life began to return. Your adventure begins exploring the extent of Geocubic crystallization Below The Surface. Loot for materials, upgrade your weapons and armors, and work your way farther into the depths. Gameplay -Light from the surface effects the faces of Geocubic crystal and can be used to navigate. [Clever players may also spot braille lettering] -Find the weapons and playstyle that works best for you. -A well timed dash can make all the difference.

row.detailed_description: ℕ𝕖𝕠ℂ𝕒𝕣𝕤 Is a cyberpunk driving game that offers an immersive experience in a futuristic universe. The game's concept is based on creating lines every time your car moves. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 𝔻𝕣𝕚𝕗𝕥 And you must skillfully drift to make these lines deadly for anything that passes through them. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 𝕊𝕒𝕦𝕥 𝕋𝕖𝕞𝕡𝕠𝕣𝕖𝕝𝕤 Unless you use your car's ability to perform temporal jumps to teleport and avoid the lines. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The game offers solo, local cooperative, and online multiplayer modes for up to four players. An interesting feature of the game is the ball system with colors, which adds a competitive and strategic dimension. You must avoid players of a different color to avoid being eliminated, but you can also choose to team up with players wearing the same color. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This also: In summary, NeoCars is an exciting and original cyberpunk driving game that offers an immersive experience in a futuristic universe. row.name: You Have 10 Seconds (2023)
row.detailed_description: You Have 10 Seconds is a fast paced arcade platformer where you’re spawned into a level and given ten seconds to work out how to reach the exit without dying before time runs out. There are 25 Areas which each introduce a new mechanic to the gameplay, eventually creating extremely complex and difficult levels. Master collecting keys, swimming through acid, dodging motion sensors, time traveling, swapping dimensions, and so much more to clear areas as quickly as possible. - Get a rating at the end of each Area depending on how well you performed! Steam achievements for S ranks! - Unlock Steam achievements for completing certain challenges and finding secrets! - A gauntlet of never ending randomized levels from the main game and more, how long can you survive? - Removes all transitions between worlds and menu interactions for seamless gameplay for speedrunners. - Some surprises hidden away that may not be found for a long, long time.
row.short_description: A fast paced platformer where you’re spawned into a level and given 10 seconds to work out how to reach the exit without dying. 25 areas with unique level design mechanics to learn.

row.name: Amalgamare
row.detailed_description: Amalgamare is an episodic indie horror experience with more episodes to come! Controls: WASD or ARROW KEYS to move Z to interact ENTER to talk with NPCs SPACEBAR to Attack In Episode 1 of Amalgamare: In this 2D horror adventure game, play as the protagonist May as she is siphoned into a horrific new world on Halloween night. In a brave feat of love for her cat Matilda, May embarks on a mysterious and gruesome journey through an otherworldly environment where she must utilize clues and interactions to find her way out. Control May’s journey from a mysterious sewer maze into a grotesque mansion while simultaneously unraveling the secretes within. EXPLORE your environment INTERACT with objects and entities FIGHT off monsters DISCOVER the secrets of the mansion Character Descriptions: Often the target of her friend’s ridicule, May is a reclusive young girl who finds solace mainly in her cat Matilda whom she found 6 months prior to the start of the story in a dumpster. May had a humble upbringing with her friends Bea and Max, but as they grew older, her friends began to look down on her for being different and coming from a lower-class family. Bea is a young girl who treats May poorly despite being very close with her from a young age and has grown to exploit their friendship as they have gotten older. After her father got a better-paying job, Bea’s family moved away from May’s neighborhood and began to ditch May for a more popular crowd. Max becomes friends with May and Bea later in their friendship but teams up against May when it comes to ridiculing her for her introverted nature. He is a hotheaded and privileged individual who often does not understand the discrepancies between his situation and the circumstances of others.
row.short_description: In this 2D horror adventure game, play as the protagonist May as she is siphoned into a horrific new world on Halloween night. In a brave feat of love for her cat Matilda, May embarks on a gruesome journey through an otherworldly environment where she must utilize her wits to find her way out.

row.name: Hotel Manibella
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Hotel Manibella, the ultimate horror puzzle game that will leave you trembling with fear and excitement! Step inside the doors of this eerie hotel and prepare to be transported to a world of terror and mystery. As you make your way through the dimly lit hallways, you'll encounter all sorts of creepy creatures and spine-tingling puzzles. Each floor of the hotel brings new challenges and scares, and the deeper you go, the more intense the horror becomes. But don't worry, you're not alone in this terrifying journey. You'll have to use your wits and skills to uncover the secret storyline behind the hotel's dark history and find a way out before it's too late. What sets Hotel Manibella apart from other horror games is its unique art style, which perfectly captures the unsettling atmosphere of the hotel. Every detail, from the creaking floors to the ghastly monsters, has been meticulously crafted to give you an immersive and unforgettable horror experience. So if you're looking for a truly spine-chilling adventure, Hotel Manibella is the game for you. Buy it now and brace yourself for a journey into the unknown. But be warned, once you enter the doors of this hotel, there's no turning back! Initially, you find yourself confined in a room. Upon successfully escaping the first room, you advance to the next level by means of an elevator. In the subsequent level of the building, you must navigate through a maze to elude another monster. The pattern repeats in the following levels where you must also evade a monster and continue to progress.
row.short_description: Get ready for the ultimate horror puzzle game! Check into Hotel Manibella for a spine-chilling experience. With a unique art style and secret storyline, journey through the floors of a haunted hotel, with each level becoming scarier and more intense.

row.name: Traitorous Trek
row.detailed_description: As a party game, we recommend playing with friends at a LAN party or online via voice chat. The game requires one player to host, and supports 4 to 12 people playing at the same time. The Astronaut Objective: Complete all missions or discover all traitors! If all traitors are expelled, or if all missions are completed, the astronaut wins! Astronauts need to complete a series of tasks on the spacecraft, including repairing equipment, cleaning the room, navigation control and so on. Missions help astronauts earn victory points, but also let others know what they're up to, making it easier to deduce the traitor's identity. Astronauts need to respond quickly to neutralize the traitor's sabotage. The ghost after the death of the astronaut can still continue to carry out the task assigned to him, and strive for victory for the astronaut camp. The Traitor Objective: Eliminate the crew or destroy the spaceship! If the number of traitors is greater than or equal to the number of astronauts, the traitors win! Traitors need to sabotage the ship undercover, killing the crew and framing bystanders, causing confusion and suspicion. Traitors can pretend to perform missions to hide their identities, but they also need to avoid being discovered by others. Emergency Meeting When the player walks near the corpse or the emergency meeting button, they can press the report button to call the entire astronauts for an emergency meeting. At this time, the player can tell who he suspects to be a traitor and what information he has. Traitors must try to prove their innocence, or accuse the other crew. A vote can be held in the meeting, and the result of the vote will determine whether to expel a player. The ejected player will be immediately thrown out of the airlock.
row.short_description: Welcome to Traitorous Trek ! Immerse yourself in a universe teeming with deception, betrayal, and nail-biting tension. As a member of an interstellar fleet, your mission is to unravel the hidden shadows lurking within, thwart the conspirators' plans, and safeguard the future of humanity.

row.name: Grand Tanks: WW2 Tank Games
row.detailed_description: Battle of Legendary Tanks Get into the spirit World War II and plunge into realistic 3D tank online battles in the game Grand Tanks! Brave tankers, get ready for an interesting game where strategy and the power of combat vehicles decide everything. A combination of genres Grand Tanks is not just a tank game, it is a combination of such popular genres as action, shooter, arcade and strategy. Show your strategic abilities in exciting online battles where every shot can be decisive. A large selection of equipment Choose from over 25+ legendary tanks, where each tank is a story, each shell is a step towards victory. Upgrade your tanks, test different strategies and dominate in PvP mode. Become a participant in the story Grand Tanks was created for those who appreciate history, who want to become part of the World War II and who like free tank games. With each online battle, you write your page in the history of the great war, and powerful equipment is at your disposal. Use strategy to defeat your opponent faster. Full Immersion in the Battle Magnificent 3D graphics and impressive sound effects take you to the center of the battle, where explosions and gunshots are felt with incredible realism, this free game offers you to become its hero. Fight, Win and Become a Legend Your tanks are waiting for the commander to destroy the enemy on the battlefield. In the online battle mode, the battles become even more extensive. A Team Game Grand Tanks is a team game where your every move is of great importance. Create your own unique tank, participate in rating battles and strategic battles, show your military skills on the fields of the great Second World War.
row.short_description: The game combines the two best sides of gameplay: part from a serious tank simulator and part from exciting and fast arcade battles. Millions of players from all over the world are fighting on the best representatives of tank equipment of the Second World War.

row.name: Antbassador
row.detailed_description: Today is the day The Antbassador will come, to speak words of peace with Her Majesty Queen Antoinette IV. The Kingdom of Antopia has finally grown accustomed to a life without war, and its people are willing to forge an alliance with their one-time foe. If The Antbassador is good and kind, he might well see their worlds connected. Take control of The Antbassador, a giant human finger with a tophat, as he makes his way through a bustling ant colony. His massive bulk makes him strong but unwieldy, and if you're not careful you're liable to squish your tiny hosts! You must use your prodigious digit to help the citizens of Antopia without causing an international incident! CONTROLS: Move the mouse to push yourself here and there. Click the mouse to curl your finger. FEATURES: 5 minutes of fumblecore finger fun! Dozens of NPCs to avoid squishing! Reused assets from Octodad: Dadliest Catch! One climactic duel for the kingdom! WHY DID WE MAKE THIS? Antbassador is part of Young Horses: Free Range, where we collect our smaller side projects and release them for free! Back in 2014 while freshly finished with Dadliest Catch, a portion of the Young Horses team decided to participate in the Ludum Dare game jam #30. The theme for the jam was 'Connected Worlds', which we interpreted fairly loosely. Over the course of 72 hours, we conceived and developed Antbassador using the Horsepower engine. To our delight, Antbassador took first place in the jam, scoring highly in innovation, humor, and fun! So give it a try! It's free, so there's only so disappointed you can be!
row.short_description: Take control of The Antbassador, a giant human finger with a tophat, as he makes his way through a bustling ant colony. You must use your prodigious digit to help the citizens of Antopia without causing an international incident!

Jump, climb, and explore as you work with your friends (or against them) to complete puzzles and reach the end. Help the Familiars along the way, collect, trading cards, and zipline through multiple levels in order to hit the alarm clock and make it to the bus on time! - Embark on a journey with up to three of your friends as you (sugar) rush your way though an exciting 3D Platform puzzle game. Press buttons, gather tasty snacks, unlock the adorable familiars, and zipline through an exciting adventure! CO-OP fun! - Invite up to 3 of your friends to help (or hinder) your progress! (While we don't endorse pushing your friends off a cliff, we cannot deny it's very funny) Friend or Foe? - Battle it out in our competitive modes in a race to the finish! Wake up on time! - Run through the levels and slam the alarm clock buzzer to wake yourself up in time for the bus!

row.name: FFFL: Brutalball Manager
row.detailed_description: Join the Discord About the Game The FFFL is a Franchise Management Simulation game, based mostly on American Football in a Fantasy setting. The goal is to create a game that’s fun to watch and manage with lots of complexity and stat tracking. After decades of hobby programming, I decided to finally release one of my games to the public following all of support from the Legend Bowl community for the Legend Bowl Franchise Mod I created. This game will remain FREE. I made FFFL: Brutalball Manager for myself and family. We've played many seasons together online, and I just want to share the fun. There are no plans for microtransactions, just a Supporter Pack for those that want some extra races and other goodies. Primary Features: 8 v 8 football, players play both sides of the ball Fantasy races: Orcs, elves, dwarves etc. 14 Base and 10 DLC Races with over 70 variants! True Simulations: Simulated games use the exact same engine as games watched at normal speed Total control of all teams: You can assign AI to manage any aspect of the game at any time. This also allows for Multiplayer Hot Seat and Multiplayer Streaming Leagues. Works with Steam Remote Play. Franchise Features: draft, unique off-season free agency, in season events, end of season awards, league records, career stat tracking, Hall of Fame Players have hidden personality traits that influence weekly events and free agency Moddable: In game Team and Player Editor (84 teams already included in the game), Import your own logos, Game variables moddable in game, History, Coach and Schedule file that is fully moddable Why Fantasy Setting? Stories and personalities are an important part of management sims With most sports franchise games it is difficult to connect to all of the players in the league - often there is little to distinguish players beside numbers and a few facial features. Fantasy races make for quicker connections and associations with the players, immediately giving them a bit more personality. Also, adding things like player death is more fitting in a cartoon fantasy setting. This also makes it easier to let go of American football conventions allowing for more rule innovations. The driving goal of this game is for the off-season and game play to foster stories and memories. Coupled with internally consistent stats and recording of major events each league should generate an interesting history. Example stories shared by beta testers: 'Had a funny moment in a game earlier, in a blood thirsty sort of a way. One of my players killed an opponent who had previously spent multiple All-Pro seasons with my club before parting ways with us in the previous off-season. A pretty brutal way to treat a former team mate who left in free agency!' 'The Championship game was 4-4 after 100 plays and it was WILD! Four of my starters were injured including the league MVP. I had a little goblin come off the bench who hadn't played a down all year, only for him to spark the winning touchdown drive. We scored the walk-off title clinching TD 20 plays deep in OT' 'I'm currently in the midst of a truly brutal season! We're 1-5 having made it to the championship game last season and have lost to four teams with a worse overall rating. I've had three starters killed including my star player, a two time league MVP. I'm looking forward to a very high draft pick and a lower team salary at least!'
row.short_description: FFFL: Brutalball Manager is a Franchise Management Simulation game, based mostly on American Football in a Fantasy setting. Take full control of the entire league. Tons of customization, deep stat tracking and unique rules.

row.name: Light Odyssey
row.detailed_description: Light Odyssey is a Boss-Rush Action game about taking down the Colossus of Light. You find yourself at the edge of time in a demised civilization, and the only thing you can rely on is a dimming light. Light Odyssey captures the interplay of light and darkness that strikes out as one of many distinctive graphic features, along with a fast-paced combat system, and an epic storyline in which you have to strike down gigantic enemies. What transpired in these ancient ruins, and what is the origin of the formidable power wielded by the colossus who guard this place? You must defeat the colossi and restore light into the world. Discover dormant colossi in rock, fire, ice, and more. Experience the unique combat system, cinematic, and challenges that require quick decisions. To put an end to these confrontations in the middle of the street, a brilliant inventor proposed to settle the conflicts by triad ball matches. A sport created by this man of science. To do this, he created impulse suits that attracted opponents and allowed them to propel themselves on balls of energy. row.name: ADDRESS1
row.detailed_description: Overview 2D style shoot'em up in which close combat is the primary attack method. With two large swords in her hands, cut her way through enemy bullets and enemy units in a post-apocalyptic world. PreStory She has lost her precious memory. She is heading to the facility where all the records are stored. She seeks that precious memory ...... Whatever the cost...... Circumstances The robots guarding the facility [Canaria] were scheduled to perform a 'military exercise in preparation for an attack on the facility by a foreign enemy'. The robots were divided into two groups ,the attackers and the defenders, and they conducted military exercises and collected the data obtained from the exercises. The matrix AI would build more advanced robots and the operational AI would formulate more advanced strategies. The each of the attackers and defenders developed on their own. ...How many exercises did it take for an exercise to become so fierce that it could no longer be called a exercise? Main Character Appearance Her appearance can only be described as a humanoid robot, but it is unclear whether she is a robot from the start or a human who received cyborgisation surgery in order to adapt to the harsh environment, as seen in [the unchosen humans] after [Jocelyn]. To assume that she was a robot from the start, she has some aspects that would not lead you to believe that she was a robot, and to assume that she was originally human, she has some aspects that would not lead you to believe that she was human. It is considered to be a female or female-typed robot due to its female-like facial features. Her entire body is made up of parts that are clearly mismatched (mainly for weapons equipment), so it is thought that a number of combat-use cyborgisation surgeries have been carried out. She is missing parts of her memory and is not sure whether the name Penryn is her real name. She uses this name [Penryn] because she barely remembers 'being taught to call herself [Penryn] that for convenience'. Due to this lack of memory, it is also unclear whether she is a robot or a human being who has undergone cyborgisation surgery. Her hair is silver in color, but this is thought to be a result of decolourisation of the blonde hair. In fact, blonde hair is also found on the inner hair of the head, which is less affected by the outside world. She wears a green shirt jacket and a navy blue skirt. These are thought to be linked to her identity, but details are unknown. It is thought that these may relate to missing memories. Weapons She uses modified weapons from [comedians] who have been shot down in past military exercises. One particular weapon is the large sword held in both her hands, which can neutralise [Comedian]'s energy weapon and barrier, and converts them into energy material. She uses these two large swords as a way of either attacking or defending. She easily swings two large swords single-handedly, which are not appropriate for her body size, and the fact that she does not even lose her balance is thought to be a result of combat-use cyborgification. Origin Unknown. miscellaneous Height: 152.2 cm Weight: 158 kg Features Game is made up of total of 5+α levels. Genre is shoot'em up, but the combat style is mainly close combat with large sword slashes. Stage-clear style that makes it easy to try again even if you fail. An adventurous story is unlocked as you progress stages. 'HOW TO PLAY' which is a basic operation guide. 'PRACTICE ROOM' where the player can freely control their character.
row.short_description: 2D style shoot'em up in which close combat is the primary attack method. With two large swords in her hands, cut her way through enemy bullets and enemy units in a post-apocalyptic world.

row.name: Snakedate
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Charmr, the premier dating app for snakes! Looking for love? Cruise around the club and wrap around your dates to show your affection! When the Charmr app pops up, you'll see a potential date. If you think they're compatible, swipe right and go find them in the club. Be warned, you'll abandon your current date if you have one! Every successful date is worth a certain Charmr Score based on compatibility. High score dates will need more coils around them to be satisfied. Relationships today are about volume, so get as high a score as you can! CONTROLS: Left Mouse (Left Arrow, A) Turn left, Swipe left on Charmr Right Mouse (Right Arrow, D) Turn Right, Swipe right on Charmr Middle Mouse (Escape, Space, S) Pause/Unpause FEATURES: Physics-based speed-dating arcade action! 11 lonely horses to date! Theoretically infinite replayability! Also an infinitely long snake (no relation to the snake from Snake)! WHY DID WE MAKE THIS? Snakedate is part of Young Horses: Free Range, where we collect our smaller side projects and release them for free! Back in 2015 we took a break from developing Bugsnax to try our hooves at Ludum Dare game jam #34. The two themes for the jam were 'Two Button Controls' and 'Growing'. Over a hectic 72 hours, we developed Snakedate using the Horsepower engine. It was a modest success, scoring third in the humor category for the jam! So give it a try! It's free, so there's only so disappointed you can be!
row.short_description: Welcome to Charmr, the premier dating app for snakes! Looking for love? Cruise around the club and wrap around your dates to show your affection!

row.name: Blood of a Demon

But beware, if you think you are alone in here, think again because you are not. A demon lies in the rooms waiting for your presence and will not let you out easily. This game contains 5 rooms for you to try and escape. But even when freed, your job is not over yet. SEE NO EVIL The demon is invisible, however, you have a radar to help you, use it wisely. HEAR NO EVIL The demon is completely silent, you can not hear it so be careful. SPEAK NO EVIL The plushie wants to help you but it can not speak, it can only whistle.
row.short_description: You have woken up inside of an escape room, however, you are not by yourself in here, for a demon lies inside of these rooms waiting for your arrival. Can you escape? 5 rooms, 1 escape.

row.name: Slime Knight
row.detailed_description: You are a humble slime that has recently found refuge for you and your family in a small village. Everything seemed peaceful...until a gigantic wurm, thought to be a myth, emerges from the deep underground and devours the entire civilization in one enormous gulp! Separated from your family, you awaken inside the beast's maw, and discover the corpse of a knight wearing a suit of armor. After imbuing the corpse with your slimy essence, you are able to deftly maneuver around the hostile creatures that lurk around you, as well as fight back with your stretchy, toxic appendages! Your family must be deeper inside the belly of this beast. Will you be able to fight your way through and rescue them before it's too late? Take Control of Slime Knight! The slightest touch of your gooey essence will damage almost anything it touches. Use this to your advantage and take enemies by surprise by stretching your arm out, and whipping it in their direction! Swing, Punch, Grab, Throw, Survive! Your extendable arm is deceptively simple, but offers you a bevy of tools to handle a variety of situations. Swing your arm through hordes of enemies to damage them en masse. Punch creatures out of your way with your first. Or, grab them and throw them at their allies to really stir some chaos! Use it to its full extent to tackle any challenge that comes your way! Devour the Devoured As a slime, you have one more trick up your sleeve that could turn the tides of battle. If you deal enough damage to an enemy while it is clutched in your gooey fist, you can finish them off by devouring them completely. Doing so will grant you unique abilities that could help get you out of a desparate situation. Different enemies grant different abilities when devoured, so be sure to experiment and plan your targets strategically!
row.short_description: Use an extendable slime arm to “dissolve”, punch, grab, and throw enemies in order to save your slime brethren and navigate through the decrepit insides of an ancient Worm in this top-down hoard battler.

row.name: Sol: Last Light

Learn to control your newly discovered power to harness the energy of the sun and battle against robots as you climb higher up the mountain to find your captured sister. Play through 5 unique levels as you unlock key abilities to defeat enemies. Uncover the secrets of this shattered world and find clues that will lead you toward saving your sister. “The world is scarred from the sins of the past. The Sun has dimmed darker than ever recorded, lowering the atmosphere of Earth to apocalyptic conditions. Humans now roam the Wastes of what was the North American continent as groups of nomads, scavenging the landscape for any means of survival.” - John Black IV

Learn to control your newly discovered power to harness energy from the sun and battle against robots on your journey up the mountain to find your captured sister. Made by students at Full Sail University.

row.name: Byte Wars
row.detailed_description: Byte Wars is a strategic top-down rocket shooter where every shot counts. Take control of a spacecraft, rotate to aim, and launch a single rocket at a time, carefully navigating the pull of nearby planets that warp your trajectory in real time. Players pilot a ship and fire one rocket at a time, requiring careful aim, as gravity from nearby planets dynamically alters rocket trajectories. Think before you shoot: accuracy are the keys to victory. 🛰️ Key Features: Online Multiplayer – Compete in real-time Elimination and Team Deathmatch modes Gravity Mechanics – Plan your rockets around planetary fields that curve and twist their paths Player Progression – Earn score and climb the leaderboard Customization – Equip your ship with visual cosmetics and power-ups for a personal edge Byte Wars offers a unique, thoughtful twist on arcade shooting action.

row.name: My Life of Repayment

The player will play the role of a cat who has just graduated from college, working around to pay off debts. Manage finances, time and physical state Players need to properly allocate time and money, replenish vigor, saturation and mood after work, and repay debts regularly. Use the remaining money to buy food, or items that can improve your work efficiency. Diverse work experience Archery Performer: physical simulation gameplay that emphasizes operation Drone Operator: A roguelite TD Pancake Cook: cooking simulation with reaction capability + time management
row.short_description: If you don't work, you will eat dirt! To pay off your loans, you will take on various jobs. Make pancakes, perform archery, and operate a space drone! Enjoy a changeable work experience in your busy life!

row.name: 2023: Alien Bugs Invade Earth
row.detailed_description: ***************************************** ***IMPORTANT UPDATE ABOUT THIS GAME*** ***************************************** NEWEST UPDATE: new content is arriving! Look for 2024: Aliens Are Coming This game currently uses the Unity game engine. Due to Unity's recent behavior at the corporate level, development on this game is halted until it can be ported to a new game engine. This is a massive undertaking that will not happen quickly, but it must be done. Much more content is planned, but the release of new content will be delayed until 2024 because of this. (If you're reading this after 2024, then a new game has been released in a different engine) ***************************************** ***************************************** ** Based on the Kindle novel: '2023: Alien Bugs Invade Earth' ** A threat is brewing on the outer reaches of the Solar system, and when it makes landfall in 2023, chaos will erupt worldwide. Panic will grip nearly everyone...except for you! In this story-driven 2D casual platform shooter, run, jump, and shoot across levels as you try to take down the alien Insectoids. Since their exoskeleton armor is 3 inches thick, things might not go well for you on the first or second try... Keep at it, and the end of each level contains text-based debriefings where you might discover what secrets humanity has been up to since the 1947 Roswell crash, and those secrets will help you gain upgrades in weapons and armor to turn the tide against the Insectoid invaders in the more challenging levels. In the current early access version, the player can expect: -To run/jump/shoot alien insectoid invaders on three 2D levels -To read through visual-novel-styled beginnings and endings for each level outlining more information about what is going on during the invasion. -Most sounds, music, and visual backgrounds already implemented -Alien insectoid implemented with basic AI & sounds -Placeholder sprite art for player/hero character PLANNED ADDITIONS: -Intermediate story ending (alien UFO and debriefing about government secrets) -Later in the game, you will take the fight to the skies and into space on a 2D rail shooter in your top-secret space fighter. Your target is the hive queen mastermind behind the invasion!
row.short_description: Why are alien insectoids invading Earth in 2023? This narrative driven 2D shooter pits you against a seemingly hopeless battle against the invading Insectoids. How will you (and Earth) manage to survive? What hidden technological, historical, and spiritual secrets will you discover as a result?

row.name: A Hint of Purple
row.detailed_description: A Hint of Purple is a short visual novel about queer love and art. Follow Maya, a once-celebrated painter now paralyzed, as she struggles to accept her new reality and its effects on her relationship. Argue with your Prefrontal Cortex, insult an art critic, befriend the elderly. A short but sweet experience that respects your time. (40min-1hr) Engage with Maya's inner struggles by conversing with her Prefrontal Cortex, providing a unique and introspective look at her mental and emotional state. An emotionally rich queer story told in the form of a visual novel. Hear from a diverse cast of characters, each with their own unique stories and perspectives.
row.short_description: A short visual novel about queer love and art. Follow Maya, a once-celebrated painter now paralyzed, as she struggles to accept her new reality and its effects on her relationship. Argue with your Prefrontal Cortex, insult an art critic, befriend the elderly.

row.name: Mystic Mischief

Rank up to become the best thief in the land. You will collect hats that will give you special abilities to acquire treasure and ward of the dragons. Experience the carnival, an abandoned castle, and a cave. Discover the tales of how the dragons came to live in their homes. Follow the heart-warming story of how a bird and human can band together to become the best thieves. Will the wizard finally grow up and become the man he should have been? Or will he continue his loser ways and achieve nothing? Play as a bird that flies around dangerous creatures, stealing high value items while fulfilling your kleptomaniac desires. Collect or use items to defend yourself from enemies. You can also poop on enemies to keep enemies away!
