row.name: Isop0dyssey
row.detailed_description: Dive into the trash-infested power fantasy of being a parasitic isopod on the seabed and gallop your fish steed in underground street races. Welcome to Abyss City: the last link in a chain of seabed cities stretching from the shores to the unexplored depths of the ocean. Built on the edge of a deep sea trench, Abyss City is a polluted metropolis fueled by the garbage and waste of the world above. As a parasitic isopod with the ability to ride fish, you are part of the logistics workforce that keeps the city running, but you are also an oppressed minority in a society dominated by higher isopods. Break free from the cycle of oppression and win your way to the top of the underground street racing scene. Features including, but not limited to: -Realistic fish handling & power drifting -Immersive factory shift mechanics -A party platter of discoloured isopods to find & talk to -Uncover secrets & mysteries of Abyss City, the world above and below
row.short_description: trash-infested power fantasy crawling sim with racing & crustacean elements set in the gritty, segregated world of ocean floor society

row.name: Chronicles of Vipers
row.detailed_description: Chronicles of Vipers is a remake-demake first-person shooter inspired by old 8-bit and 16-bit console games, as well as VHS-era movies. You play as a secret CIA agent, Steven 'The Viper' Rogers. Your task is to free all your colleagues from captivity in different parts of Colombia, as well as to destroy a new threat - the 'Free Drug Seekers' cartel. The game includes 'old school mechanics': - Only two types of weapons; - Several types of enemies; - 6 different locations inspired by VHS era movies; - Simple plot; - Dynamic gameplay; - Stylized graphics for the zero era. Help agent 'Viper' in the case of liberating friends and eliminating a drug den in the territory of Colombia. For this, you have a pistol and a machine gun, as well as the ability to open any door. So - act!
row.short_description: Chronicles of Vipers is a remake-demake first-person shooter inspired by old 8-bit and 16-bit console games, as well as VHS-era movies.
row.notes: This game is about an agent who fights against a drug cartel. This is why there are references to drugs in the game. The game does not show the methods of production and use of drugs. The game indicates the negative impact of drugs on society.

row.name: El Dorado: The Golden City Builder - Prologue
row.detailed_description: CHECK OUT MORE GAMES FROM OUR FRIENDS About the Game This is the prologue of our upcoming El Dorado: The Golden City Builder - the prologue is just part of the full game that will let you get to know the game before its official release and it's completely free. Build the mightiest and most expansive empire of Yucatan Your aim in the game of El Dorado: The Golden City Builder - Prologue, is to create the mightiest empire of the whole Yucatan peninsula. Develop your early small settlement into a city bustling with life and dripping with gold. Build, develop, manage your resources and appease the Gods. Dominate other newly rising or existing settlements of other families through conquest or peaceful talks. Diplomacy or blood… it is your choice. Become the architect of your mythical city As the Leader, you will be responsible for every building built on your territory, such as sawmills, temples, housing, barracks and many more. Skillfully plan your city as every path may play a vital role in managing your city. Well-planned zones of your empire will have a special impact on the proper and quickly develop your city. The fate of the citizens depends on you. Gather resources There are many resources on your territory crucial for the development, conquest and keeping your empire stable. Some will be used for daily life, other resources will have a chance to become part of a variety of weapons – so vital to plan your skirmishes. Offer sacrifices to the Gods to earn their favor… Without sacrifices, there is no game based on a mythical ancient tribe, right? God's favor is one of the basic and important quests in the game. Thanks to their approval your city will not only develop freely but also expand its borders and acquire greater military and political capabilities. Satisfy your Gods to avoid their wrath. You can make sacrifices through your Priest in places of worship such as temples. Choose an appropriate slave, organize a grand festival in honor of the chosen Deity and perform secret dark rituals to the delight of the audience. In return, you can expect divine protection from different cataclysms or an increase in yields from your farms and fields. … or prepare for their wrath Gold, riches, extraordinary development… it can’t be that easy. Each repeating or grand one-time festival requires sacrifices. If you happen to forget about worship, the Deities will send many cataclysms to your empire or other problems that will hinder your development. Some will be more or less taxing, but it is always better to evade a lone lightning bolt striking your home and setting the city ablaze or a huge tornado wreaking havoc in your city. Plan well what and when you offer your Gods as no mortal has survived their wrath. Conquer and enslave neighboring people Every gold is paid for in blood and war is the easiest way to get rich fast. Plunder resources, earn slaves and conquer new land needed for development. Gods are not the only worry, there are other peoples and tribes aiming for the same goal as you. Organize military expeditions, and reinforce the war front or defense lines with resources, which will help in your skirmishes with the enemy. Skillful resource management during war will have an impact on whether your people will come back as victorious conquerors bearing gifts or losers. Fight for the title of the mightiest ruler of the Golden City, El Dorado! Do not lose yourself in pride.
row.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. El Dorado - Prologue is a strategy city-building game in which you plan, build and develop your settlement to conquer Jukatan and earn the title of The Golden City. Become a leader, whom even Gods will bow to.

row.name: Food Fighter Clicker Games
row.detailed_description: FOOD FIGHTER CLICKER Food Fighter Clicker is a clicker game to become the best mukbang food fighter in the world by eating fast food and improving your skills. Tap Tap and be the fastest clicker in the world! DAILY GIFT! Every day you play Food Fighter Clicker you will get an amazing reward. Eat your favorite food as fast as possible in this mukbang clicker game. Tap and get your fingers ready for this mukbang game to click and tap tap tap fast to unlock amazing skins and many different types of food in these clicker games. EAT 10 EGGS IN 30 SECONDS! Through the different levels of this food fighter clicker game, you must complete amazing challenges like a figher to have a great time in these clicker games and discover all that Food Fighter Clicker has in store for you. MAIN FEATURES ● Strengthen various skills such as eating power, chewing, mouth size and stomach size. ● Tap tap to unlock tons of food to make your table more abundant. ● Collect a variety of items such as hair, outfits, dining tables, chairs, furniture and more. ● Test your skills to see how many you can eat in a challenge mukbang.
row.short_description: Food Fighter Clicker is a clicker game to become the best food fighter in the world by eating fast food and improving your skills. Tap Tap and be the fastest clicker in the world!

row.name: SWOLLEN TO BURSTING UNTIL I AM DISAPPEARING ON PURPOSE
row.detailed_description: Just recently, in 'Vomit', a flying saucer appears. SWOLLEN TO BURSTING is a weirdo RPG in which something is very wrong. A flying saucer has crash-landed in town, but it's Thursday so you have to go to work at the post office. THE COOL FEATURES OF SWOLLEN TO BURSTING ORACULAR GAMEPLAY! You're free to do what you'd like in SWOLLEN TO BURSTING . Engage in various misadventures in order to gain access to more places. Find a way into the flying saucer and solve the mysteries within (If you want)! There are many strange secrets to discover. We bet you can't find them all! EXPLORATION IN THE TOWN OF VOMIT! Enjoy humorous and sincere interactions with a variety of fun characters! Meet and get to know everybody over the course of a day. Dine in at the café, or maybe fish up at the pond! CUTTING EDGE 3D 'GRAPHICS' & AN ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK! SWOLLEN TO BURSTING features a variety of diverse, explorable locations. As you progress through the story, time will move forward in town. The weather and lighting will change throughout the in-game day. OVER A DOZEN 'EFFECTS' TO COLLECT! Collectable 'Effects' can be used in a multitude of ways: Level up to get past enemies! Obtain clues to help you progress! Make cosmetic changes to your character! And maybe more!(?) FANS OF THESE WILL LOVE SWOLLEN TO BURSTING : Strange JRPGs such as Yume Nikki & Chulip Old JRPGs such as Final Fantasy IV & Mother The Beatles' self titled album Hideaki Anno movies And other stuff but we don't wanna give too much away SWOLLEN TO BURSTING UNTIL I AM DISAPPEARING ON PURPOSE is just a few hours long. You could probably play it before going to bed two or three times and be finished. We hope you will play the game and have a good time.
row.short_description: SWOLLEN TO BURSTING is a weirdo RPG in which something is very wrong. A flying saucer has crash landed in town, but it's Thursday so you have to go to work at the post office.
row.notes: Children and those sensitive to text and themes involving mental illness, panic attacks, gender dysphoria, sex, violence, self-harm, and suicide are advised not to play this game.

row.name: A Collection of Mini-Games
row.detailed_description: In this collection of mini-games you can experience four different scenarios, each with different styles of gameplay, including resource management and avoiding the enemies trying to catch you. None of these short games have nearly enough content to be a full game, but they were all fun for me to create and play, so I wanted to let others play them, as well. In these four mini-games you can take the role of an Immortal Dragon God trapped in a prison and plotting revenge, a young apprentice to a powerful wizard who undergoes a dangerous test, a young boy who has to overcome a challenging journey, and a... rock. Yes... a rock. You'll see. All four games have simple controls and their own unique stories. I hope to continue making fun games in the future using everything I've been learning so far, and would genuinely appreciate honest feedback.
row.short_description: This is just a handful of mini-games that I created as I learn how to use and just play around with my RPGMaker. I created these just for fun, but was happy enough with the results that I wanted to let them be played by people to get their opinions, or any advice they may have.

row.name: Yunoia
row.detailed_description: Yunoia is a UCF, student-led, puzzle-platforming game project. Summary: Iris, a light spirit, tends to the color of her world with a prismatic mask. One day, darkness envelops the skies and it begins to vacuum away the colors of her beloved Eden. Set out on a journey together to restore this world by dispersing the iridescence that can be found within. Features: Single Player Immersive Story 5 captivating levels, including tutorial Unique Mechanics: Grappling Pulsing Cloning Original Soundtrack You: Solve puzzles and navigate this world to bring back the light to it.
row.short_description: Iris, a light spirit, tends to the color of her world with a prismatic mask. One day, darkness envelops the skies and it begins to vacuum away the colors of her beloved Eden. Set out on a journey together to restore this world by dispersing the iridescence that can be found within.

row.name: 迷宫坦克大战
row.detailed_description: Hello, this is an experimental project with a small gameplay. The gameplay is as straightforward as the name suggests, manipulating your character through the maze, destroying walls to find each other, or hiding sneak attack !! The outcome of the duel is used to decide who will check out or wash the dishes... or other rock-paper-scissors can also solve the problem. Although you can choose to practice with the AI, we still recommend that you pull a friend to play with you :D Of course, this is not because the AI is too difficult to beat~ Move: A, W, S, D Rotating lenses: Q, E Fire: Right mouse button Smoke grenades: Spaces Hi players, when you see this description, our servers have been shut down due to experimental and small team reasons. We're sorry you won't be able to use the matchmaking feature, but the ontology's adversarial AI mode still exists, so thank you very much for your interest and willingness to take the time to take a look at our little ideas. Sorry again, thanks again. If you have any ideas or questions, you are welcome to join the QQ group: 833422358 Hope you have fun and have fun hunting (or being hunted)!
row.short_description: Control the tank to search the maze for your enemies. Obstacles block the field of view, which you can use to hide, or destroy to create a better view and direction of fire. While firing a cannon can also give away your position, it can also be used properly as bait to attract a target.

row.name: Disco Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Prologue is a part of the full version of Disco Simulator and is completely free. The most important is that prologue allows you to get into the world of Disco Simulator so you will be fully ready before the final product release! Select a manager At the beginning of the game, you will be able to choose your manager. Each of them has their own unique skills to manage different aspects of the club. Decide in which direction you want to develop your club. The skills of the manager you choose will bear fruit in further gameplay, for example: bonuses for bartenders, organizing concerts, or taking care of customer satisfaction. The choice is yours! Choose your club There is a wide selection of clubs waiting for you in the game and each of them poses different challenges and has unique victory conditions. Clubs are located in various places: a village, a small town, the center of a big city. Choose wisely and enter the club legend scene! Care for your customers Your success depends on customer satisfaction. Every guest has their own individual needs, which you must meet in order to keep them in the club. Do they prefer elegant drinks in stylish cocktail glasses? Or maybe they want to dance to the best hits until dawn? Your job will be to make sure that the music, atmosphere and service meet their expectations. Take care of your customers and thanks to this they will recommend your club to others, thus increasing your reputation. React to unexpected events - a fight in the club, a clogged toilet or a drunk customer, you will have your hands full! Organize events We have the club ready and the best staff so it's time to party! Organizing spectacular concerts by bands and DJs is the key to increasing the recognition of your club. Invite celebrities to a stage that will not only attract crowds of fans, but also allow you to gain more customers. Themed events, special performances and exceptional concerts will raise the temperature on the dance floor and attract new customers. Feel the thrill of your parties becoming events that are talked about everywhere! Develop your club In Disco Simulator, the development of your club is a key element that will allow you to reach the peak level of club glory. Spend your money on a variety of upgrades that will make your club a real paradise for music and dance lovers. In the game, you will be able to improve every aspect of the club - furniture, decorations, music equipment, lighting or sound system. Also, do not forget about hiring employees, choose from among the available and create the best event that will be talked about for years!
row.short_description: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. Disco Simulator: Prologue is a game where you play the role of the owner and manager of a music club. Buy equipment, sound system, lighting and decide on the appearance of your club. Make money and have fun!

row.name: The Severn Rising 2222
row.detailed_description: Severn Rising 2222 is an ambitious imagining through gaming, of what the City of Worcester, might look like 200 years in the future, where Worcester has been flooded, humans have left, and the city is consumed by nature. Who were the humans? Why did they have to leave? Where are they now? In the style of a classic point and click adventure you guide a swan and a duck as they explore the abandoned city. Talk to characters and solve inventory puzzles as you attempt to uncover the mystery. The Severn Rising 2222 Features * Hand drawn illustration by artist Sarah Millin. * Classic point & click interface. * Fiendish puzzles. * 20 unique locations to explore. * A cast of characters to meet & interact with. * Fully voiced dialogue. This is a short game originally intended for public display at locations around Worcester. Suitable for all ages. Dominated by the River Severn which flows through it, Worcester is already at the mercy of nature, and regularly experiences flooding which leads to residents and wildlife alike, modifying their lifestyle. The Severn Rising 2222 project, challenges the player to learn more about climate change, pollution and the direct impact it will have on their community. The game brings together beautiful, vibrant depictions of nature and Worcester’s landmarks by artist Sarah Millin, with the game design skills of Paradise Multimedia. The game was developed through a series of creative workshops held in heritage, cultural and environmental venues, across Worcester during 2022. The workshops encouraged participation from a wide demographic of Worcester residents and explored environmental impact through art. The voices and ideas of the residents of Worcester, form the basis of the Severn Rising illustrations and animation and the engagement of the community was central to placing the project at the heart of The City. An exciting legacy of the workshops were the messages in a bottle written by the workshop participants. The messages provide a tantalising prediction of how participants envisage Worcester to look in 200 years’ time. A key feature of the game is the beautiful Worcester locations that the characters visit, which are based upon the partner sites and buildings which the artists felt held a special interest to the community. There is a real array of architecture in Worcester’s skyline, and this is reflected in the mixture of Tudor, Victorian and Brutalist building that are highlighted in Severn Rising. Now you have read all about the development of the project, why not be transported 200 years into the future in flooded Worcester and experience The Severn Rising 2222 for yourself? The Severn Rising 2222 project has been made possible through generous support of the Arts Council England, Elmley Foundation & Worcester City Council.
row.short_description: A graphic adventure set 200 years in the future in the flooded city of Worcester. Who were the humans? Why did they have to leave? Where are they now? Guide a swan and a duck as they attempt to find out.

row.name: Golf with the Lads
row.detailed_description: Golf with the Lads is a virtual reality sandbox minigolf game that offers an immersive experience for players to enjoy.
row.short_description: A short project aimed at bringing a fun minigolf experience to VR for free!

row.name: Project CarnEvil
row.detailed_description: Project CarnEvil is the ultimate VR Horror carnival game, transporting players to a ghostly realm filled with dread and thrills! Prepare to be immersed in an atmospheric landscape as you explore the terrifying carnival. The only way out of this sinister carnival's grip is to accomplish a series of challenges. Can you survive the four terrifying carnival games and free the lost plushies trapped inside each? The most difficult challenge of all awaits you in the tent of terror. The land's insane clown king is waiting for you, ready to put your bravery and determination to the test. Are you strong enough to defeat the clown and escape this nightmare? Keep in mind that the stakes are high, and failure is not an option. Will you be the one to break free from this twisted carnival, or will you become one of the lost souls? You have a choice! Features: 1. Haunting atmosphere: Project CarnEvil immerses players in a dark and eerie world, complete with spooky music, dim lighting, and unsettling carnival sounds. This game is not for the faint of heart! 2. Terrifying challenges: To escape the carnival, players must beat four terrifying carnival games, each with their own unique set of challenges. From shooting to ring tosses, these games will push players to their limits. 3. Sinister clown boss: The final challenge in Project CarnEvil is facing off against the mad clown ruler of the carnival. This boss battle is intense and requires skill and strategy to defeat. 4. VR immersion: Project CarnEvil is designed for VR, which means players will feel like they're inside the haunted carnival. This level of immersion adds to the intensity and scares of the game. 5. Replayability: With multiple stages and a variety of challenges, Project CarnEvil has high replay value. Players can try to beat their own scores or compete against friends to see who can escape the carnival the fastest. 6. Thrilling storyline: Discover the hidden pages within the game to uncover the horrors of the carnival.
row.short_description: Project CarnEvil, the ultimate VR horror experience, invites you to confront your fears. This game will test you to your limits with difficult carnival games and a crazed clown to banish. Will you be able to overcome your fear and escape alive?

row.name: Titor's Time Traveling Tale
row.detailed_description: Step into the shoes of a medieval physicist studying the theory of time travel in 'Titor's Time Traveling Tales,' the VR escape room game. While conducting experiments on a strange artifact, you accidentally activate it and find yourself transported to a server room in the distant future. Dive into this Demo VR Escape Room game where you must do a series of puzzles/activities to continue. Find the mystery behind your untimely traveling and Use your VR headset and controllers to navigate around the world to solve simple puzzles. Pull levers, push buttons, and find various objects to complete objectives given to continue. Assets used in the game: Medieval Level: Omni Studio Server Room: iPoly3D Dark Room: Meshtint Studio
row.short_description: Step into the shoes of a medieval physicist studying the theory of time travel in 'Titor's Time Traveling Tales,' the VR escape room game. While conducting experiments on a strange artifact, you accidentally activate it and find yourself transported to a server room in the distant future.

row.name: Symphony of Souls
row.detailed_description: Set in the Greek Underworld, Symphony of Souls is a single-player, first-person platformer with music-inspired gameplay. You, as Orpheus, will rush through the Underworld, attempting to get to the end while platforming and solving puzzles to the beats of the music. Explore the unnatural lands of the Underworld. The lands of the dead are irregular to the minds of mortals, where each region presents Orpheus with different challenges. The constant shifts in the locale will constantly keep both you and Orpheus on your toes, as you explore the modern retelling of the Greek tragedy. Throughout the Symphony of Souls, you can expect: Rhythm is Everything: Every action that you can take on the beat will reward you, allowing you to flow through the level with ease and unlock more and more of our original soundtrack as a representation of your skills. Advanced Player Movement: Orpheus can’t rely simply on his musical talents to take on the land of the dead. He must be able to flow through the levels with magically gifted movement. With a combination of running across walls, dashing through the air, and even a grapple hook within his lyre, the only thing that could stop Orpheus may be Hades himself. Lastly, Orpheus is a musician who weaves songs to life, and you will be as well! With that in mind, the music system in Symphony of Souls is interactive, where your performance affects it directly. As you progress through the levels, you will slowly build the music by performing actions on the beat, building upon the songs to show the full glory of the original soundtrack! Symphony of Souls is a work of love. With a team spread across five different programs at LaSalle College Vancouver, the gameplay and story is an effort to show the creative take we hope to bring to our mediums of choice. Due to restrictions in budget and time, it encompasses only the first two levels of our project in this form: a free experience where you can enjoy and share with your friends!
row.short_description: Save your beloved from the clutches of the God of the Dead! Symphony of Souls is a rhythm-based platformer about the Greek myth of Orpheus. Traverse the Underworld attempting to reach your goal to the beats of the music. Your performance also affects it, unlocking more elements the better you play!

row.name: J-Town: A Visual Novel
row.detailed_description: J-Town: A Visual Novel offers an easily accessible avenue to learn more about the ins and outs of Japanese American culture. With hand-drawn art inspired by the the real world counterparts in San Francisco, San Jose, and Los Angeles, explore our J-Town in this small slice-of-life narrative adventure. Talk to the community about real world issues like gentrification, cultural appropriation, and spatial preservation. And equally as important as the problems we face, come celebrate with us as we talk about cultural identity, our history, and more! The Plot A corporate contractor has tasked you with infiltrating the quiet neighborhood of J-Town and finding a weakness for him to move in and open up a new store. However, as you meet the locals, they challenge you to see this community for what it really is. Residents from all walks of life come together to share what makes this place so special. Visit shops and establishments and dip your toe into the rich experiences that bring our real world Japantowns to life!
row.short_description: A friendly crash course in Japanese American history, culture, and community! Inspired by the real stories of the three historic Japantowns of California: San Francisco, San Jose, and Los Angeles's Little Tokyo.

row.name: Bucket Brawl: Ahlman Edition
row.detailed_description: Join us on Discord Bucket Brawl: Ahlman Edition is an early student project version of our upcoming game Bucket Brawl . Follow us on social media or sign up to our newsletter to stay up to date on the development of our upcoming game. About the Game Bucket Brawl: Ahlman Edition is a frantic couch multiplayer about animal toys seeking to recycle each other in a world of plastic and raining buckets. In Bucket Brawl, you'll engage in epic battles using buckets as your primary weapon. Toss buckets at your plastic friends, knock them off ledges, convert them into reusable material or send them on a train to hell. Strive to be the last toy standing. Choose from a variety of adorable animal characters and customize them with your preferred colors. Immerse yourself in exciting environments with map-specific mechanics. Don't kick the bucket, kick your friends' ass. It's time to make the world a better place. It's raining buckets! Watch out for buckets falling from the sky. Pick up buckets and throw them at your friends. Buckets rebound from walls and obstacles so use them as your advantage. Got bucketed? It's not over yet. Spam the throw button as fast as you can to get free before your friends get rid of you! Goodbye! Push your plastic friends into traps or off the stage. Just converting waste into reusable material. Nothing personal. Watch out for golden buckets! Hitting a player with a golden bucket will instantly send them to the heavens. The longer the rounds get, the higher the chance for golden buckets to appear. 7 maps with their unique environments and obstacles Don't have enough controllers? Bucket Brawl supports 2 players on the same keyboard (WASD and arrow keys) Supports Xbox controllers and other popular PC gamepads Bombastic soundtrack
row.short_description: A fast-paced arena fighter where animal toys seek to recycle each other in a world of plastic and raining buckets. Throw buckets on the heads of other players, push them off a ledge and be the last toy standing.

row.name: CREAM SODA CLUB
row.detailed_description: Jazz up the VR party in all possible ways. Make the dance floor burst with satisfied patrons and pay attention to their desires. The more happy faces there are, the more music and development opportunities you will discover! Key features Start an epic rave in a huge VR club Observe the mood of your patrons and fulfill their wishes The audience gives you likes for the atmosphere. You spend them on sound, light, and decor Arrange the club space right in the middle of the headliner performance Discover a new track from the latest album of the popular band CREAM SODA on each new level of the game
row.short_description: Welcome to the world of fantastic parties with CREAM SODA! In this universe, suggested by the ideas of the band, you are the promoter of the club where their new album is premiering. The success of the party is in your hands — arrange a complete soldout!

row.name: Garage Flipper: Prologue
row.detailed_description: The Prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. You're an ambitious contractor with a passion for repair shops. The task seems simple, but is it really? Will you handle demolishing walls without having the roof collapse on your head? Can you give them a nice, even paint job? Starting's always tricky but remember – practice makes perfect! CLEAN UP Many people treat their garage like a dumpster and, unfortunately, before you can get to decorating the interior, you'll first have to liberate it from old junk. Rusty mufflers, used-up batteries, shelves of empty cans, as well as old fridges and washing machines are just some of the things people tend to stuff and forget in their garages. Sort the recovered materials or try to sell them to scrap collectors. REMAKE THE GARAGE Go for your hammer and bust open the old walls! You can make rooms bigger by building new ones and installing new roofs and floors. Choose your preferred paint color and soon you'll see new life breathed into the garage! BUY NEW FURNITURE Place a brand new workbench and tool cabinets, as a more expensive preset, or create a collection yourself by laying out tools individually. Remember that everything needs its proper spacing and placement.
row.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version. Garage Flipper: Prologue is a game where you get to be a builder and renovator of garages and car repair shops. Your task is to complete jobs and build up your empire by buying and restoring old facilities.

row.name: The Picture of Café au lait
row.detailed_description: The picture of café au lait Introduction The Picture of Café au lait is a visual novel game that makes the players feel immersed in the story and the characters. You will experience the story through the first-person perspective of the main character in the story named 'Takagi'. This game allows the player to make decisions and has multiple endings. Your crucial choices will change the conclusion of the story. Synopsis This is the story of a 3rd high school student named 'Takeomi Takagi', the only member remaining in the Art club because of his wrongdoings in the past. His goal is to win the art competition before his graduation from high school. He meets “Itsuki Eimi”, the cheerful junior high school girl in the Basketball Club, because she ruins his painting that he will send to the competition by accidentally running into it. This is the coming-of-age story and love story between two people who have opposite personalities. They both have their dreams and face their obstacles together. “Takagi”, the strict and sharp-tongued yet kind senior who tries to help Eimi achieve her dreams to redeem himself from his past faults. “Eimi”, the cheerful junior who always hides her sadness, wishes to become a full member of the basketball team. Will they achieve their dreams or give up? What future awaits them is for you to decide. Main Characters Itsuki Eimi “I don’t want to lose to myself again and again. So, I will only move forward as you said” The Heroine of the story. Eimi is a 1st year high school student who has a cheerful personality. She often jokes around and likes to tease Takagi because of his overly strict personality. Her dream is to become a full member of the basketball team, even if her body is on the short side. She is a joyful and determined girl who loves basketball, but she always hides her sadness behind her smile. Because of her kind personality, she decides to be Takagi's friend, who is lonely and often comes to the Art club room to meet him and makes him smile.
row.short_description: The picture of café au lait is a visual novel game that makes the players feel immersed in story and character. They will experience the story in the game through the first-person perspective of the main character in the story named 'Takagi'.

row.name: Tri City Monsters
row.detailed_description: Roadmap About the Game In TCM, meet Mori (fly-by-night party punk), Amir (lithe, conniving socialite), and Akello (certified DILF)- three mostly-normal, hot men who find themselves embroiled in the supernatural.  Choose which path to pursue as you uncover their real demonic natures, catch feelings, and get busy with them at your discretion.  The city's a dangerous place, however, and even worse things are lurking in grungy alleys to catch you (and your beau) off guard. Explore each character's struggles in pursuit of their goals in further upcoming chapters, set to release regularly. What does it mean to be human? In Tri City Monsters you'll come face to face with the answers. Mori, Amir, and Akello all lead very separate lives with their own problems but they all have one thing in common: they've traded their humanity for power but they all got more than they bargained for- and with some greater power making moves from the shadows, the dangers are a lot higher than any of them anticipated. Help them cope with what's happened to them- by embracing their new demonic forms or by holding on to their humanity, the choice is yours- and maybe forge a deep and permanent connection. In one form or another. CURRENT Choose your name and pronouns Choose your body type for sex scenes --> Whether the player is described as having a penis, vagina, or a mystery :) Stream-safe audio CGs + Gallery for each character UPCOMING Regular upcoming chapter updates that will follow each character to the culmination of their story. Each character will have multiple endings- a human ending, a monster ending, and a 'declined getting together' ending. Spicy scenes with both the human and monster forms. Ace friendly relationships- you can decline hooking up with characters without making them sad or angry. TCM contains explicit 18+ content and a lot of kinky material!  In addition to general content warnings, please note the story has elements of: Alcohol and drug use Implied but not always explicit consent Weird monster anatomy Elements of mind control, with consent (in Amir's route only) Threats of bodily harm from antagonist characters towards the MC Sex Work/Prostitution (Amir is a luxury escort) Artificial/Temporary biology changes Future chapters will include double penetration, elements of feral/primal fucking, more weird monster anatomy so keep an eye out here for more information as more chapters are released.
row.short_description: Tri City Monsters is a supernatural, monsterlovin' visual novel where you can romance and/or de-pants 3 demonic love interests. Navigate a dangerous urban jungle with their help and maybe you'll get a taste of what it means to be a monster.
row.notes: Lots of adult language Use of Alcohol Blood & Violence Mild Body Horror Graphic Depictions of Sex

row.name: Phanotia: Interlude I-Aubzan Abbey
row.detailed_description: 'Phanotia Interlude I: Aubzan Abbey' is an ARPG game using pixel style. Players will play the role of 'Connecticut' and rescue the illegally imprisoned prostitutes in Aubzan Abbey together with their companions. Two years before the timeline of 'Phanotia Interlude I: Aubzan Abbey' in 'Phanotia I: Escavive,' Princess Biana of the Fraensius Empire decided to send her trusted courtiers Celine and Allea, as well as Connecticut on the mobile fortress Oslou, which was currently undergoing maintenance in the Fraensius Empire, as foreign aid to rescue the Vampir prostitutes who were secretly imprisoned in the Aubzan Abbey and played for the nobles, And try to find a larger dark network behind it. Players can experience excellent plots and relatively excellent vertical paintings in 'Phanotia Interlude I: Aubzan Abbey' . Of course, the game contains a lot of sincerity, and players can experience exquisite level design and smooth game experience. the entire 'Phanotia' series has a magnificent world view, which will be presented to all respected players in the future.
row.short_description: Princess Biana of the Fraensius Empire decided to send her trusted courtiers Celine and Allea, as well as Connecticut, as foreign aid to rescue the Vampir prostitutes who were secretly imprisoned in the Aubzan Abbey and played for the nobles, And try to find a larger dark network behind it.
row.notes: This game only contains a small number of sensitive themes. The identity of the supporting characters in this work is somewhat special. They are prostitutes who are forced into prostitution. The game only briefly describes their identities, and does not contain descriptions of sexual behavior and extreme violence. But due to the particularity of the profession of "prostitute".

row.name: Bee-Man
row.detailed_description: It's the Bee-Man game ( ﾉ ﾟｰﾟ)ﾉ Our Bee-Man's hives are scattered all over the place. Help it collect all of the hives in each level and travel to the next level in the bubble! The levels get increasingly challenging with new mechanics that keep the fun alive! - Jump over floating blocks over the water! - Avoid the falling icicles! - Reverse gravity and walk on the ceiling! - Fly the Bee-Man around! Collect all the items in each level to gain all three stars. Can you do that for all levels? --- Bee-Man is a level based mini-Metroidvania puzzle platformer in which the objective is to collect all the bee hives in each level to be able to advance to the next level. There are also bonus items to collect to achieve a three stars score for each level.
row.short_description: Our Bee-Man's hives are scattered all over the place. Help it collect all of the hives in each level and travel to the next level in the bubble!

row.name: Elf of Era! Idols Project
row.detailed_description: 本作品为现实中的EOE虚拟偶像团体的二次同人衍生作品，与现实中的真实状况无关。 游戏内容 本游戏为视觉小说游戏，将为您讲述一个美好而又充满酸甜苦辣咸的偶像故事。 游戏原案超十五万字，共八个章节，游戏拥有三十余张精美CG及二十多首原创背景音乐。 本游戏有跌宕起伏扣人心弦的精美剧情： “如果有人哭了我一定会狠狠地跳脸，露出我健康的笑容。” 游戏简介 当人们脑海中回想起梦想这个词时，总会带着无奈的苦笑与惋惜。梦想总是伴随着生活的重压，在口袋里慢慢瘪了气，而曾经怀揣梦想的我们，也往往向现实低头。 但如果你有了一个能与现实对抗，去实现梦想的机会，你会作何选择？ 在本作中，五位少女也将面临种种现实与抉择，她们能否守护好那似远似近的梦想呢？ 请去见证吧，见证那独属于勇敢追梦者的故事。 角色 唐莞儿 生日：3月27日 “快看，连星光都为我应援！” 姜柚恩 生日：5月10日 “名为偶像的七色光折射进我的心房，将一切染上彩虹色。” 苏虞莫 生日：7月9日 “一百万换走这段时光？一千万都不行！” 白露早 生日：10月18日 “从僵死的艺术之海抬头，迎向我的是香榭大街的暖风，眼见尽是繁花锦簇。” 安米诺 生日：12月6日 “我们虽然总是在意分离，但也要把握相遇。”
row.short_description: 在迷茫的前路上，我们都如木偶般木讷前行。但一位平凡而又特别的女孩，却手握着能够改变命运的彩券。五位少女的人生轨迹也被这看起来普通的小纸票联系起来。构筑在现实之上的梦境能否实现？现在，请让我们仔细聆听…
developers: Elf of Era! Idols Project制作组
publishers: Elf of Era! Idols Project制作组

row.name: A Date with Death
row.detailed_description: You're just an ordinary person... or so you thought. For your entire life, you've been narrowly avoiding death by pure luck... or is it something more? When a strange program suddenly appears on your computer, and someone claiming to be the Grim Reaper says he's come for your soul, your life as you know it is thrown upside down. As you delve deeper into the mysterious man that calls himself the Grim Reaper, you begin to wonder if fate brought you two together for a reason. Can you resist his charm, or will you fall for the one destined to take your soul? A Date with Death is a supernatural romance chat simulator visual novel about the week long bet you enter against the Grim Reaper to attempt to keep your soul. Create your own character, from appearance to pronouns, decorate your apartment, and spend the (possible) last week of your life getting to know the one hunting for your soul. 💀 Make Your Character: Build your own protagonist, from their physical appearance to their pronouns and name. Update them throughout the game! 💀 Design Your Apartment: Decorate your apartment to your liking and create a cozy space that you'll love coming back to. 💀 Pet Your Furry (or scaley?) Companion: Yes, you can pet the dog. Snuggle up with your furry friend in-between chats. 💀 Choices That Matter: Make decisions that will affect your character's fate and lead you to one of multiple possible endings. What kind of relationship will you have with the Grim Reaper? 💀 Beautiful Art of the Babygirl Grim Reaper:  Fill up your gallery throughout your playthrough with beautiful CGs, backgrounds, sketches, and more!
row.short_description: Fight against & romance the one hunting for your soul in A Date with Death, a romance chat simulator where you date(?) the Grim Reaper himself. Create your own character, decorate your apartment, and chat away with the charming yet dangerous Grim Reaper through text and video calls.

row.name: Mages of Osmea
row.detailed_description: Become a mage and fight the corrupted monsters threatening the peace of Osmea. Invent your own spells ranging from multi-stage projectiles to area effects or healing and speed buffing spells. Invite your friends to help you in battle against waves of monsters and powerful enemies. Tinker around and finetune your arsenal of spells and level up your attributes until you are strong enough to challenge the 3 bosses who are at the root of the corruption. Spell Creation Use a powerful editor to create new spells and customize every aspect. Design projectiles that follow enemies or heal friends. They can even trigger more projectiles in multiple stages or end in an area of effect. Tune self targetting spells to heal yourself or give you a speed boost. Specialization Specialize your playstyle with skills such as adding chaining damage that jumps to nearby enemies, make area effects move with you, or add healing over time to your healing projectiles.
row.short_description: Mages of Osmea is a top down spellslinging RPG where you create your own spells to defeat corrupted monsters. Fight through waves of monsters and bosses, completing objectives in singleplayer or with friends.

row.name: The Last Frontier
row.detailed_description: You are the last surviving person on earth, between you and the hordes of zombies, only the walls of your bunker. Learn how to build weapons and turrets, protect yourself and your base, but remember, sooner or later they will break through your defenses. 16 weapons 8 defense turrets 4 difficulty levels Unique graphics Author's soundtracks from the developer Welcome to the game ' The Last Frontier ' and enjoy the game. :)
row.short_description: You are the last surviving person on earth, between you and the hordes of zombies, only the walls of your bunker. Learn how to build weapons and turrets, defend yourself and your base, but remember, sooner or later they will break through your defenses...

row.name: Zombie Ants VR
row.detailed_description: Zombie Ants VR is a short (5-10 minute) educational experience that takes the player through the life cycle of Ophiocordyceps, a fungus that drives creatures (in this case ants) to change their behavior in order to propagate the fungus then ultimately kills them. This fungus was a large inspiration for the video game series Last of Us and is often affectionately referred to as the 'Zombie Fungus'. The game offers several different control schemes to accommodate all sorts of players from those who have never used VR before (and those susceptible to motion sickness) to those who want a more interactive experience. Educational content reading level recommended for ages 12+. This project was a student & recent-grad driven endeavor developed through a collaboration between the University of Central Florida (UCF) biology & game development departments as well as the University of Utrecht (UU) biology department. It was supported by NSF Career 1941546, made available to Charissa de Bekker.
row.short_description: Zombie Ants VR is a short (5-10 minute) experience that takes the player through the life cycle of Ophiocordyceps, a fungus that drives creatures (in this case ants) to change their behavior in order to propagate the fungus and ultimately kills them.

row.name: 缘起
row.detailed_description: A science fiction themed game where characters from different cultures engage in a chaotic battle. The product tells the story of the future, under the threat of artificial intelligence, in order to awaken human competitive awareness, various human settlements recommend athletes to participate in a competitive conference held on outlying islands.
row.short_description: Action based real-time combat chaos game. Win or lose is determined by occupying key points and repelling enemies to earn points. Competitive behavior between characters based on different cultural attributes.

row.name: All is Fair in Love and Vore: The Tavorion Collection
row.detailed_description: Vore. It is the lifeblood of this world! Experience the experience all your work colleagues have been talking about, and finally get around to playing Tavorion's classic games! The collection includes never-before-seen short stories hidden throughout the games, and a complete unlockable Gallery. Not to mention, the entire thing is in both English and Spanish! Expect walking, talking, and the occasional poorly-made minigame. The stories will take you through thrills, chills, and... so much more! You literally cannot afford to miss out on this free artistic experience! The Beast of Tier 4 Play as Rana, a stunningly beautiful woman with a horrifying secret: she devours human beings alive! Seduce and deceive prey to lure them away from safety, and into your stomach... Voyage to Satiety Stephen is trapped on the ship of the enigmatic former-celebrity Olivia Ashdown, and forced to fight to avoid being devoured alive! Will he survive? Does he care about the lives of his fellow captives? Who will he grow close to? Find out! Voyage to Satiety 2 Given a second chance, will Liv finally learn to live a life she's happy with? No! Mission 74 Vore assassin! Avoid the stylishly-designed robots, devour the target! Epic! Hunger of the Fifth Sunset Ex-soldier Alexandria Twain is on a journey through war-torn Guantemana to find her cousin, and decides to stay a few nights at a welcoming hostel. But behind the welcoming smiles, warm food and vibrant colours, there are rumbling stomachs yearning for live human flesh... All is Fair in Love and Vore In the thrilling conclusion to this game saga, the characters fight the other characters and some of them die and there's vore (+ kind of vore) and it's allegory for important stuff.
row.short_description: Vore visual novel! Vore! Sex! Complex characters! Profound thoughts! Women! Well-researched historical settings! Cannibalism! Never before has it been so easy to play all 6 iconic masterpieces, now with extra content!
row.reviews: “Yeah it's great I think you should play it” 6/10 – Tavorion
row.notes: This game contains frequent nudity and sexual encounters. It also contains a lot of non-consensual human-on-human 'vore' (being eaten alive and whole), which many people might find disturbing. Graphic portrayal of gore is generally avoided, although vore is conceptually somewhat graphic. Cartoon depictions of blood and bones are present.

row.name: Space Crab VS
row.detailed_description: Space Crab VS brings the time tested, heart pumping Space Crab gameplay into the multiplayer battle-zone! As the the long awaited sequel to Space Crab 2, Space Crab VS offers wonderful all-new features, including an exciting story mode - a series first! Use your Space Crab skills to take your opponent down! Collect meteor dust to make your own meteors, or charge up for a powerful special attack! Pick from 20+ different unlock-able crabs to fight with! Each one has their own movement patterns and special attacks. From the shadow sneaking Ninja Crab to the time manipulating Chrono Crab, you'll find a crab worthy of your partnership! Experience the story of Space Crab putting together the Star Seekers, a group of crabs who explore the galaxy and it's many secrets. Meet strange friends as you fight towards your goals! Battle it out with your real life rivals in local multiplayer fights! Take a break from the excitement and chill out with classic Space Crab game-play, with all new VS style move-sets to keep things fresh. Unlock-able single player and multi-player secrets to uncover! Discover your Starlight Rival, in Space Crab VS!
row.short_description: Battle against other crabs with time tested arcade action! Form galactic partnerships and starlight rivalries in the story mode, or battle against other players locally with more than 20 unlockable crabs- some strange, many powerful.

row.name: Vesna
row.detailed_description: In this heartwarming re-imagination of Slavic lore, travel to Vyriy, home of the gods, a world full of mysteries and adventure at every turn. Follow Vesna and her sister Morena as they battle their way through dust bunnies and frog minions and discover that destiny is not always written in stone. Vesna is a turn-based, top down video game for Windows. Playing as the titular character Vesna, her sister Morena and the bog knave Dennis, use strategy to plan our your movements before attacking. Vesna's close range sweep and thrust attacks pair well with Morena's ice ping and ice wave attacks. All sound effects and music from Sound Q Substance Designer Stylized Feathers / 3dex Unreal Marketplace Assets Alchemist’s House / Yevheniia Yaremko - DarkSorceress Animset / wemakethegame - Female Mage Set / Rapa XR - A Huge Animation Bundle / Infectedfury - Knocked Down Animation Pack / Center of Nothing - Potion Props Pack / letsmakecoolart - Top-Down Starter Kit [SWVictoria] / PolyNext - Visual Novel Framework - Full System / Woodsy Studio - Stylized Forest / TomkaGS Assets from ArtStation Marketplace Hand Painted Alpha Ornamental Elements / Art Talent Studio - Stylized Wheat Roof / 3dExtrude - Stylized Stones with Ivy / 3dExtrude Assets from Freepik upklyak: Fruit and berry icons - Magic spheres shiny energy balls - Game ui loading progress bars cartoon vector set - Game level or avatar frames ui icons buttons set -Game level or avatar frames ui icons buttons set - Game wooden level or avatar frames ui icons - Wooden game banners medieval ui menu elements macrovector: Magic bottles icon set
row.short_description: Vesna is an indie made fantasy, turn-based game. Made using Unreal Engine.

row.name: Sybil is Haunted
row.detailed_description: (This game deals with sensitive subjects. Be careful.) This game is not a straightforward experience. Depending how you treat Sybil, and what adventures you take her on, your ending will be different. In this game you wander the detailed confines of Sybil's room and search for each ending. row.name: Saloon Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: America, 19th century after the Civil War. Sand dunes, hot sun, and galloping horses - feel it all while holding a portion of Tequila on ice in your hand. In Saloon Simulator Prologue, take on the challenge of rebuilding an old saloon in the heart of the Wild West and become a pioneer in the liquor business. Prepare drinks, serve them to customers, and discover their stories Not everything went your way; you were cheated, but don't worry! Your longed-for paradise is closer than ever - refresh the ruined interior and repair the damaged furnishings. Purchase the most necessary equipment, stock up on alcohol, and start designing the saloon to your liking. Just remember, money is not manna from heaven - ill-considered purchases are not necessarily advisable here! Prepare dishes, feed your guests, and observe their reactions In Saloon Simulator Prologue, you are the owner of a ruined Saloon. Make the wooden walls once again become a place of bustling meetings with a lot of alcohol. Attract customers and fulfill their expectations with the utmost care, while learning about drink recipes or various types of alcohol inspired by 19th-century America. But that's not all, your task will also be to provide an atmospheric decor, and thus maintain order. Enhance your saloon by choosing from over 50 decoration models. Earn reputation points and attract more and more customers. Make your new guests want to come back again and again with generous tips. Create the most recognizable business in the Wild West. Build relationships with 8 unique NPCs and become a part of their lives. Serving drinks or preparing food is a hard and time-consuming job, but it becomes impossible without prior preparation of the logistical background. Plan your orders in advance and keep your saloon stocked. Increase your business capital through negotiations. Maintain your saloon for customer comfort Expand your Saloon - unlock new equipment or rooms. Establish new relationships with characters and reap the benefits of them, all to help your business thrive. Dive into the mechanics of the criminal world The 19th-century West beyond the sand dunes and hot sun offers history-soaked grounds and a variety of activities. As the day begins to head west, while holding a glass of cold Tequila, take a look at what the area outside the Saloon has to offer, as well as its residents, whose favor will make your life easier more than once or twice.   Saloon Simulator Prologue, includes: -16 Quests: Engage in a variety of tasks that introduce you to saloon management. -12 Drinks and Recipes: Mix and serve a selection of 10 drinks and 2 special recipes. -8 NPCs: Interact with unique characters, each with their own stories and challenges. -Bartending Mechanics: Master drink preparation and cooking. -Criminal World Mechanics: Experience thrilling activities like dismantling carts and hiding bodies. -Full Customization: Customize every aspect of your saloon from the floor to the chandelier. -Premises Management: Unload goods, clean up, and maintain a pristine environment. -Bar Fights: Handle conflicts and keep the peace in your saloon. -3 Merchants: Trade with various suppliers for essential goods and decorations. -Over 50 Customizable Objects: Personalize your saloon with a wide range of items. -Dealing with Death: Navigate the darker aspects of saloon management, including handling dead bodies. Get ready to dive into the life of a saloon owner and create the most recognizable business in the Wild West with Saloon Simulator Prologue.
row.short_description: Saloon Simulator Prologue lets you restore an abandoned Saloon and discover that managing it isn't just about creating drinks and meals. Clean up, organize, and choose the right friends - all to become the most recognizable business in the Wild West!

Playtime: Around 40 minutes. The Gameplay This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration mechanics. Key Features Atmospheric environment and photo-realistic graphics. Player voice activity. Endings: The game has 2 Endings. As a new game developer, I'm thrilled to release my very first project into the gaming world. I'd like to express my gratitude to those who've purchased my game, and thank them for taking a chance on a new developer. I'm excited to hear feedback from players who've experienced my game, and I encourage them to leave a review and share their thoughts. I'm open to constructive criticism, and I want to use it to improve my skills as a game developer.

row.name: War For Galaxy: New Era
row.detailed_description: The planetary base is your fortress. The main resources for construction are extracted and stored here, scientific research is carried out, new projects for the construction of spaceships are being opened, and much more. The space fleet and ground defense will help protect the base from uninvited guests. Build energy domes, laser cannons, and upgrade technologies. The dock is the forge of spaceships. Currently, there are 15 types of ships in the game that will be available upon completion of the game. Each ship has its own characteristics and purpose. There are warships with different levels of armor and tactical weapons, there are scout ships, transport ships, there are ships for exploring new planets, collecting debris and even stealing. The player is given the opportunity to form flotillas himself and send them on various missions. WarForGalaxy is a multiplayer, cross-platform open-world game based on construction, battles and robbery. You have a choice: be friends with your neighbors or make them your source of power. Attacking the planets of other players, you cannot completely destroy or conquer them, but you can destroy the enemy's fleet and defenses, take away his resources - the most valuable thing in the galaxy. Before attacking, send scout ships to the planet and think over a strategy. Attention! Fights in the game do not happen instantly. The flight to the target takes some time, and the farther away the enemy planet is from your star system, the longer the fleet will fly. However, sometimes you may even run out of fuel and then you will have to develop a new strategy. When the fleet reaches its destination, you will receive an alert on the bridge about the start of the battle. You can personally take command of the flotilla  and influence the outcome of the battle. By choosing the right targets and using the special skills of the ships, you can inflict more damage on ships and enemy defenses. If you are offline, the fight will take place automatically, and you will receive a report on the fight.  Did you want to take someone else's goods for yourself with impunity? Then you should come to us. Sign a contract with the pirates and the Marauder ship will appear in your Dock. Even if the loot turns out to be small, you'll be able to lime your neighbors pretty well. And if you like fair fights and resource extraction, you can trade resources on the stock exchange. There is no currency in WFG, resources are exchanged for resources, and fuel is the most valuable resource. Expansion is the engine of progress. It is impossible to stay on the same planet all the time and develop effectively. With the development of Planet Exploration technology, it becomes possible to send ships to uninhabited planets, establish colonies there and keep these colonies under the rule of the first planet. The more advanced this technology is, the more planets can be part of the empire. You choose which planet to colonize. Planets differ in size and temperature, which in turn affects the volume of extraction of certain resources. Manage your empire from various gaming devices. The game is supported on PC, Android, iOS and WebGL

row.name: Vroom Vroom Valley
row.detailed_description: Gameplay A driving game that gives the player a manual transmission car to drive with. After each playsession, you'll understand more of the car and how it handles. Also you'll get more familiar with the roads, which helps you to take better lines. As you get these skills under control, it's time to push and reach the finish as fast as possible. Whether you are a fan of rally stages or race tracks, we got you covered. Scenery changes keep the game fresh, from twisty country road down at ground level to looping road high in the valley. The game includes a long rally stage and 4 race tracks. Rally stage is playable in Stage Rally and race tracks in Time Trial. Race tracks are located in 2 different places with 4 different routes in total. In Stage Rally mode, the player will drive through the valley collecting time bonuses along the way, which helps you get further in the valley, perhaps all the way to the finish. The game ends if time runs out. In Time Trial mode, player is given 3 laps to drive through the track. The car has manual transmission. Using 2nd and 3rd gear is the most efficient way of driving this car. After each play session, you'll get more familiar with the car and the roads, which helps you to get better results.
row.short_description: Hit the race track and improve your racing skills or take a sunday drive in a beautiful scenery. Vroom Vroom Valley offers a safe driving experience for the rookies but can also challenge the most seasoned veterans.

row.name: Anonymous Messages
row.detailed_description: You wake up in the middle of a bizarre, unsettling forest with no recollection of your past. Armed with nothing but a flashlight and an old cassette player, you must navigate through the wilderness, seeking clues to regain your lost memory. As you explore, your heart rate slowly begins to rise, filling you with dread. Your only hope comes in the form of six cassette tapes scattered throughout the forest. Each tape contains cryptic, anonymous messages that provide fleeting moments of clarity and calm your pounding heart. But with each tape you find, the forest grows more hostile, and the trees seem to close in on you as if they’re watching your every move. Can you survive long enough to piece together your forgotten past, or will the forest consume you? Features: Psychological Horror: Experience a creeping sense of insanity as memory loss and the eerie atmosphere turn your surroundings into a nightmare. Immersive Environment: The unsettling, otherworldly forest provides a haunting backdrop that amplifies your feeling of being truly lost. Unique Survival Mechanic: Your heart rate is both your friend and enemy. The more it rises, the closer you are to losing control. Localization: Play with English or Arabic subtitles for an immersive experience across different languages. --------------------------------- This is a port of the original game developed & published in 2013 which was developed by: - BUG GAMES Team - Programmer: Danar Kayfi (@DanarKayfi) Artist: Mohammad Al-Dmour (@LightOfDarkness) Original Idea By: Anmar Al-Obaidy (@PhAnmar) Voice Over: Toni Sattler (@ToniSattler) ---------------------------------
row.short_description: You find yourself lost in a strange, eerie forest with no memory of how you got there. Equipped only with a flashlight and a cassette player, you must survive and recover fragments of your memory. But beware—the trees are watching you.

row.name: Bronzebeard's Tavern
row.detailed_description: Bronzebeard's Tavern is a goofy and playful restaurant manager sim where 1-8 players can work as a team with multiplayer co-op. Fulfill a number of different roles, serve a diverse range of customers and cook up delicious dwarven cuisine. 8-Player Multiplayer! Work together (or try) to keep the tavern running for as long as you can with seven other dwarves in online multiplayer. Serve Customers! Properly manage customer seating and orders and deliver them the correct foods to reap rewards! Cook Up and Blend Delicious Food and Drink! Prepare food for the customers upon receiving orders from your teammates, being careful not to burn anything! Customize your Menu! Your daily customers are always different! Design your menu however you like based on the day's forecast and food sales! Many Customers to Discover! There's always an unfamiliar face showing up when you're working in a tavern... can you satisfy them all? Upgrade your Tavern! Build up your tavern with upgrades! These decisions change the way you play and are crucial for progressing into tougher days. Opt for more customer capacity with a shiny new expansion or utilities like more blenders or more stoves to increase your output!
row.short_description: Bronzebeard's Tavern is a goofy and playful restaurant manager sim where 1-8 players can work as a team with multiplayer co-op. Fulfill a number of different roles, serve a diverse range of customers and cook up delicious dwarven cuisine.

row.name: Homicipher: Demo
row.detailed_description: This Trial version included the first chapter of Homicipher. The savedata of Trial version will not be available for the final version. Update date: January 22, 2025 ver 4.0 This is a trial version, so updates may be made without prior notice. Please note that save data from previous versions may become incompatible. When the protagonist wakes up, they find themselves lost in a different world. As they learn the words of the mysterious monsters that speak a strange language, they search for a way to escape. Along the way, will they fall in love with the monster men who come to their aid...? Really? In this alternate world, a different language is used. Players will interpret and dechiper characters' words through expressions, gestures and the objects they point to. The language of this world isn’t as refined as human languages. One meaning is concentrated in one word, with almost no particles; a string of words conveys only a rough meaning. This is a point-and-click adventure game. Players will investigate items to learn words or engage in conversation to progress. Choices for actions are available at various points. Small changes in development, branching paths, or even instant death can occur. Even if you reach a game over, you can retry from just before without any penalties. There’s no affection management, and acquiring flags will unlock more choices. Players can freely jump back to previously encountered scenes from chapters and try again. Play comfortably and easily!
row.short_description: Homicipher is a female-targeted language deciphering and exploration ADV based on the concept of 'romance with horror men.' The protagonist, who has wandered into another world, interacts with non-human beings to decipher their language while striving to escape.

row.short_description: It's a nice sunny day in Dubai, and you decide to wander into the shady clinic of Dr. Carlos PhD. Once inside, you are tasked with answering questions that will reveal your true nature...

row.name: Eldritchvania
row.detailed_description: In Eldritchvania, you will explore unearthly ruins, solve arcane riddles and pick up your sword against the indescribable horrors that lurk amidst the forgotten depths of our world. Beware the creeping grip of madness as you uncover secrets not meant for the eyes of men. Over 70 hand drawn rooms to explore! Countless enemies and traps! Puzzles and riddles that will test your cunning! Upgrades and items to help you on your journey! Damnable bosses! Madness and insanity that affect how the game is played! Lore and story based on and inspired by the works of H.P Lovecraft Eldritchvania follows the aged occultist, Dougald, as he desperately tries to track down his son, Fergus. All clues lead him to believe Fergus traveled to the small island of Blackhorn, just outside the coast of northern Scotland. Dougald is convinced he must save his son before he unearths the ungodly knowledge buried deep beneath the island. But will his quest force him to uncover the very same secrets? Unearthing the long since abandoned ruins of lost civilizations, your cunning, endurance and sanity will be duly tested. Are you up to the task?
row.short_description: Explore unearthly ruins, solve arcane riddles and pick up your sword against the indescribable horrors that lurk amidst the forgotten depths of our world. Beware the creeping grip of madness as you uncover secrets not meant for the eyes of men!

row.name: Circuit Breakout: Dual Polarity
row.detailed_description: Circuit Breakout: Dual Polarity is an immersive 3D puzzle-adventure game that challenges players to think strategically and overcome electrifying challenges. Take control of two unique characters, Data and Surge, as you navigate through a derelict facility and uncover its hidden secrets. Use Data's rocket-powered mechanical arms to interact with machines and devices and use Surge's incredible electrical powers to activate the corporation's circuits and unlock new paths. Switch between the two characters at any time and make them work together to solve challenging logic puzzles. Experience a thrilling adventure full of surprises and secrets as you help Data and Surge find their way to freedom! Key Features: Dual-Character Gameplay : Seamlessly switch between Data and Surge, each with their own distinct abilities, to solve intricate electrical puzzles. Experience an innovative gameplay mechanic that requires careful coordination and clever thinking to progress. Emotional Bond : Traverse the abandoned facility and bring Data and Surge closer together, strengthening their bond and unveiling their heartwarming story. Atmospheric Environments : Explore the eerie, desolate atmosphere of the derelict facility, filled with abandoned rooms and cryptic messages. The stunning visuals and haunting ambiance draw players into the game's mysterious world. Brain-Teasing Puzzles : Test your problem-solving skills with a variety of logic-based puzzles, each designed to challenge your understanding of electricity and the unique abilities of Data and Surge. Rich Narrative : Unravel the enigmatic story of the facility, its history, and the connection between Data and Surge, as you progress through the game. The engaging narrative adds depth and emotion to the overall experience. Embark on a captivating journey of discovery and connection in Circuit Breakout: Dual Polarity. With its engaging dual-character gameplay, thought-provoking puzzles, and compelling narrative, this game is sure to electrify fans of puzzle-adventure games.
row.short_description: Unravel the mysteries of a derelict facility as you control two characters with unique abilities simultaneously in this thought-provoking 3D puzzle adventure.

row.name: ENDLING
row.detailed_description: What's your favorite color? Would you eat meatballs for the rest of your life? Are dogs really that cute? Live the perfect day, break the cycle, and discover the truth about yourself in ENDLING , a short, quirky sci-fi mystery about freedom, choice, and loneliness. A Lifetime of Choices Life is full of hard questions and difficult choices—but who says exploring them can't be fun? Watch as each new day brings more questions and curious changes. Marvel as your surroundings twist and turn to accommodate your every wish. But how—and to what end? This quizzical first-person game will have you wondering, guessing, contemplating—but it will take an inquisitive mind and a fondness for reckless destruction to really get to the bottom of things. Inspired by other story-driven, short-form games,  ENDLING  features not only a mind-boggling, soul-searching story, but also home-thrashing excellence and unparalleled high-octane beach ball action. The Perfect Day Just Got Better Originally released in 2021, this school-project-turned-indie-hit finally makes its Steam debut, featuring a slew of exciting improvements including: Enhanced graphics and lightning Upgraded UI, audio, and subtitles Better stuff-breaking physics A ton of puzzling achievements Bug fixes of every magnitude And more! Best of all, ENDLING  is still  free to keep and play! We want everyone to have the chance to live the perfect day—over, and over again!
row.short_description: Live the perfect day, break the cycle, and discover the truth about yourself in this short, quirky sci-fi mystery about freedom, choice, and loneliness.

row.name: Blind Bullet
row.detailed_description: Blind Bullet is a top-down 2D action shooting game. The player is blind but possesses exceptional hearing, allowing them to perceive their surroundings through echolocation generated by footsteps. Evasion In the game, unknown enemies will attack the player. When sound waves from footsteps hit the area where an enemy’s attack is coming from, the color of the waves changes. Pay close attention to the changes in the echoes to avoid enemy attacks. Attack When sound waves from footsteps hit an enemy, the waves flicker, revealing the enemy’s location. The player is skilled in handling firearms and can effortlessly use a shotgun when acquired. Rely on the echoes to aim and take down enemies. Investigate The player is unaware of their current situation. While they wish to find out what has happened to them and what is going on around them, their blindness limits what they can do alone. Work together with companions they meet along the way to uncover the truth. Contact & Guidelines If you encounter any issues, I would appreciate it if you could contact me via my Discord server or by DM on X (@tesakiza). The streaming and content guidelines are available at patreon.
row.short_description: Blind Bullet is a 'blind' 2D action shooting game. The player cannot see but can perceive their surroundings through echolocation generated by footsteps. Shoot down unknown enemies with a shotgun, investigate the area with companions, and uncover the truth behind what has happened to them.
